name: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
description: Happu lives happily with his family and works day and night as a policeman. However, his life is filled with humorous events and misadventures at home and at work.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 1
videos.overview: Happu Singh and his wife Rajjo’s time together is often interrupted by their nine kids and his Amma, mother, a cunning lady who claims to communicate with her dead husband. Stressed due to taking care of her large brood, Rajjo wishes for a holiday in Agra to de-stress. Throwing a wrench in their plans, Amma informs them about the imminent arrival of Happu’s uncle, Adveer. While Rajjo is adamant about going to Agra, Amma warns Happu with dire consequences if he and Rajjo leave.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 2 - March 05, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Happu Singh cribs about his marital woes to his friend, Beni Prasad. When Rajesh invites her mom to Kanpur for her treatment, Amma tries to discourage her. When Rajesh doesn’t relent, she calls Happu to stop his mother-in-law’s visit as it will coincide with her brother’s. Poor Happu gets stuck between doing right by his wife as well as his mother. He asks his fashionista-cum-English-obsessed daughter, Katori a.k.a Kat, to help him, while his other daughter, Chamchi, eavesdrops.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 3 - March 06, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Chamchi informs Amma about Happu and Kat’s conspiracy to stop Rajesh’s mother as well as Adveer's Mama’s visit. Hrithik, Happu’s son, who overhears Amma and Chamchi, informs Rajesh about Happu’s plan. As per Happu’s plan, Kat tells Amma and Rajesh that a crowded house will prevent her from studying for her exams. In front of Kat, Amma and Rajesh falsely agree to postpone their respective relatives from coming to Kanpur. However, they have no plans of following through on their promise.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 4 - March 07, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: When Amma confidently informs Chamchi of Adveer’s arrival, Hrithik listens in and informs the same to Rajesh. Hearing this, Rajesh also confirms her mother’s visit to Kanpur. Knowing that a battle awaits him at home, Happu is reluctant to return. Malaika, Happu’s wrestling-obsessed daughter, helps him scale the wall of their house, but Happu falls down and injures himself. The next morning, Happu is stunned upon knowing that Amma and Rajesh lied about their respective relative’s visit.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 5 - March 08, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Rajesh tells Happu about her wish to celebrate her upcoming birthday lavishly. Though Happu agrees momentarily, he worries about Amma’s reaction as Pitaji, Happu’s father, died on the same day as Rajesh’s birthday. The next morning, Happu approaches Amma for permission to celebrate Rajesh’s birthday. But, before Happu could say anything, Amma puts forth her wish to organise a prayer meeting for her husband on his death anniversary.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 6 - March 11, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Rajesh becomes angry on Happu for failing to take permission to celebrate her birthday from Amma. Stuck between Rajesh’s wish to celebrate her birthday and Amma’s desire to hold a prayer meeting on Pitaji’s death anniversary, Happu asks Beni for help. Beni tells Happu to sneak out from the temple during Pitaji’s prayer meeting to celebrate Rajesh’s birthday. Amma, who comes to know of Happu’s plan to throw Rajesh a birthday party, vows to ruin it.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 7 - March 12, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Amma uses cunning tactics to ensure Happu agrees to organise a prayer meeting for her husband’s death anniversary. Hrithik, who had eavesdropped on their conversation, reiterates everything to Rajesh. To convince an angry Rajesh, Happu promises to hold the prayer meeting as well as the celebration for her birthday. Happu informs his kids to keep Rajesh’s birthday celebration a secret from Amma and Chamchi. Finally, the day of Rajesh’s birthday and Pitaji’s death anniversary arrives.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 8 - March 13, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: By entrusting Beni with the responsibility of arranging the birthday cake and snacks, Happu leaves for work to arrange gifts for Rajesh without Amma’s interference. During the prayer meeting, Amma catches Beni sneaking in with Rajesh’s birthday cake, but Happu handles the situation tactfully. While Amma becomes engrossed in the prayer meeting, Rajesh and Happu sneak out to celebrate her birthday. Soon, their children and friends join the celebration as well.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 9 - March 14, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Leaving Amma and Chamchi, Happu, Rajesh, their kids and friends begin celebrating Rajesh’s birthday. When Amma notices their absence, Happu makes excuses to distract Amma and re-joins the celebrations. Feeling suspicious, Chamchi peeps in the house through the window and sees everyone dancing and celebrating. She takes Amma inside, effectively putting an end to the merriment. Amma soon realises her mistake and herself joins in the celebrations for Rajesh’s birthday.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 10 - March 15, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Rajesh and Happu make plans to celebrate the upcoming festival of ‘Holi’. Speaking with Pitaji’s ghost, Amma reminisces about their past ‘Holi’ celebrations. While celebrating ‘Holi’ early, Happu’s younger kids drench Beni with water and make fun of his romantic feelings towards Rajesh’s sister – Vimlesh. When Amma and Rajesh get into an argument, it escalates to the level that Amma puts a ban on celebrating ‘Holi’. Happu’s attempts to mediate the dispute between them fails.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 12 - March 19, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: In a game of truth and dare, Chamchi dares Ranbir to play ‘Holi’ with her. The kids secretly enjoy the festival away from Rajesh’s and Amma’s prying eyes, but Malaika catches them in the act. To outwit Amma and Rajesh, Happu suggests them to allow the family to celebrate ‘Diwali’ instead of ‘Holi’. Though Amma and Rajesh initially dismiss Happu’s idea, they agree in the end. Finally, the day of ‘Holi’ arrives and Happu’s family makes preparations to celebrate ‘Diwali’ instead.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 13 - March 20, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh try to outdo each other while preparing sweets for ‘Diwali’. Happu and the kids feel dejected to be celebrating ‘Diwali’ instead of ‘Holi’. Surprising everyone, Rajesh and Amma bury their dispute and start celebrating ‘Holi’. Happy at the turn of events, the kids join their neighbours in the festivities. The next morning, chaos ensues when the news of Ranbir failing in the sixth-grade breaks. Amma and Happu blame Rajesh for Ranbir’s inadequate academic performance.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 14 - March 21, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Rajesh comes across Happu’s sixth-grade mark sheet and realises that he too had failed in his sixth-grade. She becomes enraged as Happu had lied about being an exceptional student. She calls him at work and vows to take revenge upon him when he returns. She informs Amma about Happu’s duplicity as well. During dinner-time, Rajesh asks Happu to re-take the sixth-grade tests alongside Ranbir to prove his credibility. To gain an upper hand over Rajesh, Amma commands Happu to pass in the tests.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 15 - March 22, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Happu tries to pacify Rajesh but fails. The next day, Kat is entrusted with the responsibility to set the test paper for Hrithik and Happu. The fear of failing makes Happu ask Beni for help. Beni promises to have a solution for him by evening. Amma calls Happu at work and reminds him to study well, and also warns him of dire consequences if he fails. Rajesh helps Hrithik study for the test and is left surprised by his preparation. Beni suggests Happu to cheat in the test.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 16 - March 25, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Amma encourages Happu to cheat in the test. He requests Kat to leak the question paper. When Kat doesn’t relent, Happu attempts to bribe her but Malaika intervenes and takes Kat away. Eventually, Happu tries to get out of giving the test but Amma stops him. To help Ranbir score more marks than Happu, Rajesh asks Hrithik to capture a picture of the test paper set by Kat. Happu also requests Chamchi to do the same for him. With Amma’s encouragement, Chamchi agrees to do Happu’s bidding.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 17 - March 26, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: When Hrithik and Chamchi search Kat’s room to click a picture of the test paper, Malaika catches them and sends them away. She also warns Rajesh and Happu from cheating again. Beni gives Happu some laxatives so that he can evade giving the test. During the test, Happu waits for the laxative’s effect to kick-in. However, Amma and Rajesh scrap the test after putting their juvenile feud away. Happu is left to face the consequences of his actions.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 18 - March 27, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Beni predicts that Amma may fall prey to a deadly attack. An insurance agent informs Amma that she is liable to receive INR 25 lakhs. Not much later, seeing Amma’s medical reports, Rajesh tells Happu to do something about Amma’s increasing blood sugar. Amma, who overhears a part of their conversation, interprets that Happu is conspiring with Rajesh to kill her to get his hands on her money. When Rajesh mixes a sugar-control medicine in her food, Amma feels she is trying to poison her.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 19 - March 28, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Amma calls the police helpline and complaints about her son and daughter-in-law trying to poison her. When she realises that it is Happu who had received her call, she hangs up. When Rajesh serves lunch to her, she refuses to consume it fearing it may contain poison. As Rajesh adamantly insists her to have lunch, she lies about having eaten it already. While Happu asks a doctor for remedies to lower Amma’s blood sugar, Kamlesh tries to trap a rat but fails miserably.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 20 - March 29, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Amma fears that the ‘halwa’ served to her is laced with poison. Her fear strengthens when Happu prohibits his kids from eating the ‘halwa’. When Happu force-feeds it to her, she discreetly spits it out. When Amma sees a person holding a knife in his hand, she starts shouting and running. Happu, who only wanted Amma to run as a form of exercise to lower her blood sugar, is beaten and chased out of the house by his kids.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 21 - April 01, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Rajesh tries to hide the fact that the person who broke into their house was Happu himself. To explain his injured state, Happu lies about being beaten by the perpetrator. However, Amma catches Happu’s lie and her fear strengthens. She confides her trouble in an unlikely source and asks for help. The next morning, she calls a ‘pundit’ to their house to predict her future. Meanwhile, Happu once again asks the doctor to suggest some other remedy to help lower Amma’s blood sugar.

videos.title: Amma is attacked by Happu once again - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: Happu once again attacks Amma with a knife to make her run. He is beaten and chased away by Beni and his children. Amma decides to confront Happu and Rajesh directly.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 23 - April 03, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Amma’s misunderstanding regarding Happu and Rajesh is solved. Later, Amma expresses her wish to participate in a dance competition organised in the neighbourhood.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 24 - April 04, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Happu is stuck making a choice to participate in the dance competition with Amma or Rajesh. The police commissioner instructs Happu to find his lost phone.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 25 - April 05, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh battle over who should participate in the dance competition with Happu. Happu lies about breaking his leg to fool the police commissioner.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 26 - April 08, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Happu and his family try to convince the commissioner of his injury. When Kat’s phone trapped in the fake plaster worn by Happu starts ringing, the commissioner becomes suspicious.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 27 - April 09, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Happu’s lie is inadvertently exposed due to Kat and Kamlesh’s antics. Malaika apprises the commissioner of the reality. The commissioner gives a surprising punishment to Happu.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 28 - April 10, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Happu promises to save Rajesh if she were ever in a sinking ship with Amma. To pacify Amma, he promises to save her. Hrithik informs Rajesh about Happu and Amma’s conversation.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 29 - April 11, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Happu tries to pacify an angry Rajesh. The next morning, when Beni tells Rajesh that Happu will save himself and not her and Amma from a sinking Ship, Rajesh’s anger increases.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 30 - April 12, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh put an end to the feud between them. Both the ladies also praise Happu for his display of bravery and loyalty in the face of a trying situation.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 31 - April 15, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh get into a tussle over who amongst them has the best sense of humour. Happu laughs at both their jokes to keep the matter from escalating.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 32 - April 16, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Happu feigns laughter at Amma and Rajesh’s jokes. Hrithik and Chamchi overhear Happu sharing his true feelings to Beni. Beni agrees to play the role of a buffalo in Kamlesh’s play.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 33 - April 17, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh get angry with Happu over the phone for bad mouthing their jokes. Later, Happu asks Beni to come along to defuse the situation at home.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 34 - April 18, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh ask Happu to choose whose sense of humour is better. Later, Happu wants Beni to settle the debate between Amma and Rajesh as to who is more hilarious.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 35 - April 19, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Chamchi chooses Amma while Hrithik picks Rajesh when an argument is struck over whose jokes are better. Later, Amma and Rajesh get angry with Happu for laughing on their bad jokes.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 36 - April 22, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Happu makes a plan of watching a movie in a theatre with Rajesh. To successfully hide the plan from Amma, he decides to lie to her about visiting the market with Rajesh.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 37 - April 23, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Kat and Kamlesh, Rajesh and Happu and Amma arrive at the same theatre to watch a movie. Chaos ensues when Malaika’s actions unravel everyone’s secret.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 38 - April 24, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Amma asks Happu to help Raju, son of a family friend who is being troubled by his wife. Later, Rajesh requests him to help solve her friend Sarika’s marital troubles as well.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 39 - April 25, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Sarika arrives at Happu’s residence after an altercation with her husband - Raju. Happu lands himself in trouble settling Raju and Sarika’s marital dispute.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 40 - April 26, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Happu lands himself in trouble with the commissioner for coming to work in casual clothes. Meanwhile, Raju and Sarika patch up their differences.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 41 - April 29, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: In today's full episode 41 of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan 2019, Happu notices that his children have developed a bad temper. Amma blames Rajesh for their condition, which infuriates the latter. Helpless, Happu pretends to support Amma and Rajesh's contrasting views to restore balance in the house.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 42 - April 30, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: In today's full episode 42 of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan 2019, Amma and Rajesh place a bet, which requires them to prove the other to be an angrier person. They try to instigate each other, but they both don't budge. Rajjo later blackmails Happu to make Amma angry and suggests him a plan.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 43 - May 01, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: In today's full episode 43 of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan 2019, Amma and Rajesh try to make each other angry to win a bet, but nobody gives in. Later, on reaching home, Happu pretends to lash out at his family as he has been advised to control the women in his house.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 44 - May 02, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: In today's full episode 44 of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan 2019, Amma orders Happu to make Rajesh angry. Rajesh thereafter blackmails Happu to make Amma angry. Helplessly trapped, Happu takes a few medicines, which causes laughter, from a doctor to secretly feed it to Amma and Rajesh.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 45 - May 03, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: In today's full episode 45 of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan 2019, Kat’s ploy to ascertain Kamlesh’s sincerity backfires. Happu manages to feed the ‘laddus’ laced with laughter medicine to Amma and Rajesh. The commissioner arrives at Happu’s residence to meet Amma.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 46 - May 06, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: In today's full episode 46 of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan 2019, the commissioner suspends Happu when Amma and Rajesh laugh at his woes. Kat and Kamlesh apologise to each other and want Malaika to join them for an outing. Amma gives Rajesh the responsibility to arrange the mangoes for the pickle.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 47 - May 07, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: In today’s full episode 47 of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan 2019, Rajesh and Beni get caught stealing raw mangoes from Mr. Awasthi’s tree to make pickle. Catering to Amma’s demands frustrates Rajesh. Happu makes a futile attempt to pacify her.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 48 - May 08, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: In today's full episode 48 of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan 2019, Rajesh is upset with Amma's recent behaviour towards her. On her mother's suggestion, she decides to seek the priest's help in order to improve her situation. Later, the priest successfully manipulates Amma into agreeing to serve Rajesh.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 49 - May 09, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: In today’s full episode 49 of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan 2019, Rajesh rejoices at successfully manipulating Amma. Amma unwillingly caters to Rajesh’s wishes. Mr. Awasthi catches Amma stealing mangoes from his plantation. Happu is curious to learn the reason for Amma’s changed behaviour towards Rajesh.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 50 - May 10, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: In today’s full episode 50 of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan 2019, Happu asks Amma the reason for her changed behaviour towards Rajesh. Amma continues to serve Rajesh as per the priest’s command. Witnessing Amma’s love for her, Rajesh puts an end to the charade. Happu finally learns about Rajesh’s ploy.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 51 - May 13, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: In today's full episode 51 of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan 2019, Hrithik cribs about being served the same vegetarian food every day. Hearing this, Amma declares that only vegetarian food will be prepared the entire month. The family finds it difficult to forgo non-vegetarian food for another 10 days.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 52 - May 14, 2019 - Full Episode
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, a man delivers a chicken to Happu's home. Assuming Happu ordered for the chicken, Rajesh accepts the delivery and hands it over to Beni. Beni then prepares a delicious non-vegetarian meal.

videos.title: Amma worries for the lost rooster named Babloo - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh happily feeds the chicken dish prepared by Beni to Happu. Amma worries for the lost rooster named Babloo that Adveer had sent for her. Happu and Rajesh try to conceal the truth about what happened to Babloo from Amma.

videos.title: Malaika investigates the matter of Babloo’s disappearance-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Malaika is suspicious of Beni having a hand in Babloo’s disappearance. She shares her suspicion with Amma. Amma calls Happu and accuses Beni of allegedly consuming Babloo.

videos.title: Malaika remains suspicious of Beni-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Babloo’s disappearance continues to worry Amma. Happu buys another rooster and has Beni pass it off as Babloo to Amma. Malaika remains suspicious of Beni.

videos.title: Amma discovers what really happened with Babloo-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma discovers what really happened with Babloo. She chides the culprits for lying to her and consuming Babloo. The next morning, Amma praises Happu for helping out with the household chores.

videos.title: Rajesh decides to seek Happu's help in the household chores-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, on Karishma's insistence, Rajesh decides to seek Happu's help in the household chores and orders him to buy groceries on his way home. On the other hand, Amma's friend, Nargis, tells Amma to not let Happu dance to Rajesh's tunes.

videos.title: Malaika topples Kamlesh’s ladder-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Chamchi sees Happu massaging Rajesh’s back and informs Amma about it. Malaika topples Kamlesh’s ladder for arguing with her. The doctor breaks the news of Kamlesh sustaining grievous injuries in the fall.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - May 23, 2019
videos.overview: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan is a Hindi comedy drama serial, starring Yogesh Tripathi, Himani Shivpuri and Aryan Prajapati. The show revolves around Happu Singh, a family man, who works very hard as a police constable to provide for his family. However, all his hard work, keeps going in vain as difficulties refuse to leave his life, generating a comedy of errors.

videos.title: Kamlesh’s pretends to be injured-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, seeing Kat tending to Kamlesh, Malaika gets irritated. Hrithik and Chamchi escalate the brewing situation between Amma and Rajesh. Meanwhile, Malaika discovers Kamlesh’s pretence of being injured. Amma and Rajesh resolve their misunderstandings.

videos.title: Pappi asks Rajesh to audition for his next singing project-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Beni’s friend Pappi, a music composer, becomes impressed with Rajesh's singing prowess. While Kat organises a blood donation camp, Rajesh agrees to audition for Pappi’s next project, which gives rise to Amma’s competitive spirit.

videos.title: Amma gloats about her singing talent-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh pester Happu with complaints about each other. Happu curses Beni for introducing Pappi to his household. At dinnertime, Amma gives a glimpse of her singing talent and gloats about it.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh refuse to cook to practise singing-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh start singing to outdo each other. A disguised Kamlesh arrives at the camp to donate blood. Amma and Rajesh refuse to cook to practise singing. A disgruntled Happu prepares to cook with Beni’s help.

videos.title: Rajesh and Amma audition for Pappi’s project-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Malaika doubts Beni’s intention for donating blood. Kamlesh once again arrives at the camp to donate blood in a different disguise. Happu’s woes multiply. Rajesh and Amma audition for Pappi’s project.

videos.title: Happu tries dissuading Amma from singing-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik cleverly manipulates the priest into donating blood. On Rajesh's demand, Happu tries dissuading Amma from singing so that Rajesh can follow her dream of becoming a singer. However, Amma is determined to defeat Rajesh.

videos.title: Pappi makes his decision-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Pappi selects Rajesh for his next project. Rajesh convinces him to let Amma sing as well. Later, Amma and Rajesh enthral everyone with their melodious performance.

videos.title: Rajesh learns about Amma’s sister Chatori - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh learns that Amma’s sister Chatori had eloped with another man named Prakash before her wedding. After all these years, a vengeful Amma asks Happu to locate Prakash. Meanwhile, Rajesh discovers that Prakash is her uncle.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - June 05, 2019
videos.overview: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan is a Hindi comedy drama serial, starring Yogesh Tripathi, Himani Shivpuri and Aryan Prajapati. The show revolves around Happu Singh, a family man, who works very hard as a police constable to provide for his family. However, all his hard work, keeps going in vain as difficulties refuse to leave his life, generating a comedy of errors.

videos.title: Happu and Beni plan to prevent Prakash from meeting Amma-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, on Amma’s request, the commissioner agrees to find Prakash. Prakash decides to visit India to settle things with Chatori’s sister. Happu and Beni plan to kidnap Prakash to prevent him from meeting Amma. Amma learns the truth.

videos.title: Happu and Beni kidnap Prakash - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu and Beni lure Prakash away from the railway station under false premises and keep him tied up in Beni’s house. Rajesh shares her worry about Prakash’s disappearance with Happu. Amma prepares for Prakash’s arrival.

videos.title: Amma forgives Prakash - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh calls Happu and accuses Amma of having kidnapped Prakash. Rajesh and Amma find a drunk Prakash in Beni’s house. After speaking with Chatori and finding her happy in her life, Amma forgives Prakash.

videos.title: Amma sees Happu and Rajesh romancing each other - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma witnesses Rajesh and Happu romancing each other. Nargis tells Amma that Happu may become a henpecked husband if he spends a lot of time with Rajesh. Kamlesh asks Kat to play the part of a heroine opposite him in a film.

videos.title: Amma joins Happu and Rajesh on their outing - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, while Rajesh wants to go out with Happu, Amma schemes to keep the couple apart. Much to Rajesh’s disappointment, Happu invites Amma along with them to keep peace. Meanwhile, Kamlesh and Kat rehearse the dialogues from their film.

videos.title: Happu and Rajesh, and Amma and Nargis to go for a movie - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh declines going for a movie if Amma joins them. Happu makes an excuse of being sick to dissuade Amma from accompanying them. Nargis and Amma plan to watch the movie together.

videos.title: Amma catches Happu and Rajesh at the movie theatre-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Nargis see Rajesh and Happu in the movie theatre. To keep Happu and Rajesh apart, Amma orders Happu to sleep in her room for the night. Happu blames Beni for his woes, so Beni gives him a solution for his problem.

videos.title: Amma pretends to sleepwalk to keep Happu and Rajesh apart-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma pretends to be drunk to fool Happu. Happu sneaks into his room to spend quality time with Rajesh. Pretending to sleepwalk, Amma succeeds in keeping the couple apart.

videos.title: Amma mends her ways - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma sees the error in her ways. While leaving the temple, a man warns Rajesh that she will soon be possessed by a witch who will disrupt her life. Though Rajesh doesn’t take the warning seriously, some unforeseen accidents may convince her otherwise.

videos.title: Rajesh agrees to participate in a play-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, on being hit by a wave of dizziness, Rajesh spoils the ‘rangoli’ made by Chamchi. In a dramatic fashion, Dr Chanchal diagnoses Rajesh of having low haemoglobin. Beni requests Rajesh to reprise the role of a witch in a play with his fellow lawyers.

videos.title: Rajesh’s dialogue rehearsals scare Happu-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gets scared hearing Rajesh rehearse the play’s scary dialogues. Further incidents make Happu suspect Rajesh of being a witch.

videos.title: Happu shares his suspicions about Rajesh with Amma-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu shares his suspicions about Rajesh with Amma. Amma sees Rajesh practicing for the play with Beni and thinks that a possessed Rajesh is attacking him. She calls Happu and asks him to bring a tantric capable of driving any supernatural power away.

videos.title: Happu lives in growing fear of Rajesh and Beni being possessed-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik and Chamchi play a prank on Happu that makes him believe they have turned into zombies. Rajesh takes her pet to the kitchen and prepares chicken, but Amma and Happu think otherwise. Later, Beni gets Happu drunk and then pretends to be a vampire.

videos.title: Happu runs to the police station in fear of Rajesh-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu, who is not in his uniform, runs to the police station in fear of Rajesh. The commissioner tells him to go home and wear his uniform or he will be suspended. Elsewhere, Nargis and Amma visit a tantric and tell him about Rajesh being possessed.

videos.title: Everybody learns about Rajesh’s participation in the play-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, on Beni’s instructions, Rajesh practises the mannerisms of a witch at midnight for the play. It is to this scene that Amma, Nargis and Happu arrive with the "tantric'. Later, Beni and Rajesh clear up everyone’s confusion.

videos.title: Happu is frustrated with Amma and Rajesh's bickering-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma criticizes Rajesh's cooking and the two start bickering, frustrating Happu. He rants about it to Beni and waits for Beni to cook for him. When Rajesh asks him to come back home, he sends her away.

videos.title: Happu refuses to eat or drink anything - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma blames Rajesh for not bringing Happu back home and goes herself to persuade him. There, she slaps Beni for not encouraging Happu to go home. On returning, Happu refuses to eat or drink anything.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh getting along surprises Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh resolve their differences and promise to never fight with each other again. Their camaraderie comes as a surprise to Happu and Beni.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh’s friendship irks Happu-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gets in trouble with Amma and Rajesh. Irked with their new-found friendship, Happu asks Beni for a way to create differences between them.

videos.title: Happu decides to implement the ‘Divide and Rule’ strategy-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu decides to use the strategy of ‘Divide and Rule’ to create a rift between Amma and Rajesh. The success of this strategy pleases Happu. However, he is forced to confess to his schemes when Amma and Rajesh threaten to leave the house.

videos.title: Rajesh hits a man with Karishma’s car - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Karishma parks her car in the lane near Happu’s house and gives the keys to Rajesh before her Kerala trip. Rajesh hits a man on the way to buy groceries with Karishma’s car. An astrologer tells Beni to walk on burning coals to win Vimlesh’s love.

videos.title: Happu learns that Rajesh hit the commissioner with Karishma’s car - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma gets nervous thinking about the repercussions of the accident Rajesh caused. The commissioner orders Happu to find the culprit who had hit him with a car. Happu is left shocked on learning that Rajesh is the culprit.

videos.title: Amma tries to mollify the commissioner’s ire towards his culprits-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner’s arrival at their home makes Rajesh nervous. Amma tries to mollify the commissioner’s ire towards his culprits. Beni prepares to walk on burning coals as per the astrologer’s suggestion.

videos.title: Rajesh once again hits the commissioner with Karishma’s car - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner learns that the car which hit him is parked in Happu’s neighbourhood and leaves a message with Rajesh for Happu to nab the culprit. On the way to hide the car in the jungle, Amma and Rajesh once again hit the commissioner.

videos.title: The commissioner forgives Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh fear the repercussions of hitting the commissioner twice with the car. The entire matter unravels in front of the commissioner on Karishma’s arrival and he decides to forgive Rajesh.

videos.title: Rajesh burns Amma’s favourite saree - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh wishes to wear Amma’s favourite saree to her friend Seema’s wedding. While giving the saree to Rajesh, Amma tells her to not let any damage come to it. However, a distracted Rajesh burns the saree while ironing it.

videos.title: Kamlesh gets Amma’s saree repaired - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh fears telling Amma that she had burnt her favourite saree. Much to Rajesh’s relief, Kamlesh gets the saree repaired. Meanwhile, the commissioner orders Happu to apprehend the thief who stole his chain.

videos.title: Kamlesh loses Amma’s saree - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Kamlesh loses Amma’s saree. When Amma asks for her saree back, Rajesh lies to distract her. Beni suggests a way for Happu and Rajesh to save themselves from Amma’s anger.

videos.title: Helping Rajesh lands Beni in trouble - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Beni steals Rajesh’s necklace which Amma is wearing, but gets caught by the commissioner. To help Rajesh, Hrithik stops the laundryman from coming to their house. Assuming Beni to be the real thief, the commissioner gets Happu to beat him up.

videos.title: Rajesh confesses to having burnt Amma’s saree - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Malaika learns that Kat and Kamlesh had left Amma’s saree in the movie theatre. In the police station, Beni tells the commissioner why he stole the necklace. Later, Rajesh confesses before Amma to having burnt her saree.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh enter into a poetic war - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Beni listens to Amma recite a poetry and falsely praises her. Amma discredits Rajesh’s understanding of the poetry and Rajesh complaints about her to Happu. Later, Amma and Rajesh argue with each other through the use of poetry.

videos.title: Happu tries his hand at poetry - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Happu tries his hand at poetry but fails to impress the commissioner. Beni promises to introduce Amma and Rajesh to his friend who is a publisher. The idea of getting their poetries published in a book grips Amma and Rajesh, while it worries Happu.

videos.title: Amma finds Pitaji’s diary - Happu ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the poetic war between Amma and Rajesh continues. Kat and Kamlesh’s antics irritate Malaika. Sorting through some old items, Amma and Happu find Pitaji’s diary. The contents of it come as a surprise to Amma.

videos.title: Will Amma take Beni’s hint? - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh ask Beni to invite his publisher friend for a ‘mushaira’ session, where they both vow to outdo each other. Beni tries to discourage Amma’s poetic aspirations.

videos.title: The ‘mushaira’ begins - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh refuse to give up on the idea of getting their poems published. Beni welcomes his publisher friend Hararat Bukhari to the ‘mushaira’, and the session begins with Chamchi reciting her poetry, followed by Hrithik and Malaika.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh’s dreams crash - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh fail to impress Hararat Bukhari with their poetries. Later in the night, Happu tries to spend some quality time with Rajesh, but is interrupted by his kids. During a ‘puja’, Amma hints at Rajesh being blessed with the boon of motherhood.

videos.title: Is Rajesh pregnant? - Happu ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh calls Happu at work and tells him that she is pregnant. She tries to hide the news from Amma, but Amma learns the truth from Chamchi and chides the couple for adding to their already large brood.

videos.title: Amma wins an exciting prize - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, a priest visits Amma and foretells that she will go abroad soon. She is overjoyed, but Rajesh bursts her bubble and what Amma says next hurts her. Later, Amma wins a contest and receives an exciting prize.

videos.title: Rajesh’s ultimatum to Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma is excited for her upcoming London trip and promises to return with lots of gifts for all. Rajesh pesters Happu to send her for a trip abroad as well. Fed up with Amma’s taunts, she gives an ultimatum to Happu.

videos.title: Happu plans a party - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh tells Amma that she will also be going to London. They ask Kamlesh and Kat to teach them English. Happu and Beni plan a get-together with their friends in their absence. Amma tells Happu to pay INR 20,000 as taxes for her travel and stay.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh learn Western etiquettes - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Kamlesh teaches English to Amma and Rajesh. Imagining Kamlesh to be a British official named Colonel Peterson, Malaika thrashes him. Kat teaches Amma and Rajesh to eat food with knives and forks. Later, they flaunt their western outfits.

videos.title: Amma’s dreams crash - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh and Amma pack for their London trip. The trip gets cancelled because of a news delivered by Nargis. Soon after, Happu’s friends arrive for the party, which lands him in trouble.

videos.title: Happu and Beni’s friendship troubles Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, while Happu is at Beni’s house, everyone back home awaits him for dinner. Later, an angry Rajesh taunts Beni and Happu’s friendship. Undaunted, Happu lies to Rajesh and visits Beni again at night.

videos.title: Amma’s suggestion - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, when Rajesh calls Happu, he lies to her about being busy with an important case. Rajesh discovers Happu’s lie which leads to an argument between the two. Amma suggests Rajesh to become Happu’s friend so he stops visiting Beni for company.

videos.title: Rajesh becomes Happu’s friend - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh promises Happu that she will be a good friend to him. She and Happu join Beni for some drinks, but they leave when Beni and Happu get into an argument. The next morning, Rajesh’s brazen and overfriendly behaviour before the family disturbs Happu.

videos.title: Rajesh breaks Happu and Beni's bond - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu fights with Beni on Rajesh's instigation. Beni gets upset when he sees Happu having drinks with Rajesh at night. Happu overhears Amma and Rajesh's conversation and learns that they had deliberately created a rift between him and Beni.

videos.title: Rajesh’s plan backfires - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu pacifies Beni and tells him about Amma and Rajesh’s ploy. To teach Rajesh a lesson, Happu teases her friend Karishma. Later, an upset Rajesh complains about Happu to Amma.

videos.title: Rajesh teaches Happu a lesson - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh overhears Beni and Happu’s conversation. Her ploy to get back at Happu endangers his job. Happu apologises to Rajesh for his mistake and promises to spend more time with family.

videos.title: Happu’s uncle tells him a secret - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma stops Rajesh from giving away an old basket. Happu’s uncle from Agra pays him a visit at the police station and tells him a secret. Meanwhile, Kamlesh tells Amma to become a brand ambassador of an NGO supporting orphans.

videos.title: Happu devastated - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Chamchi comes across a letter which makes her think she is an orphan. Beni consoles Happu who is upset after learning about being an orphan. Happu and Rajesh’s loving behaviour towards her leaves Amma in doubt.

videos.title: Happu is depressed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik and Ranbir take advantage of a vulnerable Chamchi. Beni gives a bottle of alcohol to Happu to alleviate his sorrows. The commissioner sympathises with Happu and shares his own unfortunate story. Happu wishes to meet his biological parents.

videos.title: Amma reveals a secret - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, under a misconception, Happu assumes Tiwari, a vegetable seller, to be his biological father. Malaika teaches Hrithik and Ranbir a lesson. Later, Amma tells Happu the secret about the basket.

videos.title: Happu’s family welcomes Gunjan - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner agrees to let his niece, Gunjan, stay with Happu’s family to experience the joys of family life. When Gunjan arrives, Amma and Rajesh learn why she is averse to marriage. During dinner, Rajesh and Amma end up quarrelling before Gunjan.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh quarrel before Gunjan - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu advises Amma and Rajesh to not quarrel before Gunjan. The next day, Amma and Rajesh pretend to be caring towards each other. Later, Gunjan gets happy when she sees them quarrelling and tells Happu about it.

videos.title: Happu sings false praises of his family - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Beni and Happu end up fighting when the former complains about the latter’s children. Tired of Amma and Rajesh’s conflicts, Happu once again tries to reason with them. Later, he sings false praises of his family before Gunjan.

videos.title: Gunjan agrees to get married - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner tells Happu that Gunjan has refused to marry upon witnessing the fights at his home. Later, Gunjan changes her mind on seeing Amma and Rajesh’s loving behaviour. Moreover, Happu and Beni resolve their differences.

videos.title: Happu gets frightened on seeing ghosts - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu teases Rajesh for getting scared of a mouse. To teach Happu a lesson, the kids and Kamlesh come up with a plan. At night, the light goes out and Happu gets frightened on seeing the ghosts.

videos.title: Amma’s suggestion to Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh fights with Happu for not giving time to the family. Amma gives a suggestion to Happu. Kamlesh tells Happu that due to Kat’s low attendance, he has been called to the college. Being busy with work, Happu refuses to go to the college.

videos.title: Happu’s leave request denied - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu’s kids complain about him not spending time with the family. The commissioner turns down Happu’s leave request. Amma comes up with an idea to get Happu some time off from work.

videos.title: Happu gets suspended - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, due to Amma and Rajesh, the commissioner suspends Happu from duty for seven days. Happu plays with his kids and spends some quality time with Rajesh. Happu openly romancing Rajesh irks Amma.

videos.title: Happu irritates everyone - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, on Beni’s suggestion, Happu narrates a story to his children to mingle with them. Happu gets angry when the children fall asleep. Irritated with Happu’s antics, everyone complaints about him to Amma.

videos.title: The commissioner remains stubborn - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh request the commissioner to cancel Happu’s suspension, but he refuses to budge. With Hrithik’s idea, everyone teaches Happu a lesson. Later, the commissioner suspends Happu for one more week.

videos.title: Rajesh’s demand for a maid - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh tells Happu to find a maid for her to help in the household chores. Happu asks Beni and Manohar to help him find one. When Happu returns home without a maid, he is faced with everyone’s ire.

videos.title: Rajesh gets a maid - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh hires a maid named Dimple to help her around the house. Dimple impresses everyone with her cooking. Rajesh suggests Karishma to hire a maid as well. A homeless Kamlesh finds shelter at Beni’s house.

videos.title: Dimple threatens Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Dimple considers Kamlesh to be a servant when she sees him washing clothes at Beni’s house. The next morning, Happu and Rajesh chide Dimple for waking up late. Further, Dimple threatens to send Happu to jail on charges of molestation.

videos.title: Dimple’s increasing demands - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, under Dimple’s threats, Happu, Amma and Rajesh take care of the household chores. Beni manipulates Kamlesh into doing errands for him. Kamlesh mocks Happu who is washing clothes. Dimple’s increasing demands trouble everyone.

videos.title: A shocking revelation - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu shares his woes with Beni. Later, Beni confronts Dimple and tries to scare her with his tactics. Soon after, Happu’s friend arrives and reveals that Dimple is his wife and he did everything to take revenge from Happu.

videos.title: Hrithik lies to the Principal - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik and Ranbir decide to teach Kamlesh a lesson for taunting them. Later, Hrithik lies to his school Principal about Happu meeting with an accident to escape punishment. The Principal meets Happu and tells him about Hrithik’s lie.

videos.title: What happened to Hrithik? - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, hearing the Principal’s complaints against Hrithik, Happu and Rajesh decide to give him a good hiding. Rajesh gets worried when Hrithik and Ranbir do not return from school. Ranbir brings Hrithik home and gives a bad news to the family concerning him.

videos.title: Hrithik’s memory loss saddens everyone - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu blames Kamlesh for Hrithik’s memory loss and thrashes him. Despite the doctor’s efforts, Hrithik is unable to gain his memory back and his condition worries everyone in the family. Amma sings a lullaby for Hrithik in the hope that he recovers.

videos.title: Chamchi becomes suspicious of Hrithik - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma’s fails to help Hrithik get his memory back. Happu starts blaming himself for Hrithik’s condition. Meanwhile, Chamchi suspects that Hrithik is pretending to have lost his memory and vows to prove it.

videos.title: Hrithik’s lie exposed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, to bring back Hrithik's memory, Rajesh gives an advice to Happu. In order to cure Hrithik, the commissioner agrees to get slapped by Happu. Chamchi overhears Hrithik and Ranbir’s conversation and exposes Hrithik's pretence.

videos.title: The priest's prediction - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Fakirchand complains to Happu that Hrithik has beaten his son Bansuri. Happu punishes Hrithik, but Hrithik feels that Happu has done wrong by punishing him. The priest makes a prediction about Amma, which makes her very happy.

videos.title: Did Amma kill Kamlesh? - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu advises Rajesh and Amma to be alert of the thieves. Amma mistakes Kamlesh to be a thief and attacks him. Amma worries that she may have killed Kamlesh when the latter pretends to die.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh hide Kamlesh’s corpse - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma gets terrified on thinking about getting punished for killing Kamlesh. Further, Rajesh and Amma hide Kamlesh's corpse in the cupboard. Later, Happu asks Amma about Babuji's walking stick, and Amma tells him that it is kept in the cupboard.

videos.title: Happu to save Amma from punishment - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma confesses to killing Kamlesh before Happu, and he promises to save her from punishment. Kamlesh’s father arrives at Happu’s house looking for Kamlesh. Whereas, the commissioner decides to stay at Happu's house.

videos.title: Amma saved from going to jail - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, a hungry Kamlesh goes into the kitchen but Amma mistakes him for a ghost and gets scared. Meanwhile, Kamlesh’s father threatens Happu. Happu’s family tries to dispose of Kamlesh’s body. To save his life, Kamlesh puts an end to his pretence.

videos.title: Happu ends up hurting Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma begins to feel that Happu does not love her. Nargis tells Amma of a way through which she could test the depth of Happu’s love. Whereas, Rajesh chides Happu for hurting Amma.

videos.title: Amma gets herself kidnapped - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, in need of money, Beni pretends to kidnap Amma on her request. Then, he calls Happu and asks for ransom. The news of Amma’s kidnapping leaves everyone worried.

videos.title: Beni threatens Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner gives an advice to Happu. Beni threatens to kill Amma when Happu fails to pay him the ransom. Kamlesh clicks pictures of everyone in the house on Amma’s request and gets scared on seeing one of the pictures.

videos.title: Beni and Kamlesh get jailed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu arrives at the place suggested by Beni with the ransom. Malaika catches Kamlesh and Beni red-handed. Since Amma has lost her voice, she is unable to reveal the truth to the family members. Happu locks Beni and Kamlesh in jail and thrashes them.

videos.title: The truth finally comes out - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the doctor informs that Amma has lost her voice permanently. An incident restores Amma’s voice and she confesses to getting herself kidnapped. A guilty Happu profusely apologises to Beni and helps him financially.

videos.title: Malaika instigates Kat against Kamlesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Malaika complains to Rajesh that Kamlesh is a bad influence on Kat. She then comes up with an idea to keep Kat away from Kamlesh. Later, she instigates Kat against Kamlesh, and Kat gets angry at him.

videos.title: Amma ousts Kamlesh from the house - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Chamchi tells Amma that Kamlesh’s father had badmouthed Kat before them. On Amma’s behest, Malaika kicks Kamlesh out of the house. Later, when Kamlesh tries to sneak in through the bedroom window, Kat pushes him from the ladder on Malaika’s instigation.

videos.title: Rajesh confesses the truth - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh tells Happu why she orchestrated the events that led to a fight between Kat and Kamlesh. Kat tells Happu that she aspires to be an air hostess and not a doctor. Rajesh confesses her wrongdoings before Kat.

videos.title: Happu’s family demands for gifts - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu’s family demands presents from him on ‘Dussehra’. Gulab Singh, an acquaintance of the commissioner, arrives at the police station to file a complaint for his missing dog. Whereas, Kat and Kamlesh rehearse for a play.

videos.title: Gulab Singh gets attracted to Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Gulab Singh visits Beni’s house and leers at Rajesh. He is left stunned on learning that Rajesh is Happu’s wife. Happu gets angry when he hears Rajesh praising Gulab Singh. The next day, Gulab Singh brings presents for everyone in Happu’s family.

videos.title: Gulab Singh gives a love letter to Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh gets Gulab Singh’s love letter along with his gift, which makes Happu angry. Meanwhile, the priest tells Amma that she will face something catastrophic in her life. Later, Gulab Singh plots to create suspicion in Rajesh’s mind against Happu.

videos.title: Gulab Singh accepts Malaika’s challenge - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, by telling Rajesh about Gulab Singh’s ploy, he clarifies her misunderstanding. On Malaika’s provocation, Gulab Singh agrees to fight a boxing match with Happu. Happu fears losing at Gulab Singh’s hands but Malaika assures him that she will train him.

videos.title: The boxing match begins - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Malaika wakes Happu early in the morning to make him exercise. Happu’s family tries to motivate him to win the match. Later, the boxing match between Happu and Gulab Singh begins.

videos.title: Happu defeats Gulab Singh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Gulab Singh's beating leaves Happu breathless. With his family’s encouragement, Happu succeeds in defeating Gulab Singh. Further, Happu gets trapped in the fight between Amma and Rajesh over their rights at home.

videos.title: Amma gets the house’s ownership - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu stops Rajesh from leaving the house. The next day, Beni reads Pitaji’s will and declares that Amma is the rightful owner of the house. Later, Beni reveals a secret about the will to Happu and Rajesh overhears their conversation.

videos.title: Happu’s house gets divided - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh is declared the owner of the house as per Pitaji’s new will, but Amma refuses to accept it. Beni suggests that the house be divided to solve Amma and Rajesh’s conflict. Happu and the children follow through on Beni’s suggestion.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh’s feud continues - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, moved by the children’s plight, Amma and Rajesh allow them to use their sections of the house. Later, Happu tries to reason with Amma and Rajesh but they refuse to end their feud.

videos.title: Happu to keep a fast for Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, due to the recent upheavals, Happu vents his anger on the family members. He also gets into an argument with Beni when the latter calls Amma selfish. Later, with Beni’s suggestion, he unites the family and decides to keep a fast for Rajesh.

videos.title: Rajesh finds Amma’s mother-in-law’s letters - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma taunts Rajesh for not being an obedient daughter-in-law. Further, Rajesh finds letters written by Amma's mother-in-law Savitri, in which she has criticised Amma. Amma tells Rajesh to prepare for a ‘puja’ for her mother-in-law's death anniversary.

videos.title: Rajesh acts like Amma’s mother-in-law - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, during the ‘puja’, Rajesh starts speaking like Amma's mother-in-law, Savitri. Amma feels that Savitri’s soul has possessed Rajesh and becomes scared of her. Meanwhile, Kat tries a trick to change Malaika's angry nature.

videos.title: Amma learns about Rajesh’s pretence - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh orders Amma to prepare breakfast. Kamlesh is left surprised by Malaika's generosity. Pitaji tells Amma a secret related to Savitri's letters. When Amma realises that Rajesh is pretending to be possessed, she resolves to teach her a lesson.

videos.title: Amma’s false story - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma’s false story scares Rajesh. She tells Happu that Amma is a murderer and is about to kill her. To save themselves, Happu and Rajesh try to escape from the house with their children.

videos.title: Happu fasts for Rajesh on ‘Karwa Chauth’ - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma taunts Happu for keeping the ‘Karwa Chauth’ fast for Rajesh. Everyone celebrates ‘Karwa Chauth’ together. Hrithik insists on getting firecrackers for ‘Diwali’. Later, Happu and Rajesh bicker over their jobs and Kamlesh shares a good news with Kat.

videos.title: Happu’s hurtful words upset Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu criticises the breakfast prepared by Rajesh. In a fit of rage, he says that he regrets marrying her. The commissioner reprimands Happu before Beni. Kamlesh’s uncle, Bittu offers to hire Kat as an air hostess for his airline.

videos.title: Rajesh becomes an inspector - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner exposes Happu’s lies before Amma and Rajesh. Later, he suspends Happu and gives his job to Rajesh to teach him a lesson. Over a few drinks, Happu shares his woes with Beni, and gets irritated when Kamlesh and Kat interrupt him.

videos.title: Happu struggles with the household chores - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu blames Rajesh for his woes. The next morning, Amma tells Happu to takeover Rajesh’s household duties. When Happu calls Rajesh for assistance, she dismisses him and tells him to manage on his own. Beni mocks Happu when he sees him washing clothes.

videos.title: KD Pathak threatens Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gets lunch for Rajesh at the police station. The next morning, a smuggler named KD Pathak visits Rajesh and tells her to release the trucks she had seized. He threatens her with dire consequences when she refuses to relent.

videos.title: KD Pathak kidnaps Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, KD Pathak gets Happu kidnapped to force Rajesh into doing his bidding. Along with the commissioner and Manohar, Rajesh arrests KD Pathak and frees Happu. After patching up their differences, Rajesh and Happu celebrate ‘Diwali’ with their family.

videos.title: Rajesh’s behaviour worries Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh gets embarrassed before Amma and the kids due to Happu. Rajesh’s disinterest in him bothers Happu and he confides in Amma. Meanwhile, Kamlesh overhears Malaika and Kat’s conversation and decides to use the knowledge to impress the latter.

videos.title: Happu poses as his twin Pappu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma tells Happu to pose as his fictional twin brother Pappu to impress Rajesh. The next morning, Happu tells Rajesh that in his absence, Pappu will handle his household chores. Happu undergoes a makeover and arrives at the house as Pappu.

videos.title: Rajesh impressed with Pappu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh becomes impressed with Pappu. Kamlesh’s new look displeases Kat. Rajesh praises Pappu in front of Happu, making the latter angry. Further, Rajesh and the children rejoice at their plan to fool Happu.

videos.title: Rajesh’s infidelity saddens Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, seeing Rajesh’s growing attachment towards Pappu, Happu thinks that she doesn’t love him at all. Meanwhile, Kat doesn’t like Kamlesh’s new look. Believing Rajesh to be unfaithful towards him, Happu gets sad.

videos.title: Happu tests Rajesh’s love - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma tells Happu to test Rajesh’s love. Further, Rajesh agrees to elope with Pappu and her children help her with the same. Eventually, Happu reveals the truth about Pappu to everyone.

videos.title: Rajesh’s cousin to pay her a visit - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh is unhappy with the news of Adveer’s impending visit to Kanpur. Later, she learns about the arrival of her cousin, Laila. Beni decides to become a partner in Kat and Kamlesh’s new business. Rajesh plots to stop Adveer from coming to Kanpur.

videos.title: Amma sees Happu in Laila’s embrace - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu brings Laila home. To get some tea, Laila goes to the kitchen at night and takes Happu along. Amma sees Laila hugging Happu and misunderstands the situation. The next day, Amma inaugurates Beni, Kat and Kamlesh's new hotel.

videos.title: Kat tells Rajesh about Laila's behaviour - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma tells Laila to maintain distance from Happu. The commissioner tells Happu his secret. Later, Happu takes Laila to Beni's restaurant for dinner. Laila's behaviour surprises Kat and she tells Rajesh the whole truth.

videos.title: Laila, the theif - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh catches Happu red-handed. After Laila leaves the house, the family members learn about the theft and the real Laila makes an entry. Happu narrates the incident to Beni. Later, a nightmare leaves Rajesh scared.

videos.title: Rajesh tells Amma about her nightmare - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma hides a truth about her past from Happu. Rajesh tells Amma about her nightmare. At night, a drunk Happu falls over a pile of garbage. Later, the commissioner suspends Happu indefinitely.

videos.title: Happu is left upset after losing his job - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu’s family feel embarrassed on seeing a news about him on TV. Rajesh gets terrified on spotting a moneylender outside the house. Happu goes to Beni’s house and drowns his sorrows in alcohol. His condition leaves Amma and Rajesh worried.

videos.title: Amma resumes her old job - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi think of a way to get Happu his job back. Rajesh looks for a job to cover the household expenses. Amma resumes her former profession to take care of the family, and Beni learns the truth about it.

videos.title: Happu learns the truth about Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Ranbir, Hrithik and Chamchi curse the commissioner at the police station. The commissioner agrees to hire Happu back if he succeeds in nabbing a pickpocket. Happu agrees to the commissioner’s condition but gets shocked on learning the pickpocket’s name.

videos.title: Rajesh ousts Happu from the house - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu is unable to arrest Amma. The commissioner revokes Happu’s suspension. Later, Rajesh ousts Happu from the house after a fight. Beni refuses to accommodate Happu at his house due to Amma’s threat.

videos.title: Rajesh invites the commissioner for a party - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu starts staying in a tent outside the house. Rajesh speaks about the delicious food she had cooked to make him jealous. Later, she invites the commissioner for her faux birthday party and tells him to not get Happu along.

videos.title: Happu estranged from his family - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gets upset on seeing everyone enjoying themselves at Rajesh’s faux birthday party. Hiding from everyone, Amma gives ‘roti’ to Happu. The next day, Happu’s ill health worries Kamlesh.

videos.title: Happu and Rajesh resolve their differences - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu feigns illness to get back into the house, but gets caught by Rajesh. He badmouths Rajesh before Beni and Kamlesh, unaware that Rajesh is overhearing their conversation. Later, Rajesh and Happu patch up because of Amma.

videos.title: Happu buys a gold necklace for Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh demands a gold necklace from Happu. Happu gets INR 1.5 lakhs in a property case. Further, he employs a homeless Kamlesh as a security guard at his house. Later, he buys a gold necklace for Rajesh from the money he got.

videos.title: Happu gives the necklace to Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gives the necklace he bought for Rajesh to Amma. Due to this reason, Rajesh gets insulted before her friends and gets angry at Happu. Happu goes to sleep at Beni’s house at night and tells him the reason behind Rajesh’s anger.

videos.title: Happu promises to get a necklace for Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma gets happy on wearing the necklace and dances with Happu. To pacify Rajesh, Happu promises to get her a necklace like Amma’s. However, when the goldsmith’s artisan refuses to make another one, Happu comes up with an idea to fulfil his promise.

videos.title: Happu commits theft for Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Kamlesh and Pitaji see Happu stealing Amma’s necklace, which he later presents to Rajesh. Amma informs that her necklace was stolen. Rajesh discerns that Happu was the one who stole it. She flaunts it before Amma to make her jealous.

videos.title: Happu to steal the necklace once again - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Pitaji tells the name of the thief to Amma. Happu tells Amma the reason he stole the necklace. She tells him to steal it back from Rajesh. Happu decides to steal at night but unbeknownst to him, his kids lay out a trap for the thief.

videos.title: Happu and Rajesh reminisce about the past - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, unaware that the thief is Happu, the children beat him up. The next day, Happu sees a lipstick stain on his handkerchief and chides Rajesh for it. Rajesh reminisces about the past. Later, Happu regales Beni with the stories of his and Rajesh’s past.

videos.title: Happu and Rajesh’s plan to watch a movie fails - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu and Rajesh plan to go for a movie and Chamchi tells Amma about it. Due to Amma and the kids, Rajesh is unable to go to the movie theatre. Meanwhile, Happu, who is waiting for Rajesh, gets angry when she does not turn up.

videos.title: Happu tells Rajesh about Amma and the kids’ act - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu learns about the act staged by Amma and the kids. Inadvertently, he ends up telling Rajesh about the act as well. Later, Amma and the kids apologise to the couple and they get to spend some quality time together.

videos.title: Happu gets in trouble trying to romance Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the children watch the news of a theft incident on TV. Happu secretly comes to meet Rajesh to relive their memories. Mistaking him for a thief, Amma and the children beat him up. Regretting their mistake, they promise to not trouble the couple anymore.

videos.title: Rajesh and Happu spend quality time together - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma slips and gets injured. At Amma’s behest, the children do not alert Rajesh and Happu about her injury when they return from their outing. Eventually, Happu and Rajesh learn the truth and get emotional on seeing Amma and kids' love towards them.

videos.title: Hrithik’s report card infuriates Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gets angry on seeing Hrithik’s report card. He blames Rajesh for spoiling him. Rajesh agrees to help Happu reform Hrithik. Later, Pitaji wishes Amma on her birthday.

videos.title: Hrithik records a video of Amma dancing - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu scolds Hrithik who is playing cricket. Later, Amma sees Rajesh dancing at her birthday party and gives her an earful. At night, while Amma is dancing with Pitaji, Hrithik records the scene. The next day, he uses the video to blackmail Amma.

videos.title: Hrithik blackmails Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma chides Chamchi and slaps Beni on being blackmailed to do so by Hrithik. Rajesh calls Happu and tells him about Amma’s changed behaviour. Hrithik refuses to delete the video despite Amma’s request and continues to do as he pleases.

videos.title: Amma’s behaviour upsets Chamchi - Happu ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Chamchi gets upset with Amma’s changed behaviour towards her. Amma regrets her actions and apologises to Beni but also slaps him again. Later, she gets Hrithik’s favourite food prepared, which angers other family members.

videos.title: Rajesh puts forth a condition in front of Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik gets delighted as Amma beats Happu. Rajesh and Happu come to know that Hrithik is the one who has Amma's dance video and he is blackmailing her. Amma apologies to Rajesh who then puts forth a condition before Amma to forgive her.

videos.title: Amma finds a suitable groom for Kat - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, a priest predicts Kat’s future and advises Amma to get her married soon. The news saddens Kamlesh but he pretends to be happy before Kat. However, his pretence leaves Kat heartbroken. Further, Amma finds a suitable match for Kat.

videos.title: Rajesh selects a prospective groom for Kat - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh chooses a collector’s son as a match for Kat. She and Amma insist on getting Kat married to the boy of their choosing. Their squabble over the matter annoys Happu. Later, Kamlesh professes his feelings to Kat through the story of his novel.

videos.title: Kat’s question upsets Kamlesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh taunt each other during breakfast. The commissioner jokes with Happu at the police station. A question asked by Kat upsets Kamlesh and leaves him in tears. Later, he faints near Beni’s house.

videos.title: Prospective grooms come to meet Kat - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Kamlesh comes to Happu’s house to help with the chores. Collector Rajveer Singh and his son Bunty come to meet Kat. Seeing Bunty and Kat talking upsets Kamlesh. Before Bunty and his father could leave, the commissioner arrives with his son.

videos.title: Kat and Bittu’s alliance doesn’t get fixed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajveer and Bunty leave Happu’s house in a huff. Amma agrees to not fix Kat’s alliance with Bittu. The commissioner threatens Happu when he turns down the alliance with his son. Later, a court order leaves the commissioner shocked.

videos.title: Happu confides in Beni about his problem - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu confides in Beni about his health condition. Meanwhile, Karishma gives an idea to Rajesh to solve her problem. Later, Beni takes Happu to a hakim for treatment. Happu gets shocked on seeing Commissioner Resham Pal there as well.

videos.title: Rajesh tells Happu that she is pregnant - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the hakim gives some medicines to Happu for his condition. Later, Happu jumps with joy when Rajesh tells him that she is pregnant again. Beni senses something is fishy when Happu shares this news with him.

videos.title: Happu doubts Rajesh’s character - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma takes care of Rajesh. Meanwhile, Happu doubts Rajesh’s character as he feels she is carrying someone else’s child. Later, Amma and the children think of names for the baby. Their conversation saddens Happu.

videos.title: Happu and Beni get into a tussle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu questions Rajesh about her pregnancy. A conversation with Hrithik convinces Happu that Rajesh is pregnant with Beni’s child. While Happu and Beni get into a tussle, Amma prepares for Rajesh’s baby shower.

videos.title: Happu gets happy when the truth unfolds - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu pacifies Beni and shares his plight with him. During the baby shower, Happu tells Amma that he is not the father of Rajesh’s child. Later, he gets delighted when the truth unfolds.

videos.title: Happu buys a car - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
