videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, everyone blackens their faces to convince Happu to buy a car. Happu returns home and on learning that he has bought a car, everyone leaps with joy. Later, Malaika dislikes a dress gifted by Kamlesh to Kat.

videos.title: Happu’s love for his car - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu forbids Amma and Rajesh from taking the car to the market as he fears them causing damage to it. Karishma runs into Amma and Rajesh and the duo requests her to drop them to their home. Later, the family members get upset due to Happu.

videos.title: Happu’s car gets damaged - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh promises Beni that she will get him married to Vimlesh in the new year. After the new year celebrations, Happu’s kids and Kamlesh secretly take the car out for a drive. When the car gets a dent, they try to keep Happu from learning about it.

videos.title: Kamlesh suggests an idea - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Ranbir and Chamchi tell Rajesh about the damage to the car. A mechanic takes the car away for repair. Kamlesh suggests an idea to keep Happu in the dark about it. Kamlesh's uncle Kripal Singh files a missing complaint for his car at the police station.

videos.title: Happu’s car gets sold - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu learns that his car got damaged. Recalling a past instance, he forgives the kids. After the mechanic returns the car, Makwana buys it from Happu and sells it to another person. The person’s identity leaves Happu shocked.

videos.title: Happu’s childhood incident - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu beats Kamlesh on Malaika’s provocation. Karishma tells Rajesh about the antics of their friends’ philandering husbands, making Rajesh angry. Amma tells Chamchi about the incident when Happu had lost his memory.

videos.title: Rajesh becomes suspicious of Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, a woman tries to get close to Happu at the police station. Due to a misunderstanding, Rajesh suspects Happu and fights with him. While Happu clears her misunderstanding, Rajesh later finds a strand of woman’s hair on his sweater.

videos.title: Happu loses his memory - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu runs to escape from an angry Rajesh. He loses his memory after falling from the stairs. He addresses himself as Micchu Phupha and mistakes the others for servants and berates them. Later, Amma blames Rajesh for Happu’s condition.

videos.title: Happu pretends to be Micchu Phupha - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu tells everyone to leave the house. Further, he tells Beni why he is pretending to be Micchu Phupha. Continuing with the charade, he behaves inappropriately with Rajesh. Meanwhile, Kat and Kamlesh come up with an idea to get Happu’s memory back.

videos.title: Amma puts on an act - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Kat and Kamlesh’s plan to help Happu regain his memory backfires. Rajesh learns about Happu’s pretence and tells Amma about it. Amma puts on an act to force Happu to come clean.

videos.title: Happu upset on not getting the carrot pickle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu’s family, on Makar Sankranti, indulge themselves in kite flying. Happu refuses to have dinner when he doesn’t get the pickle made out of black carrot and goes to Beni’s house instead. To appease Happu, Amma and Rajesh decide to make the pickle.

videos.title: Rajesh and Amma argue over making the pickle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh and Amma argue over making a pickle of black carrots for Happu. Malaika gives a suggestion to Happu to resolve their differences. Further, Amma and Rajesh begin with the preparations for making the pickle. Malaika blackmails Kat using a picture.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh plan to spoil the other’s pickle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh plan to spoil each other’s pickle. Later, Amma and Rajesh both prepare the pickle and leave it in the sunlight. Meanwhile, Hrithik and Chamchi learn that Malaika has been blackmailing Kat.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh keep a watch over their pickles - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Chamchi and Hrithik blackmail Kamlesh by showing him the photograph. On their behest, Kamlesh comes to spoil Amma and Rajesh’s pickles but Happu and Beni beat him up. Later, Amma and Rajesh brave the cold to watch over their pickles.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh regret making the pickle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh bring Happu home from the police station using threats. Chamchi blindfolds him and makes him taste the pickles made by them. Stuck in a tight spot, Happu puts up an act which makes Amma and Rajesh regret making the pickle.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh fight over onions - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma chides Rajesh for making onion pakoras as they are expensive. An upset Rajesh vents out her anger at Happu. Having overheard their conversation, Chamchi tells Amma about it. Fed up with Amma and Rajesh’s quarrels, Happu gives Beni an advice.

videos.title: Rajesh accepts Amma’s challenge - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh accepts Amma’s challenge of managing the household expenses on a budget. Happu invites the commissioner for a meal and the latter makes a request. Hrithik gets upset on not getting his favourite food, but Rajesh finds a way to fulfil his wish.

videos.title: Rajesh’s idea to manage the household expenses - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
videos.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu asks Rajesh for money to pay for the commissioner’s feast. On Rajesh’s behest, Beni fills the bottle with cheap liquor. When the commissioner comes home, Happu serves him the liquor. Beni fears that his actions will come to light.

videos.title: The commissioner falls sick - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan

videos.title: Rajesh’s Business Idea Irks Happu
videos.overview: Rajesh and the kids decide to start a catering business and excitedly inform Amma about the same. But, Amma instigates Happu against Rajesh, and they both argue about Rajesh’s new venture.

videos.title: Amma Learns Rajesh and Dumar’s Truth
videos.overview: Rajesh and the kids discuss about the menu and the brochure and hire Kamlesh as the delivery boy. Later, Amma overhears Rajesh and Dumar’s conversation and reveals the truth to Happu.

videos.title: Happu and Amma Devise a Plan
videos.overview: Rajesh makes Kat accompany Kamlesh to deliver the tiffin. As per Amma’s instructions, Happu asks Manohar to stop them, but he lets them go after taking a bribe, leaving Amma furious.

videos.title: Rajesh Is Baffled on Learning the Truth
videos.overview: Amma and Happu devise a plan to stop Rajesh’s business, but their plan backfires. Rajesh chides Amma for conspiring against her but later apologises to Amma when Chamchi reveals the entire truth.

videos.title: An Upset Amma Decides to Leave the House
videos.overview: Amma tries to narrate a story about her and Pitaji but is left heartbroken to realise that nobody has time to talk to her. She later decides to permanently shift to Baba Mokshanand’s ashram with Beni.

videos.title: Amma’s Decision Shocks Everyone
videos.overview: Resham Pal tells Happu how his father’s decision to shift to Baba Mokshanand’s ashram has disturbed him. Amma too announces her decision of shifting to the same ashram, leaving everyone shocked.

videos.title: Amma’s Actions Upset Rajesh
videos.overview: Amma takes back the necklace from Rajesh and gives her a pair of earrings. But, at Pitaji’s insistence, she takes back the earrings too. Meanwhile, the kids decide to stop Amma from leaving the house.

videos.title: Will Rajesh and Happu Brainwash Amma?
videos.overview: Rajesh and Happu think of ways to stop Amma from going to the ashram. Beni forbids Amma from having non-veg food. But, provoked by Vimlesh’s letter, he eats non-veg food and gets slapped by Amma.

videos.title: Will Amma go to the Ashram?
videos.overview: Happu’s efforts to stop Amma from going to the ashram fail. Beni learns about the kids’ conspiracy. Unable to see her family in tears, Amma takes an unexpected decision.

videos.title: Happu’s Height Embarrasses Him
videos.overview: Happu’s family gathers for a photoshoot. The kids mock Happu for being shorter than Rajesh. Later, when Rajesh’s friends, Sanju and Mohini, visit them, Happu’s height leaves him further embarrassed.

videos.title: Happu Lies about His Height
videos.overview: Rajesh, Sanju, and Mohini’s conversation revolves around taller men, leaving Happu upset. Later, when Rajesh apprises Happu of the competition's criteria, he lies to her about his height.

videos.title: Rajesh Foils Happu’s Plans
videos.overview: As per Beni’s advice, Happu wears high-heeled shoes to look taller than Rajesh in the competition. However, Rajesh foils his plans as she too buys high-heeled sandals, leaving Happu annoyed.

videos.title: Chamchi Plans to Help Happu
videos.overview: Happu avoids the competition inspector. Later, Rajesh informs Happu about Sanju and Mohini inviting them for dinner at their place. Chamchi decides to help Happu and executes her plan.

videos.title: Amma Teaches Happu a Lesson
videos.overview: Rajesh overhears Chamchi's confession about stealing the sandals at Happu’s behest. Happu’s patriarchal thoughts irk Amma, who gives him an earful. A guilt-ridden Happu apologises to her and Rajesh.

videos.title: Happu Falls for Hrithik’s Lies
videos.overview: The principal informs Happu and Rajesh about Hrithik failing in all subjects. Hrithik puts up an act and lies about wanting to become a doctor. Everyone vows to make his dream come true.

videos.title: Happu Brings Resham Pal Home
videos.overview: Resham Pal tells Happu that he wishes to settle in the Himalayas and give away his entire property to a big, loving family. Happu brings him home, where Amma, Rajesh, and the kids put up a charade.

videos.title: Happu’s Family’s Emotional Act
videos.overview: Happu and his family continue to put up an emotional charade before Resham Pal to compel him to give away his property to them. Beni too joins in, but to their dismay, Resham Pal remains unmoved.

videos.title: A Plan to Oust Resham Pal
videos.overview: Amma, Happu, and Rajesh realise that Resham Pal doesn’t intend to give them anything, and decide to oust him. Later, Beni arrives to demand INR 10 lakh from Happu in Resham Pal's presence.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh’s Conspiracies
videos.overview: Resham Pal is shocked to see Amma and Rajesh conspiring against each other. Later, when Happu and Resham Pal reveal the truth about their charades, Hrithik’s lies are exposed before everyone.

videos.title: Gopal’s Truth Comes to Light
videos.overview: Bala beats up Gopal to learn the truth and takes him captive. He also finds the man harassing Bhim. Later, Gopal’s father reveals Sarvagya Maharaj’s plan to Bala and his family.

videos.title: Resham Pal’s Advice to Happu
videos.overview: Amma successfully keeps Happu away from Rajesh by pretending to fall sick. Resham Pal advises Happu on how to remain young and healthy. Later, Beni gives Happu a solution to his problem.

videos.title: Resham Pal’s Advice to Happu
videos.overview: Amma successfully keeps Happu away from Rajesh by pretending to fall sick. Resham Pal advises Happu on how to remain young and healthy. Later, Beni gives Happu a solution to his problem.

videos.title: Rajesh’s Pregnancy Angers Amma
videos.overview: Amma tells Rajesh and Happu about her dream, and they assure her that they don’t plan to have any more babies. The next day, Rajesh learns about her pregnancy, and Amma decides to leave the house.

videos.title: Amma Tries to Learn the Truth
videos.overview: Rajesh and Happu argue over informing Amma about Rajesh’s pregnancy. Resham Pal cancels Happu’s promotion on learning about him becoming a father again. Amma devises new plans to learn Rajesh’s truth.

videos.title: Happu’s Kids Blackmail Him
videos.overview: The kids threaten to divulge the truth to Amma and blackmail Happu and Rajesh into fulfilling their demands. Later, Amma loses her cool on learning the truth about Rajesh’s pregnancy.

videos.title: Happu Lies to the Principal
videos.overview: Amma feels at peace to learn that Rajesh is not pregnant. She suggests Amma a plan to make Happu get rid of his habit of lying. Meanwhile, he saves his kids from punishment by lying to the principal.

videos.title: Happu Vows to Speak the Truth
videos.overview: Beni warns Happu of dire consequences if he reveals the truth. However, Happu vows to always speak the truth for Amma. Malaika tells Kat to ask Kamlesh as well to vow to speak the truth.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh Batter Happu
videos.overview: Happu’s decision to speak only the truth puts him in trouble, and Amma and Rajesh beat him black and blue. Kat makes Kamlesh promise that he will never lie to her, and his words leave her heartbroken.

videos.title: Amma Gives an Order to Happu
videos.overview: Happu tells Beni that Rajesh will never get Vimlesh married to a loser like him. Amma tells Happu that he doesn’t need to speak the truth henceforth. Kamlesh’s harsh words leave Kat heartbroken.

videos.title: A Shocking Remedy for Happu
videos.overview: When Amma narrowly escapes an accident, Happu decides to speak only the truth and even gets his kids dismissed. A pundit suggests a shocking remedy for Happu, but Pitaji saves him from the torture.

videos.title: Will Rajesh Catch Happu Red-Handed?
videos.overview: Happu and Manohar reassure Haseena. A suspicious Rajesh arrives at the hotel with Amma where the manager lies to her. Happu asks Haseena to show him a place to hide.

videos.title: Haseena’s Lies Put Happu in Trouble
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh catch Happu red-handed with Haseena in a room. Haseena lies to them to save Happu, but he still lands in trouble. Later, Rajesh decides to test Happu to learn the truth.

videos.title: Happu Refuses to Recognise His Kids
videos.overview: Happu and Rajesh's kids arrive at the hotel. Amma and Beni suggest Rajesh an idea. When Happu refuses to recognise his own kids, Rajesh asks Beni for his help and makes a promise to him.

videos.title: Haseena Stops Happu from Confessing the Truth
videos.overview: Happu treats Beni as a stranger. Later, Happu gets upset when his kids cry. Haseena stops Happu from telling the truth to Rajesh. The manager provokes Rajesh against Happu.

videos.title: Rajesh's Tricks to Find the Truth
videos.overview: Amma tests Happu when he refuses to recognise them. Rajesh feels that Happu has cheated on her. She tries another trick when Happu doesn't speak out the truth even after being taught a lesson.

videos.title: Happu and Rajesh's Honeymoon
videos.overview: Happu confesses the truth after seeing Rajesh and the hotel manager's engagement. Later, Manohar allays Hasina's worries. A few days later, Happu takes Rajesh back to the hotel for a honeymoon.

videos.title: Kat Visits a Hotel with Kamlesh
videos.overview: Rajesh and Happu see Kat and Kamlesh arriving at the hotel. The manager informs Happu that Kat and Kamlesh are going to get married at the temple. Amma arrives at the hotel with Chamchi and Malaika.

videos.title: Beni, Ranbir and Hrithik at the Hotel
videos.overview: Kat meets Kamlesh after feeling scared, but his stories scare her even more. Amma, Malaika and Chamchi hide when they see Beni, Ranbir and Hrithik at the hotel. Happu calls Amma to find out the truth.

videos.title: All the Lies Come to the Fore
videos.overview: The hotel manager accidentally activates the fire alarm. Everyone comes out and their lies are exposed. Later, Rajesh waits for Happu in a garden. Meanwhile, Happu sits with Beni to drink.

videos.title: Rajesh Fights with Happu
videos.overview: Angry on seeing Happu drinking alcohol with Beni, Rajesh gets into a fight with Happu. Amma suggests an idea to reconcile Rajesh and Happu. Later, Hrithik gives a letter to Happu.

videos.title: The Commissioner Seeks Happu's Help
videos.overview: Happu and Rajesh reconcile when they go on a dinner date. Later, the commissioner seeks help from Happu's family for his sister-in-law Rusha's marriage alliance and introduces them to her.

videos.title: Kat Agrees to Help Rusha
videos.overview: Kat agrees to help break Rusha’s alliance. Happu greets the suitor’s family. Beni shares his idea with Kat and Rusha. He assumes a disguise and tells a false story to Happu and the Commissioner.

videos.title: Happu and Resham Pal Are Scared
videos.overview: Chamchi blackmails Hrithik and Ranbir. Kamlesh, disguised as Kalpana Shaitani, appears in front of Happu and Resham Pal. Luchcha Shaitani reveals a fact that scares Happu and Resham Pal.

videos.title: Kat Slaps Praful
videos.overview: Rusha, along with Kat, visits Praful. Kat slaps Praful, and Resham Pal apprises Happu of Kat's actions. Happu asks Kat for an explanation. Surprisingly, Kat behaves strangely and slaps Manohar.

videos.title: Happu's Plan Gets Foiled
videos.overview: Happu asks Rusha and Praful to spend time together. Kat arrives there and slaps Praful. The commissioner gets upset with Happu due to Kat's actions. Later, Kat refers to herself as Kalpana Shaitani.

videos.title: The Hotel Bill Shocks Happu
videos.overview: Rusha's marriage alliance breaks up. Manohar apprises Resham Pal of Rusha and Kat's plan. Resham Pal apologises to Rusha. Later, Resham Pal and Happu are shocked to see the hotel bill.

videos.title: Rajesh Moves to Her Maternal Home
videos.overview: Rajesh moves to her maternal house after an argument with Happu. Later, Happu does not allow Kamlesh to stay and Kat comes up with an idea. Resham Pal's wife asks Happu for his help.

videos.title: Amma Meets a Woman in a Temple
videos.overview: Kat brings Kamlesh, disguised as Kamli, home. Happu's kids request him to get Rajesh back. Amma and Nargis meet a woman in a temple, who pretends to be in misery. Nargis gives Amma a piece of advice.

videos.title: Amma Lands in Trouble
videos.overview: Amma brings Chandni home. Happu complains to Amma about Chandni. Later, Amma tells Chandni to leave the house, but she threatens Amma and demands INR two lakhs.

videos.title: Happu Gets Rid of Chandni
videos.overview: Amma tells Happu about Chandni’s threat. Malaika learns that Kamlesh is posing as Kamli. Later, Kamlesh apologises to Happu, while Happu gets rid of Chandni due to Beni’s idea.

videos.title: Dumar Fails to Send the Mangoes
videos.overview: Rajesh tells Dumar to send mangoes to the house before Atbir. Later, Amma and Rajesh argue about ordering mangoes. When Dumar fails to send the mangoes, Rajesh gives a task to Kamlesh.

videos.title: Atbir Delivers the Mangoes
videos.overview: A disguised Kamlesh brings mangoes and states that Dumar has sent them. The kids criticise the mangoes. Later, Atbir sends some mangoes and Rajesh employs a trick to prevent Amma from eating them.

videos.title: Amma Yearns to Eat Mangoes
videos.overview: Rajesh deprives Amma of mangoes. Later, the commissioner threatens to transfer Happu, who fails to provide two boxes of mangoes to him. Meanwhile, Rajesh tempts Amma by eating a mango in front of her.

videos.title: Happu Steals the Mangoes
videos.overview: Rajesh refuses to give Happu two boxes of mangoes for the commissioner. At night, Happu tries to steal the mangoes from Rajesh’s room. Chamchi and Kamlesh arrive as well to steal the mangoes.

videos.title: Amma Relishes the Mangoes
videos.overview: Amma learns that she is not diabetic and discerns Rajesh’s ploy. Later, she puts on an act with the doctor. Rajesh apologises to Amma for her mistake and feeds her the mangoes.

videos.title: The Commissioner’s Accusation on Happu
videos.overview: When Dumar is arrested for possessing fake certificates, Happu refuses to get him released. Later, Happu gets into trouble when the commissioner accuses him of getting the job with a fake degree.

videos.title: Happu Worries about the Exams
videos.overview: Happu worries about the exams and confides in Beni. Later, Happu forcefully feeds the commissioner his favourite sweet. Miffed, the commissioner threatens to ask tough questions during the exams.

videos.title: Happu Bribes Manohar
videos.overview: Happu bribes Manohar and seeks his help to pass the exam. Beni tells Amma and Rajesh why Happu is worried. Later, Happu’s trick to pass the exam falls through.

videos.title: Kamlesh Gets Caught Stealing
videos.overview: At Happu’s behest, Kamlesh goes to the commissioner’s house to steal the question paper but gets caught. As Happu fears losing his job, Hrithik and Ranbir suggest some tricks to him to pass the exam.

videos.title: The Commissioner’s Wife’s Revelation
videos.overview: The commissioner catches Happu cheating during the exam. The commissioner’s wife makes a revelation, which Happu uses to save his job. Later, Rajesh punishes Happu for not helping Dumar.

videos.title: Manohar Calls Rajesh Unlucky
videos.overview: Rajesh wakes up Happu. Later, Amma burns her tongue and begins to lisp. When Happu’s day at the police station goes bad, Manohar comments that Rajesh’s face is unlucky for him.

videos.title: Happu Incurs a Loss of INR Five Hundred
videos.overview: Happu sees Rajesh’s face upon waking up. At Rajesh’s behest, the kids apologise to Happu, while Kat connects with Kamlesh through a video call. Later, Happu incurs a loss of INR five hundred.

videos.title: The Commissioner Suspends Happu
videos.overview: The commissioner suspends Happu for 15 days. This leads Happu to believe that Rajesh’s face is unlucky for him. Meanwhile, Kamlesh decides that Kat is unlucky for him and doesn’t meet her.

videos.title: Rajesh Hides Her Face
videos.overview: Rajesh overhears Happu telling Amma that her face is unlucky for him. Meanwhile, Malaika thrashes Kamlesh for calling Kat unlucky. The events lead Rajesh to hide her face from Happu.

videos.title: Happu Realises His Mistake
videos.overview: Despite not seeing Rajesh’s face, Happu loses his job and gets beaten up. Rajesh decides to leave the house, while Happu realises his mistake. Later, Amma shares a piece of good news with Happu.

videos.title: Happu and Kamlesh Kill a Serpent
videos.overview: Amma tells Happu that he is going to be in trouble. Inadvertently, Happu and Kamlesh end up killing a shape-shifting serpent. Later, Happu gets scared when the serpent’s mate comes seeking revenge.

videos.title: Happu and Kamlesh Seek Help
videos.overview: Happu’s kids try to scare him with a fake snake. Kamlesh gets scared due to the shape-shifting serpent and confides in Happu. At the police station, Happu and Kamlesh seek help from a snake charmer.

videos.title: Happu Develops a Misunderstanding
videos.overview: Rajesh and Kat burn their tongues. The snake charmer reveals the identity of the serpent. Happu misunderstands Rajesh and the kids, while the snake charmer gives a ‘been’ to Happu and Kamlesh.

videos.title: Happu Gets Slapped by the Commissioner
videos.overview: The commissioner slaps Happu when he plays the ‘been’. Happu assumes that Amma is the serpent, but as his misunderstanding resolves, he tells the truth to everyone. Later, the serpent gets caught.

videos.title: The Snake Charmer Gets Exposed
videos.overview: Happu sees the serpent once again. The snake charmer suggests Happu to perform a yagna. Rajesh becomes suspicious of the snake charmer and exposes him through her plan.

videos.title: Rajesh Dreams of Happu Going Bald
videos.overview: A bad dream prompts Rajesh to declare that she will divorce Happu if he ever goes bald. Meanwhile, Pitaji tells Amma about a rule of ‘Mrityalok’, and she decides to prevent Happu from going bald.

videos.title: Happu Suffers from Hair Fall
videos.overview: Happu gets nervous as he suffers from hair fall and seeks Beni’s help. Kamlesh suffers from hair fall as well and worries about Kat ending their friendship. Later, he dons a cap and goes to meet Kat.

videos.title: Amma Shares a Remedy for Hair Fall
videos.overview: Pitaji tells Amma that Happu is suffering from hair fall. Later, Amma shares a remedy with Happu and Hrithik overhears their conversation. Meanwhile, Chamchi and Ranbir extort money from Kamlesh.

videos.title: Rajesh Learns about Happu’s Hair Fall
videos.overview: Happu and Kamlesh fight to obtain the cow dung. Beni applies the cow dung on Happu’s hair and Rajesh overhears them. Kat learns about Kamlesh’s hair fall, while something troubles Amma and Rajesh.

videos.title: Why Is Happu Suffering from Hair Fall?
videos.overview: Happu’s family ousts him from the house as he suffers from hair fall. Happu and Kamlesh visit the doctor and learn the reason behind their condition. Later, Kamlesh thrashes Janeman Jalebiwala.

videos.title: The Commissioner Suspects Happu
videos.overview: Rajesh has a bad dream, while Kamlesh hides black money behind Happu’s house. The commissioner suspects that Happu has black money. Happu shares his problem with Beni, who gives him an idea.

videos.title: An IT Officer Raids Happu’s House
videos.overview: Along with Manohar and the commissioner, the IT officer raids Happu’s house. Rajesh is interrogated when some jewellery is found in the kitchen. The officer also finds a lot of money during the raid.

videos.title: Happu’s Troubles Multiply
videos.overview: Happu and Rajesh argue, while money is found from the kids’ room. Happu’s woes multiply when the commissioner gets his hands on Amma’s money and jewellery. Kamlesh tries to retrieve the black money.

videos.title: A Trunk Is Found in Happu’s House
videos.overview: A trunk is found in Happu’s house during the raid. Happu gets angry at Rajesh and inadvertently reveals a startling truth. Later, Happu seeks help from Beni.

videos.title: Happu Evades Arrest
videos.overview: The income tax officer, Inder, finds the black money buried in Happu’s garden. Later, Manohar arrives to arrest Happu. However, Happu evades arrest because of Pitaji.

videos.title: Amma to Tell the Importance of 15th August
videos.overview: Happu and his kids plan on how to spend the 15th August holiday. Amma decides to explain to them the significance of 15th August. She convinces the children to obey her by luring them with money.

videos.title: The Family Members Become Amma's Slaves
videos.overview: Amma appears as Colonel Katori and makes the family members her slaves. She turns the house into a central jail. When Beni shares an idea with Amma on how to celebrate 15th August, she beats him up.

videos.title: Colonel Katori's Atrocities
videos.overview: Colonel Katori wakes up Happu, Rajesh and the kids early in the morning. She orders Happu and the kids to clean the house and Rajesh to cook a meal. Beni tells Happu a trick to step out of the house.

videos.title: Colonel Katori Enslaves Beni
videos.overview: Colonel Katori gets her slaves to starve. Happu and Rajesh try to step out of the house with Beni's help. However, Colonel Katori catches them and enslaves Beni to punish him.

videos.title: Happu's Family Honours Independence Day
videos.overview: Reshampal visits Happu, and Colonel Katori enslaves him. Amma's attempt to explain the meaning of independence to the family is successful. Later, everyone celebrates Independence Day together.

videos.title: Happu’s Lie Infuriates Rajesh
videos.overview: Happu tells Rajesh about his friend, Kavita. In retaliation, Rajesh tells him about her friend, Rahul. Later, Kamlesh comes up with a business idea while Rajesh gets angry at Happu’s lie.

videos.title: Rajesh Meets Her Friend
videos.overview: Rajesh meets her friend, Rahul, and invites him for a meal at her house. Happu tells Beni that Rajesh has gone somewhere in anger. When Rajesh returns home in a cheerful mood, Happu feels jealous.

videos.title: Rajesh and Rahul Recall the Past
videos.overview: Amma and the kids leave the house for some work. At the police station, Happu worries about Rahul’s arrival in the absence of his family members. Later, Rajesh and Rahul reminisce about the past.

videos.title: Happu Feels Jealous of Rahul
videos.overview: When Happu returns home, Rajesh introduces him to Rahul. Rahul impresses Amma and Happu’s kids with expensive gifts. Happu feels jealous of Rahul and Manohar gives him an idea.

videos.title: Rajesh Gives a Fitting Reply to Rahul
videos.overview: Happu and Manohar’s plan backfires. Amma discerns Rahul’s intentions and ousts him from the house after reprimanding him. Later, Rajesh gives a fitting reply to Rahul when he offers to marry her.

videos.title: Amma’s Alcohol Addiction
videos.overview: On seeing Amma’s liquor bill, Happu tells Rajesh that Amma has an alcohol addiction. Later, Amma promises Happu that she will stop drinking alcohol, while the commissioner gives a task to Happu.

videos.title: A Trick to Curb Amma’s Addiction
videos.overview: Amma is unable to restrain herself and consumes alcohol. Happu seeks an idea from Rajesh to curb Amma’s addiction. Later, Beni tells Amma about Happu’s bad habit.

videos.title: Pitaji Gives an Advice to Amma
videos.overview: Amma gets worried on seeing Happu gambling. Pitaji gives an advice to Amma. The commissioner sees a photo in which Happu is gambling and suspends him. Later, Amma scolds Rajesh for shopping.

videos.title: Rajesh Shares Her Woes with Amma
videos.overview: Rajesh tells Amma that the family members developed bad habits in order to curb her addiction. The commissioner gives a final warning to Happu on seeing him gambling. Later, Amma confides in Pitaji.

videos.title: Beni Shares His Plight with Happu
videos.overview: The kids give up their bad habits on Amma’s insistence. Pitaji overhears Beni sharing his plight with Happu and tells Amma. Later, Happu and Amma talk to Rajesh about Beni and Vimlesh’s alliance.

videos.title: Happu Secretly Meets a Girl
videos.overview: Rajesh fights with Happu over a trivial matter and Happu believes that no one loves him. Rajesh gets upset on learning about her friend Joginder’s plight. Meanwhile, Happu secretly meets a girl.

videos.title: Rajesh Learns about Happu’s Affair
videos.overview: Rajesh shares her worry with Amma. The duo sees Happu meeting Rusha and fears that he will abandon their family for her. Later, Beni gives an idea to Amma.

videos.title: Happu's Family Tries to Please Him
videos.overview: Happu arrives home and everyone tries to please him. Happu learns the reason behind the family's sudden care towards him and tells the truth to Beni. Later, Happu continues his pretence.

videos.title: Happu's Rules for the Family
videos.overview: Rajesh narrates the incident of last night to Amma. Amma and Rajesh overhear Happu and Rusa's dangerous plan. Amma confronts Happu and he makes some rules for the family. Rajesh asks him for a chance.

videos.title: Happu Accepts Rajesh’s Conditions
videos.overview: Rajesh accepts Happu’s rules. Later, Rajesh and the commissioner learn the truth about Happu’s act. Rajesh teaches a lesson to Happu and asks him to accept her conditions to earn her forgiveness.

videos.title: Kat Wishes to Go to London
videos.overview: Kat wishes to pursue modelling in London. To elevate her standing amongst her friends, Rajesh demands that Kat be sent to London. However, Happu refuses to give in to her demands.

videos.title: Happu Refuses to Send Kat to London
videos.overview: Amma convinces Happu to send Kat to London. Kamlesh gets a bad dream after learning about Kat’s impending trip. Later, Happu learns about the fee amount and refuses to send Kat to London.

videos.title: Happu Tries to Raise Money
videos.overview: Kamlesh tries to stop Kat from going to London with his trick. Happu seeks the commissioner’s help to get a loan, but he refuses. Both Amma and Rajesh wish to accompany Kat and get into a fight.

videos.title: Hrithik and Chamchi Take Revenge
videos.overview: Hrithik and Chamchi avenge their insult. Kamlesh advises Kat to become a ‘swadeshi’ and not go to London. Happu gets upset when he is unable to raise the money for Kat’s fees.

videos.title: Amma Decides to Sell the House
videos.overview: Amma decides to sell off the house for Kat's trip to London. Kamlesh gets beaten up while trying to save Happu's house from being sold. Kat suddenly changes her mind and Kamlesh comes with a news.

videos.title: Beni’s Plight Moves Amma
videos.overview: Hrithik, Ranbir, and Chamchi strike a deal with Beni. They overhear Rajesh’s conversation with Vimlesh and tell Beni about it. Moved by Beni’s plight, Amma urges Rajesh to get him married to Vimlesh.

videos.title: Beni Misbehaves with the Commissioner
videos.overview: Beni misbehaves with the commissioner. Happu tells Beni how to impress Rajesh’s father, Gabbar Singh. Gabbar Singh visits Happu’s house, where the commissioner arrives to complain about Beni.

videos.title: Beni Tries to Commit Suicide
videos.overview: Amma stops Gabbar Singh from leaving. Instead of impressing Gabbar Singh, Beni annoys him. Later, Rajesh takes a decision to stop Beni from committing suicide.

videos.title: Beni Gets Married to Vimlesh
videos.overview: Beni and Vimlesh get married. Before the couple’s wedding night, Rajesh gives an advice to Vimlesh, while Happu helps an anxious Beni. Later, Vimlesh plays a prank on Beni and scares him.

videos.title: Beni Spends the Night Outside His House
videos.overview: Happu and Rajesh reminisce about their wedding night. The next morning, Happu rebukes Beni on seeing him sleeping outside his house. Later, Beni and Vimlesh spend some quality time together.

videos.title: Vimlesh Insists on Going for a Honeymoon
videos.overview: Vimlesh tells Beni to take her abroad for their honeymoon. Happu’s kids tell Amma about their wish to visit Switzerland. Later, Beni asks Happu for an idea to avoid going on a honeymoon.

videos.title: Beni’s Mother’s Wish
videos.overview: Beni lies to Vimlesh and refuses to take her on a honeymoon. Happu and Beni decide to foil Rajesh’s trick upon getting some information from the kids. Nargis reveals Beni’s mother’s wish.

videos.title: Beni Puts On an Act
videos.overview: Happu agrees to take Rajesh to Switzerland for their honeymoon. Later, Beni sprains his back. The doctor lies to Vimlesh and dashes her hopes to go on a honeymoon.

videos.title: The Commissioner Grants Leave to Happu
videos.overview: At Rajesh’s request, the commissioner grants leave to Happu for 10 days. The pandit predicts that Amma will travel abroad. Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi give a solution to Vimlesh to cure Beni’s sprain.

videos.title: Beni and Vimlesh’s Honeymoon
videos.overview: Amma and the children too demand to go to Switzerland with Happu. Later, Amma expresses a wish. Beni explains to Vimlesh how helpless he is and just then, they receive a piece of good news.

videos.title: Rajesh Demands a Gift from Happu
videos.overview: Vimlesh tells Rajesh about Beni’s gift, leading Rajesh to demand a gift from Happu. Hrithik, Chamchi and Ranbir find a way to get their demands fulfilled. Meanwhile, the commissioner punishes Happu.

videos.title: Kat’s Demand
videos.overview: Happu brings slippers for Rajesh. Amma and Vimlesh tell Rajesh to demand an expensive gift from Happu. On getting blackmailed from Chamchi, Hrithik and Ranbir, Kat makes a demand from Kamlesh.

videos.title: Vimlesh Expresses Her Wish to Beni
videos.overview: Kamlesh fulfils Kat’s demand. Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi convey their next demand to Kat. Happu buys a pashmina shawl for Rajesh, who shows it to Vimlesh and Amma. Vimlesh expresses her wish to Beni.

videos.title: Rajesh’s Secret Trick
videos.overview: Rajesh demands a diamond necklace from Happu. She shares her secret to get gifts from husbands with Amma and Vimlesh, and Happu overhears her. Amma complains to Pitaji for never giving her gifts.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Rein in Their Wives’ Demands
videos.overview: Vimlesh demands a diamond necklace from Beni. Kat blackmails Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi. Later, Happu and Beni try a trick to rein in their wives’ demands with Manohar's help.

videos.title: Happu Gives His House on Rent
videos.overview: The commissioner tells Happu about his leave. Kat tells Happu to give their house on rent to earn extra money and Rajesh agrees with her. Happu’s family’s plan gets foiled due to Beni.

videos.title: Happu’s Family Stays at the Police Station
videos.overview: Happu’s family goes to stay at the police station. Manohar nabs a thief but Happu refuses to imprison him. Happu’s family sleeps in the jail and Rajesh tells Happu to spend quality moments with her.

videos.title: Happu’s Family in the Lock-Up
videos.overview: The commissioner returns when his leaves get cancelled. On learning about this, Happu gets worried. To save his job, he locks up his family in the jail and lies to the commissioner.

videos.title: The Tenants Refuse to Vacate Their House
videos.overview: Happu and Beni’s tenants refuse to vacate their house. Happu’s tenant, Pramod, puts forth a condition before offering refuge to Happu in his own house. Meanwhile, Kamlesh learns that Kat is in jail.

videos.title: Happu Tells the Truth to the Commissioner
videos.overview: Kamlesh works on his plan to get Kat out of the jail. The commissioner puts a criminal, Shakaal, in the lock up with Happu’s family. Happu confesses the truth to commissioner, who makes a revelation.

videos.title: The Negative Effect on Happu’s Kids
videos.overview: Happu takes his kids to witness Ram Leela. On seeing the kids’ behaviour, Amma tells Happu to lead them on the right path. Rajesh worries for the kids, while Kat seeks the commissioner’s help.

videos.title: The Commissioner Regrets Helping Kat
videos.overview: Happu and Beni try a trick to get the kids on the right path. The commissioner suffers the consequences of helping Kat. Happu’s kids tell him to give up honesty for a life of luxury.

videos.title: Happu Gets Arrested for Stealing
videos.overview: To bring the kids on the right path, Happu robs Beni’s house. The CID officer arrests Happu for stealing. Later, Rajesh seeks Beni’s help, and he talks to Manohar.

videos.title: Beni Fails to Get Happu Released from Jail
videos.overview: Beni and Manohar get into trouble while trying to free Happu from the jail. Kat tells the commissioner about Happu’s arrest. The commissioner once again gets into trouble while helping Kat.

videos.title: Happu's Kids Learn a Lesson
videos.overview: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

videos.title: Tekamal’s Prediction about Kat
videos.overview: Rajesh vents her anger at everyone. Astrologer Tekamal makes a shocking prediction about Rajesh. Kamlesh angers Tekamal with his antics and to take revenge on him, Tekamal gives a suggestion to Kat.

videos.title: Rajesh’s Terror
videos.overview: Happu tells the commissioner and Beni about Tekamal’s prediction. Later, Happu, Beni and Amma become fearful of Rajesh. When Kat makes an effort to stay away from Kamlesh, the latter threatens her.

videos.title: A Fearful Happu Runs Away from Rajesh
videos.overview: At Amma’s behest, the kids hide all the sharp tools. When Rajesh finds the knife missing from the kitchen, she gets angry. Later, Happu spots the gun in Rajesh’s hands and runs to the police station.

videos.title: Happu Fears Rajesh and Makes a Plan
videos.overview: Happu fears Rajesh’s anger and makes a plan. However, his plan gets foiled due to Beni. Later, Happu overhears Rajesh talking to Joginder and develops a misunderstanding.

videos.title: Rajesh Divulges the Truth
videos.overview: Happu tells the commissioner about Rajesh's plan to kill everyone. Along with Happu, the commissioner arrives to arrest Rajesh. Later, Rajesh tells everyone about the plan she devised with the pandit.

videos.title: Happu Tells Rajesh a False Story
videos.overview: Joginder, who visits Rajesh's house for dinner, taunts her and leaves. Happu tells Rajesh a false story to avoid her anger. Later, the news of Happu encountering aliens spreads like fire.

videos.title: The Aliens Keep an Eye on Happu
videos.overview: Happu boasts about his bravery in an interview while a few aliens keep an eye on him. His family is happy to see his photo in a newspaper. Kat distances Kamlesh when she finds a new friend.

videos.title: Happu to Get the Reward on a Condition
videos.overview: Rajesh, Amma and the kids take advantage of Happu’s fame. Later, a scientist from the Alien Research Institute visits Happu’s house. Later, he promises to reward INR 50 lakh to Happu on a condition.

videos.title: The Fake Proof Lands Happu in Trouble
videos.overview: Rajesh tells Happu about the reward money. Happu gets greedy and tells Manohar the truth to get his help. Later, he shows the fake proof to the researcher and gets into trouble.

videos.title: Happu's Lies Come to the Fore
videos.overview: Happu tells Rajesh the truth. The family puts on an act in front of the researcher, but they are exposed. Happu soon tells the researcher the truth. Later, Happu and Beni actually see an alien.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Get Busy with Gambling
videos.overview: Happu and Beni plan to gamble. The family members demand gifts on Diwali from Happu. Rajesh and Vimlesh wait for Happu and Beni to go for shopping, but the duo gets busy with gambling.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Get Caught while Gambling
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh learn about their husbands’ lie. Beni uses foul means to defeat the commissioner while gambling. Rajesh and Vimlesh see Beni and Happu gambling, and Amma gives them an idea.

videos.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Try Their Hand at Gambling
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh pretend to gamble in front of their husbands. Later, Happu and Beni take the duo along to gamble with them. However, the commissioner raids the gambling den.

videos.title: Rajesh Loses Happu while Gambling
videos.overview: Vimlesh and Rajesh lose their husbands when they put them on stake while gambling. Amma rejoices at her plan, while Manohar and Dr Udaas enslave Happu and Beni. Manohar makes Happu clean his shoes.

videos.title: Happu Gets Diwali Gifts for His Family
videos.overview: Happu and Beni's condition worsens due to being enslaved by Manohar and Dr Udas. Amma makes them realise that gambling is bad. Later, Happu gives gifts to his family and everyone celebrates Diwali.

videos.title: Chappu Arrives at Happu’s House
videos.overview: Happu tells Beni about his ex-lover, Sulochana. A boy named Chappu arrives and introduces himself as Happu and Sulochana’s son. Happu requests Rajesh to give him four days’ time to expose the truth.

videos.title: Happu Looks for Sulochana
videos.overview: Rajesh tells Beni about Chappu. Amma accepts Chappu as her grandson. Chappu blackmails Kat and Kamlesh and prevents them from meeting. Later, Happu tells Manohar to locate Sulochana.

videos.title: Happu’s Plan to Learn Chappu’s Truth
videos.overview: Manohar fails to find Sulochana. The commissioner promises to get justice for Rajesh and threatens Happu. To learn the truth about Chappu, Happu makes a plan and seeks Beni’s help.

videos.title: Manohar Poses as Sulochana
videos.overview: Happu’s plan to learn Chappu’s truth fails, while Chappu troubles the kids. Manohar shares an idea with Happu and the commissioner overhears them. Happu brings Manohar home disguised as Sulochana.

videos.title: Chappu Gets Exposed
videos.overview: Beni arrives to bail out Happu. The commissioner tells them to provide the proof of Happu’s loyalty and releases him. Later, Chappu’s mother Leena arrives and tells the truth to everyone.

videos.title: Happu Insults Rajesh
videos.overview: Happu insults Rajesh. Rajesh overhears Happu and Beni’s conversation and decides to punish Happu. Later, Amma and Rajesh seek Dr Udaas’ help and he hires Rajesh as a nurse.

videos.title: Rajesh Poses as a Nurse
videos.overview: Posing as a nurse, Rajesh comes to Dr Udaas’ clinic and shares the plan with him. Later, Rajesh and Dr Udaas put on an act before the commissioner. The commissioner gives a piece of bad news to Happu.

videos.title: Beni’s Words Hurt Happu
videos.overview: The kids and Amma put on an act in front of Happu. Happu tells Beni what the commissioner told him about Rajesh. Rajesh and Dr Udaas act in front of Beni as well. Beni relates the events to Happu.

videos.title: Rajesh’s Disloyalty Hurts Happu
videos.overview: A bad dream scares Happu and he reaches Dr Udaas’ clinic to find the truth. Rajesh and Dr Udaas put on an act in front of him. Later, an upset Happu returns home and relates the events to Amma.

videos.title: Happu Realises Rajesh’s Value
videos.overview: Rajesh decides to leave the house for Dr Udaas. Happu apologises to Rajesh and Amma makes him realise Rajesh’s value. Later, Happu learns about Amma’s ploy.

videos.title: An Argument Between Happu and Rajesh
videos.overview: Amma concocts a tale about herself and her father, causing a quarrel between Happu and Rajesh. Rajesh accepts Happu's challenge. Later, Happu goes to Beni's house, and Vimlesh goes to Rajesh's house.

videos.title: Happu and Beni’s Mutton Party Gets Ruined
videos.overview: Hrithik conveys a plan to Rajesh and Vimlesh and goes to stay with Happu and Beni. Later, Hrithik ruins Happu and Beni’s Mutton party. Rajesh prepares a chicken-based dish and makes Happu jealous.

videos.title: Happu's Plight Delights Rajesh
videos.overview: Happu's sleep gets disturbed due to Beni. The next morning, Happu chides Beni when he drinks the tea made by him, while Rajesh and Vimlesh rejoice. The commissioner stops Happu from eating outside.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Plot against Their Wives
videos.overview: Vimlesh suggests Rajesh that they should patch up with their husbands, but Rajesh refuses. Happu and Beni decide to teach a lesson to their wives. Later, Rajesh and Vimlesh spot them with two women.

videos.title: The Couples Resolve Their Differences
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh tell Amma about seeing Beni and Happu with other women. As advised by Amma, Rajesh and Vimlesh patch up with their husbands. Later, Happu and Beni divulge their plan.

videos.title: Kat Gets a Boon
videos.overview: Kat gets a boon from god, while Happu and Beni give gifts to their wives. Later, Kat’s dream turns into reality, and Chamchi tells Happu and Rajesh about this.

videos.title: Kat’s Dreams Come True
videos.overview: Kat’s dreams come true. The family members refuse to believe Chamchi’s words. Happu mistakes a man for the leader of the Chutki gang and imprisons him. Later, Kat sees a bad dream about Beni.

videos.title: Kat’s Dreams Worry Everyone
videos.overview: Despite Kat’s warning, Happu goes to the police station, where the commissioner insults him. Everyone worries on realising that Kat’s dreams are coming true. Malaika comes up with a solution.

videos.title: Kat’s Dream Troubles Happu
videos.overview: Kat tells Happu that she saw Rajesh and Vimlesh killing and burying her in the dream. Happu reads the love letter that arrived for Rajesh. Later, Kat gets scared on seeing Vimlesh digging a grave.

videos.title: Kat Gets Rid of the Boon
videos.overview: Due to Kat’s dream, everyone assumes that Rajesh and Vimlesh have killed Happu. Later, everyone breathes a sigh of relief when Kat gets rid of the boon. However, Ranbir sees a bad dream about Happu.

videos.title: Amma to Test Rajesh and Vimlesh
videos.overview: Gabbar asks Amma a question. To answer it, Amma decides to test Rajesh and Vimlesh. Malaika tells Kat a way to identify a real friend. Later, Kat tests Kamlesh.

videos.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh's Competition
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh argue over being an ideal daughter-in-law. Hrithik and Chamchi place a bet. Later, Rajesh and Vimlesh strive to fulfil Amma's demand to achieve the ideal daughter-in-law's title.

videos.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh's Fierce Fight
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh order fritters and feed it to Amma, for which, she gives them points. Happu and Beni make a futile attempt to reason with them. Later, Amma gives Rajesh and Vimlesh a task.

videos.title: Vimlesh Defeats Rajesh in the Competition
videos.overview: Vimlesh defeats Rajesh in the match by cheating. Hrithik and Chamchi argue over who will win between Rajesh and Vimlesh. While Vimlesh falls in love with Beni, Rajesh feels jealous of Happu.

videos.title: Who Becomes Amma’s Best Daughter-In-Law?
videos.overview: Amma demands a diamond ring from Vimlesh and Rajesh. Happu gets a diamond ring, which Rajesh gives to Amma. Later, Amma puts an end to Rajesh and Vimlesh’s fight by making them realise their mistake.

videos.title: A Troubled Mamera Visits Rajesh
videos.overview: Rajesh’s brother Mamera approaches her with his problem. Amma gives an advice to Mamera. Rajesh gives an idea to Happu who is worried about his promotion. Later, Kat conveys her wish to Kamlesh.

videos.title: Mamera Elopes with Rashmita
videos.overview: Happu invites the commissioner to his house for a meal. Rajesh hides Mamera from Happu’s eyes. Later, Kat elopes with Kamlesh, while Mamera elopes with Rashmita and brings her to Happu’s house.

videos.title: Rashmita’s True Identity Gets Exposed
videos.overview: Happu and the others learns that Rashmita is Rusa. Amma decides to get Mamera and Rusa married, while the commissioner tells Happu to find Rusa. Later, Manohar and the commissioner arrest Kamlesh.

videos.title: The Commissioner’s Threat Scares Everyone
videos.overview: Manohar beats up Kamlesh. The commissioner arrives at Happu’s house and Rusa hides on seeing him. The commissioner’s threat scares everyone. Rajesh and Vimlesh tell Mamera to drop Rusa at her house.

videos.title: Mamera Doesn’t Marry Rusa
videos.overview: The family members confess the truth to the commissioner. Happu’s job is put in jeopardy when Rusa and Mamera elope. Mamera refuses to marry Rusa on learning the truth about her.

videos.title: Santa’s Letter for Happu
videos.overview: Happu’s kids make a plan to celebrate Christmas. The commissioner tells Happu and Manohar about his wish to spread cheer amongst people during Christmas. Later, Happu gets a letter from Santa Claus.

videos.title: A Wishlist of Gifts to be Asked from Santa
videos.overview: The prospect of getting gifts from Santa delights everyone. Happu believes that the commissioner is going to pose as Santa and tells it to Rajesh and Beni. The elders make a long wishlist of gifts.

videos.title: The List of Gifts Shock the Kids
videos.overview: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

videos.title: Happu’s Kids Stage a Robbery
videos.overview: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

videos.title: The Truth about Secret Santa Is Revealed
videos.overview: Kamlesh arrives to rob Beni’s house, but gets caught and Happu locks him up in the jail. Later, the kids reveal the truth when the elders get disappointed with Santa’s gifts.

videos.title: A Fight Ensues between Amma and Rajesh
videos.overview: The commissioner gives a piece of good news to Happu, while Amma and Rajesh fight. Kamlesh confides in Kat about his trouble and seeks help from Happu. Later, Rajesh complains to Happu about Amma.

videos.title: Amma Leaves the House
videos.overview: Happu gets into trouble when Amma leaves the house. Rajesh and Vimlesh take the kids along to watch a movie. When Amma doesn’t return home by night, everyone gets worried.

videos.title: The Commissioner Helps Amma
videos.overview: Rajesh and Happu get restless when Amma is nowhere to be found. To teach them a lesson, Amma seeks the commissioner’s help. On learning that Happu had cheated him, Kamlesh devises a plan.

videos.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Dominate Their Husbands
videos.overview: Happu insults Rajesh in front of Vimlesh. Later, Rajesh dominates Happu in front of Vimlesh. Thereafter, Vimlesh too dominates Beni when he scolds her in front of Rajesh.

videos.title: Whose Husband Will be Oppressed?
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh challenge each other to prove that their husbands always obey them. Later, they humiliate their husbands in front of everyone. Amma tells Happu and Beni to restrain their wives.

videos.title: Amma Tries to Reason with Rajesh and Vimlesh
videos.overview: Rajesh’s and Vimlesh’s behaviour with Happu and Beni upsets Amma. She tries to reason with them but fails. Later, Kat develops a misunderstanding on seeing Rajesh with the commissioner.

videos.title: Rajesh’s Apology to Happu
videos.overview: Happu assumes that Rajesh is cheating on him when she dances with the commissioner. Upset, Happu decides to leave the house. Rajesh clears his misunderstanding and apologises for her behaviour.

videos.title: Happu’s Family Wants to Stay in a Flat
videos.overview: Happu’s family demands to stay in a flat. Kamlesh informs Kat about joining his father’s business. Later, Happu decides to take a huge share from the bribe collected by Resham Pal.

videos.title: Happu Blackmails Resham Pal
videos.overview: Rajesh gives his kids the good news of moving to a new flat. Pitaji narrates his grief to Amma and she takes a decision. Happu and Beni blackmail Resham Pal to arrange money for the flat.

videos.title: Amma’s Decision Angers Everyone
videos.overview: Everyone gets angry at Amma when she refuses to shift to the flat. Happu tries to change Amma’s decision. Later, Happu plans to extort money from the commissioner and lands in trouble.

videos.title: Happu Gives a Task to Kamlesh
videos.overview: Rajesh and the kids are excited to visit the flat and don’t obey Amma. Happu tells the family members that he is not buying the flat. Later, he threatens Kamlesh and gives him a task.

videos.title: Everyone Decides against Shifting to the Flat
videos.overview: To help buy the flat, Amma gives her jewellery to Rajesh. However, everyone decides against shifting to the flat. The commissioner clears Happu and Manohar’s doubts, and Lohri celebration takes place.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Lie to Their Wives
videos.overview: Happu and Beni plan to watch Kittu Kamsin’s show. Rajesh and Vimlesh ask the duo to accompany them to a restaurant, but they come up with a lie. Meanwhile, Kat’s friend Rahul asks her to meet him.

videos.title: Happu and Beni to Watch Kittu Kamsin’s Show
videos.overview: Kamlesh is left heartbroken on seeing Kat and Rahul together. Happu ditches his night duty to watch Kittu Kamsin’s dance with Beni. The commissioner arrives to watch the show as well.

videos.title: Happu Lies to the Commissioner
videos.overview: The commissioner spots Happu and Beni dancing with Kittu Kamsin. Later, Kat lies to Kamlesh to prevent him from learning that she had ice-cream with Rahul. Meanwhile, Happu lies to the commissioner.

videos.title: Amma Lies to Save Happu’s Job
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh get angry when Happu and Beni’s lie gets exposed. The commissioner visits Happu’s house to meet Tappu. Happu confides in Amma, and she lies to the commissioner to save Happu’s job.

videos.title: Happu’s Pretence Lands Him in Trouble
videos.overview: Happu and Beni pacify their angry wives, while Kamlesh uncovers Kat’s lie. Happu’s pretence about being Tappu lands him in trouble with the commissioner. Rajesh tells the truth to the commissioner.

videos.title: Rajesh Keeps a Paying Guest at the House
videos.overview: Happu and Amma refuse to buy an expensive saree for Rajesh. Later, Happu’s kids insist on visiting a foreign country. To raise money, Rajesh keeps a paying guest at the house without informing Happu.

videos.title: The Paying Guest Lands Rajesh in Trouble
videos.overview: Vicky Jholar arrives at Happu’s house to stay as a paying guest. Happu procures ‘churan’ from a ‘baba’ and gives it to Beni. Later, housing the paying guest lands Rajesh in trouble.

videos.title: The Commissioner Suspends Happu for a Week
videos.overview: Kamlesh sees Vicky sleeping on Kat’s lap and gets upset. Rajesh lies to Happu to prevent him from learning about the paying guest. Later, the commissioner suspends Happu for one week.

videos.title: Happu Comes Face-to-Face with Vicky
videos.overview: Happu returns home and tells everyone about his suspension. Vimlesh refuses to help a troubled Rajesh. When Happu meets Vicky, Rajesh lies to prevent him from learning the truth.

videos.title: Happu Ousts Vicky from the House
videos.overview: Rajesh’s aunt Seema gives a piece of bad news to Happu, who assumes that Vicky is a ghost. He brings a tantric home to perform exorcism. On learning the truth, Happu ousts Vicky from the house.

videos.title: The Secret of Pitaji’s Death
videos.overview: When Rajesh gets angry at Happu, he manages to pacify her using Beni’s trick. Kamlesh tells Kat that he will set an example of their friendship. Pitaji tells Amma a secret associated with his death.

videos.title: Happu to Nab Pitaji’s Killer
videos.overview: Pitaji gives Amma a clue to identify his killer. Amma conveys the same to the family members and Happu decides to nab the killer. Meanwhile, Kamlesh promises Kat that he will locate the killer.

videos.title: Who Killed Happu's Father?
videos.overview: Gabbar comes to Happu’s house. To test her friendship with Kamlesh, Kat tells him to avenge her father. Amma tells Happu the name of his fathers’ killer. Happu insults Gabbar.

videos.title: Happu Tries to Get the Truth from Gabbar
videos.overview: Happu tells Rajesh that he will catch Gabbar as soon as he gets his hand on evidence. Happu apologises to Gabbar to get him to stop from leaving. To get the truth out, Happu and Beni get Gabbar drunk.

videos.title: Gabbar's Innocence
videos.overview: While arguing with Rajesh, Happu comes up with an idea. He appears in front of Gabbar posing as Pitaji. Gabbar falsely confesses killing Pitaji out of fear. Pitaji tells Amma that Gabbar is innocent.

videos.title: Who Has the Talent for Cooking?
videos.overview: Kat is jealous as her friend Kanchan is selected in the Master Cook competition. Reshampal and Manohar tell Happu that he has no talent. Pitaji tells Amma about his talent.

videos.title: Kat To Partake in the Cooking Competition
videos.overview: Pitaji tries to make Amma’s drawing. Benny gives a piece of good news to Happu. Rajesh puts up an act to be excused from work. Kat decides to participate in the Master Cook competition.

videos.title: Happu Supports Kat's Talent
videos.overview: Happu expresses his sadness to Benny and cries. Kat tells Rajesh and Happu about her taking part in the Master Cook competition, which makes Happu happy. Kamlesh gives Kat’s dish to the Master Cook.

videos.title: Kat Cooks Food for Everyone
videos.overview: Happu tells Amma about Kat's talent. At Kamlesh's behest, Dr Udas visits Happu's house posing as Garden Ramsingh, the judge of the cooking competition. Kat cooks food and serves it to everyone.

videos.title: The Truth about Kat’s Talent Gets Exposed
videos.overview: The commissioner and Manohar arrive at Happu’s house for a meal to encourage Kat. Kat learns that she was not selected for the Master Cook Contest. Later, Pitaji shows Amma the picture that he made.

videos.title: Will Happu Decide to Be a Manager?
videos.overview: Rajesh’s uncle offers the position of manager to Happu and Beni after listening to Rajesh, Amma and Vimlesh. Rajesh and Amma talk to Happu about it. Kamlesh informs Kat about leaving for Canada.

videos.title: Happu Accepts Mamaji’s Offer
videos.overview: Happu and Beni accept Mamaji’s offer of a manager’s job due to Rajesh and Vimlesh. Mamaji interviews the duo and employs them. Later, the commissioner gives a piece of good news to Happu.

videos.title: Happu Stages an Attack on Himself
videos.overview: Beni suggests a way for Happu to get the government compensation. They both turn down Mamaji’s offer. A disguised Kamlesh beats up Happu, and Beni shows the video of the incident to the commissioner.

videos.title: Happu’s Greed Lands Him in Trouble
videos.overview: Happu’s family demands compensation from the commissioner. Kamlesh lands in trouble by helping Happu. Beni goes to collect the compensation’s cheque, and Happu encounters trouble due to his greed.

videos.title: Happu Reaps the Fruit of His Greed
videos.overview: Inspector Ghadiyal exposes Happu’s act and puts forth a condition to forgive him. Kat reveals the truth when Manohar nabs Kamlesh. Later, Happu reaps the fruit of his greed.

videos.title: Hrithik and Ranbir Rob Kamlesh
videos.overview: Rambhopal Verma decides to cast Hrithik and Ranbir in his movie. Beni is left shocked upon seeing Vimlesh on Happu’s lap. At Rambhopal’s behest, Hrithik and Ranbir rob Kamlesh.

videos.title: Kamlesh Lodges a Complaint on Getting Robbed
videos.overview: Kamlesh lodges a complaint on getting robbed. Happu mistakes Vimlesh for Rajesh and embraces her and Beni arrives at the scene. Later, the commissioner gives a tough task to Hrithik and Ranbir.

videos.title: Hrithik and Ranbir Run Away from the House
videos.overview: Hrithik and Ranbir don disguises and rob Happu, leading to his embarrassment. Masuma threatens Kamlesh as she’s not able to find her dress. Ranbir and Hrithik leave a note and run away.

videos.title: Hrithik and Ranbir Get Kidnapped
videos.overview: Vimlesh gets upset when she is blamed for Hrithik and Ranbir running away. Beni develops a misunderstanding when Happu consoles Vimlesh. Later, Happu learns about Hrithik and Ranbir’s kidnap.

videos.title: Rambhopal Blackmails Happu
videos.overview: Beni tells Rajesh that Happu and Vimlesh are having an affair. On getting blackmailed by Rambhopal, Happu agrees to obey him and lands in trouble. Hrithik and Ranbir sense Rambhopal’s intentions.

videos.title: Rajesh Pretends to Be Sick
videos.overview: Happu tells Rajesh an idea to get some private time with her. Later, Happu asks the commissioner for a leave. Happu's children prepare to attend a wedding. Rajesh pretends to have fallen sick.

videos.title: Kamlesh Spoils Happu and Rajesh's Romance
videos.overview: Happu and Rajesh's plan bears fruits as the family heads to the wedding, leaving them alone. Kat asks Kamlesh to look after Rajesh. Later, Kamlesh interrupts and spoils Happu and Rajesh's romance.

videos.title: Happu and Rajesh's Plan Fails
videos.overview: Kamlesh shares some bad news with Kat. The family returns without attending the wedding and foils Happu and Rajesh's plans for romance. Later, Happu tells Beni about it and asks him for help.

videos.title: Happu and Rajesh's Wish Remains Unfulfilled
videos.overview: Beni shares Happu and Rajesh's problem with Vimlesh. Vimlesh relays it to Amma. Beni takes the family to the wedding but they return again, leaving Happu and Rajesh's wishes unfulfilled.

videos.title: An Evil Eye Looms on Happu and Beni's Houses
videos.overview: Businessman Ajit Singh Chhabra eyes Happu and Beni's houses. He asks Happu and Beni to sell them to him, but they refuse. Amma replaces the name plates on both the houses with new ones.

videos.title: Ajit Threatens Happu and Beni
videos.overview: Happu and Beni tell their wives about Ajit's offer. Later, Ajit threatens Happu and Beni. On getting panicked, Happu locks Ajit in the jail.

videos.title: A Clash Lands Happu and Beni in Trouble
videos.overview: Rajesh decides to get the house whitewashed. Happu releases Ajit Singh Chhabra from jail, but clashing with him backfires on him and Beni. Happu and Beni approach a minister for help.

videos.title: Happu's Idea to Save the House
videos.overview: The minister refuses to help Happu and Beni. Listening to the children's horror story, an idea strikes Happu. Later, everyone performs a play in front of Ajit Singh Chhabra.

videos.title: Happu's Plan to Save the House Succeeds
videos.overview: Vimlesh, posing as a ghost, pretends to kill Rajesh to scare Ajit. He reaches the police station in horror, where Kamlesh arrives in an occultist's disguise. Later, all three scare him together.

videos.title: Malaika Thrashes Rocky
videos.overview: The commissioner introduces his nephew to Happu. The priest tells Rajesh a solution for Malaika. Malaika beats Rocky. The commissioner orders Happu to arrest the girl who beat Rocky.

videos.title: Happu Asks Malaika for a Promise
videos.overview: Happu asks Malaika to promise him never to beat anyone. On Malaika's advice, Ritik gets into a fight with Buzo and falls in trouble. The priest gives Rajesh a ritual offering but Amma eats it.

videos.title: Malaika Denies Help to Ritik
videos.overview: Buzo arrives at Ritik's house but Malaika doesn't help him. Rajesh learns that the priest's prasad has been eaten by someone and gets upset. Later, Amma asks the priest for a solution.

videos.title: Kat Hides Malaika in the Room
videos.overview: Happu doesn't arrive at the police station and the commissioner visits him with Rocky. Kat hides Malaika in the room. Later, Chamchi falls into trouble because of Hrithik, and Malaika saves her.

videos.title: Happu Withdraws His Promise
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh are robbed by some goons. Malaika thrashes the goons after Happu retracts his promise. Later, the commissioner learns that Malaika had beaten up Rocky.

videos.title: Kamlesh Arranges Bhang for Happu and Beni
videos.overview: Amma invites Gabbar for Holi celebration. Kamlesh arranges bhang for Happu and Beni, and Happu grants him permission to bring Kat to the celebration. Hrithik invites Preeti home to celebrate Holi.

videos.title: Happu Mixes Bhang in the Thandai
videos.overview: Kamlesh arrives to take Kat to the party and Malaika whips him. Happu mixes bhang in the thandai and Amma, Gabbar and Kat drink it. Later, everyone sings, dances and celebrates holi.

videos.title: Amma Elopes with Gabbar
videos.overview: Happu and Beni realise that theirs is a lacklustre Holi without bhang. Under bhang's influence, Amma elopes with Gabbar, much to everyone's worry. Manohar informs Happu about Amma's whereabouts.

videos.title: Gabbar and Amma Return in Wedding Attire
videos.overview: Rajesh's friend shares some news about Amma with her. Everyone worries as they suspect that Amma and Gabbar have gotten married. Amma and Gabbar return wearing a wedding attire.

videos.title: Rajesh Receives the News of Dharmesh's Arrival
videos.overview: Rajesh tells Happu about her friendship with Dharmesh, making Happu jealous. Later, Vimlesh clears Happu's misunderstanding. Dharmesh shares the good news of his visit with Rajesh.

videos.title: Dharmesh's Death Traumatises Rajesh
videos.overview: Vimlesh instigates Amma. A man abducts Dharmesh and shares the fake news of his death with Rajesh. Rajesh blames Vimlesh for Dharmesh's death. Later, the trauma deteriorates Rajesh's health.

videos.title: Dharmesh's Spirit Visits Rajesh
videos.overview: The driver who abducted Dharmesh visits Happu's house. He proclaims to be Dharmesh's spirit in a stranger's body, who has come to meet Rajesh. Everyone gets scared, but Rajesh fulfils all his wishes.

videos.title: The Driver's Plan to Con Rajesh
videos.overview: Happu gets annoyed with Dharmesh's spirit. The children also complain to Amma about Rajesh. The driver furthers his act by asking Rajesh for INR 10 lakh. Rajesh asks Happu to arrange the money.

videos.title: Kamlesh and Kat Rescue Dharmesh
videos.overview: Happu lies to Chamanlal and asks him for INR ten lakh. Later, Kamlesh and Kat learn about the driver's intentions. They rescue Dharmesh, bring her home, and get the driver arrested.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh Argue
videos.overview: Amma taunts Rajesh as there is more salt in the food, and Rajesh agrees with her. Happu tells Kamlesh to stay away from Kat as she fails in her exams. Vimlesh hears Amma speaking to Pitaji.

videos.title: The Solution to Amma and Rajesh's Quarrel
videos.overview: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

videos.title: Rajesh Taunts Amma as a Mother-in-Law
videos.overview: Rangeela unveils a secret from Amma and Rajesh's past life and suggests a solution for their conflict. Later, Rajesh poses as a mother-in-law and taunts Amma. Happu thrashes Kamlesh on visiting Kat.

videos.title: Happu’s Children Learn Vimlesh’s Secret
videos.overview: Happu’s children learn about Vimlesh’s secret and blackmail him to get their work done. Gabbar gets furious with Rajesh as he misbehaves with Amma. Kamlesh gets beaten up because of Kat.

videos.title: Amma Realises Rajesh's Value
videos.overview: Tired of doing the household chores, Amma realises Rajesh's importance. Rajesh feels bad about disrespecting Amma as well. Vimlesh reveals the truth and Hrithik's act also comes to an end.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Remain Devoid of Romance
videos.overview: Happu and Beni share their problems with each other. They try to bring romance in their married lives but fail in doing so. Happu advises Beni to meet Rocky to find a solution to his problem.

videos.title: Rocky Advises Happu and Beni
videos.overview: The commissioner makes Manohar the chief of the 'Anti Laila-Majnu' Squad. Happu and Beni tell Rocky about their problem, and on his advice, ask their wives out for a candle-light dinner.

videos.title: The Wives' Behaviour Upsets the Husbands
videos.overview: Their wives' unromantic behaviour at the romantic dinner upsets Happu and Beni. Manohar gives some work to Kamlesh. Rajesh and Vimlesh overhear their husbands and decide to act as their girlfriends.

videos.title: Romance Lands Happu and Beni in Jail
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh meet their husbands, posing as girlfriends, at the park. Kamlesh and Kat spot them and inform Manohar about it in exchange for money. Manohar puts Happu and Beni in jail.

videos.title: The Husbands Regret Their Mistake
videos.overview: Amma learns about Happu and Beni's doing and slaps them. They request Amma to turn their wives back to normal. The family peforms an act and Amma teaches a lesson to her sons and daughters-in-law.

videos.title: Happu to Nab Raka
videos.overview: Chamanlal baits Happu and Manohar with promotion and challenges them to catch the vicious killer Raka. Later, Raka appoints Beni as his lawyer. Amma experiences a nightmare that leaves her scared.

videos.title: Happu Asks Beni for Raka's Whereabouts
videos.overview: Upon learning about Amma's dream, the family plans to stop Happu from nabbing Raka. Happu asks Beni about Raka's location. Kat suggests to Kamlesh, a way to lift his reputation in front of the family.

videos.title: Happu Catches Kamlesh Instead of Raka
videos.overview: Amma asks Kamlesh to do something for her. Happu nabs a disguised Kamlesh instead of Raka and hands him over to Raka. When the truth comes forth, Happu's job falls in danger.

videos.title: Raka Slips Past Happu
videos.overview: Rajesh's threat causes Kamlesh to resume roaming in disguise. Happu nabs him again, mistaking him for Raka. Upon learning the truth, Happu asks Chamanlal for a final chance to catch Raka.

videos.title: Raka Fires a Gun at Happu
videos.overview: Rajesh plans to make Happu leave his job. Happu mistakes Chamanlal's brother-in-law, Raka, for Bittoo and nabs him. Chamanlal then fires Happu. Later, Raka visits Happu and fires a gun at him.

videos.title: Shakal Escapes from Happu's Captivity
videos.overview: Shakal escapes from Happu's captivity due to Rajesh's interference. Hrithik boasts about Happu's profession in front of Maisha. Kamlesh tries to put Malaika in place but gets beaten up by her instead.

videos.title: Reshampal and Happu Become Constables
videos.overview: Senior official Suresh Chatwal appoints Reshampal and Happu as constables and makes Manohar their senior. Maisha expresses her wish to meet Happu. Hrithik relays it to Happu, who pleads with Manohar.

videos.title: The Family Learns about Happu's Demotion
videos.overview: The family learns about Happu's demotion. Kamlesh ends his friendship with Kat. Happu blames Amma and Rajesh for his demotion. Amma and Rajesh get into another argument about the food menu.

videos.title: Chatwal Visits Happu's House
videos.overview: At the police station, the new commissioner, Chatwal punishes Happu. On Beni's advice, Happu invites Chatwal to his house for dinner. Chatwal, with bad intentions, offers a job to Rajesh.

videos.title: Happu Becomes an Inspector Again
videos.overview: Rajesh arrives at the police station as an inspector and Chatwal eyes her maliciously. Later, Happu and the commissioner get their former positions back with Beni's help. Kamlesh apologises to Kat.

videos.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Fall in Roma's Trap
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh call their friend Roma. Reshampal gives Happu and Manohar the task of finding the gold smugglers. Rajesh and Vimlesh deliver Roma’s parcel to a man and find themselves in trouble.

videos.title: Roma Blackmails Rajesh and Vimlesh
videos.overview: Benny brings alcohol for Happu, who’s working at the blockade. Roma blackmails Rajesh and Vimlesh. Happu tells Rajesh that he has been assigned the work of catching the smugglers, which worries her.

videos.title: Roma Meets Rajesh and Vimlesh
videos.overview: Rajesh cooks ‘Halwa’ for Ritika, but Roma calls Rajesh and Vimlesh to meet her. Ritika feels more upset. Commissioner loses his cool at Happu. Roma tells Rajesh and Vimlesh to deliver the parcel.

videos.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Smuggle Gold
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh fool Happu. Kamlesh spots the duo smuggling gold and gets into trouble. Beni shares his suspicion with a worried Happu, that an insider is colluding with the gold smugglers.

videos.title: Roma Gets Arrested
videos.overview: At night, Happu and Beni follow their wives and spot them smuggling. Rajesh and Vimlesh reveal the truth to the family. Happu arrests Roma and Rajesh reveals her ploy.

videos.title: Gabbar Flirts with Amma
videos.overview: Gabbar arrives to give his daughter's wedding invitation and flirts with Amma. Kamlesh sets up a namkeen stall. Everyone shops for the wedding and rejoices. Kat sees Kamlesh selling namkeen.

videos.title: Beni and Happu Suffer from Constipation
videos.overview: To take revenge on Kamlesh, a man spikes his namkeen and Happu takes it. Happu and Beni eat the namkeen and get constipated. Happu suspects that the namkeen was spiked.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Suffer from Constipation
videos.overview: Malaika warns Kamlesh to stay away from Kat. Happu and Beni suffer from constipation and refuse to go to Kusum’s wedding. After learning about this, Gabbar calls Rajesh.

videos.title: Happu Decides to Not Attend the Wedding
videos.overview: Dr. Udaas recommends surgery to treat Happu's constipation. Rajesh and Vimlesh assume that their husbands are putting on an act and quarrel with them. Happu decides to not attend the wedding.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Seek Revenge from Kamlesh
videos.overview: Happu and Beni consume a powdered substance to treat their constipation, but it worsens. Gabbar calls Rajesh and shares some bad news with her. Later, Happu and Beni take revenge from Kamlesh.

videos.title: Urvashi's Reunion with Happu and Beni
videos.overview: One of Happu and Beni's old friends, Urvashi, calls them and they lie to their wives in order to meet her. Kamlesh tells Kat about his friend Sapna and Kat feels jealous.

videos.title: What did Happu and Beni Do wiith Urvashi?
videos.overview: In their drunken stupour, Happu and Beni go to drop Urvashi home. Urvashi tells them about their doings, once they are sober. Kat calls Kamlesh after she sees him with Sapna, but he lies to Kat.

videos.title: Urvashi Blackmails Happu and Beni
videos.overview: On reaching home, Happu and Beni lie to their wives. Kamlesh introduces Kat to Sapna and Sapna tells her that she is Kamlesh's first girlfriend. Urvashi blackmails Happu and Beni for money.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Steal Rajesh's Saree
videos.overview: Urvashi visits Rajesh and Vimlesh, and spots Rajesh's expensive saree. Happu and Beni give Urvashi money, but she demands Rajesh's saree as well. Later, Happu and Beni steal Rajesh's saree.

videos.title: Urvashi Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Urvashi blackmails Beni and Happu again. Bittu's police complaint gets Urvashi arrested. Rajesh and Vimlesh learn the truth. Kamlesh turns down Sapna's love for the sake of Kat.

videos.title: Happu Gifts Rajesh a Fake Necklace
videos.overview: Rajesh asks Happu for a diamond necklace, but he decides to give her a fake necklace. Kamlesh gifts Kat a box of sweets. Later, Happu distributes gifts to the family. The necklace leaves Rajesh happy.

videos.title: Happu Reveals the Necklace's Truth to Amma
videos.overview: Happu tells Amma that he gave a fake necklace to Rajesh. Vimlesh asks Beni for a necklace like Rajesh's. Kat asks Kamlesh for an expensive gift. Later, Happu reveals the necklace's secret to Beni.

videos.title: Gabbar Asks Rajesh and Vimlesh for Money
videos.overview: Happu advises the commissioner to gift his wife a fake necklace. Beni gifts Vimlesh a necklace. Gabbar approaches Rajesh and Vimlesh for financial help and they consider pawning off their necklaces.

videos.title: The Truth about Happu's Gifts Comes Forth
videos.overview: Happu tells Amma about having purchased the land. An injured commissioner reaches the police station and blames Happu for his condition. Later, the family learns that their gifts are fake.

videos.title: Rajesh's Act Causes Happu to Admit His Fault
videos.overview: Rajesh fakes her abduction and death with Gabbar, Kamlesh, and the children's help. Due to this, Happu realises his mistake and admits that the necklace was fake. Kamlesh practices black magic.

videos.title: Happu Becomes a Courtesan Named 'Happi Jaan'
videos.overview: A bad omen leaves Rajesh scared. The commissioner plans to nab the criminal, J.K. Meanwhile, Happu turns into courtesan, Happi Jaan. Kamlesh tells Kat and Malaika about his new business.

videos.title: Happu's Suffers from Mental Imbalance
videos.overview: Happu and J.K. get into a fistfight and Happu suffers from a head injury, causing mental imbalance. Happu, upon turning into Happi Jaan, mistakes Beni for Kunwar Sa. Pitaji speaks to Amma about Happu.

videos.title: Happu Dances in front of the Principal
videos.overview: Hrithik fights with Bittu at the school. Amma throws a party to celebrate Happu's recovery. After the kids are expelled, Happu visits the principal and again dances in Happy Jaan's disguise.
