videos.title: Happi Jaan Flirts with Beni
videos.overview: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

videos.title: Happu Regains His Mental Balance
videos.overview: Believing himself to be Happi Jaan, Happu tries to kill Gabbar, assuming him to be Thakur. Happu recovers after being hit on the head by Beni. Rajesh tests whether Happu has recovered or not.

videos.title: Happu Renders His Children's Teacher Homeless
videos.overview: The children's words delight Happu. Later, he takes a bribe and unknowingly renders his children's teacher homeless. The children offer their home for the teacher's stay. Kamlesh asks Kat for help.

videos.title: Beni Poses as the Father of Happu's Children
videos.overview: Happu learns about the mistake thet he committed unintentionally. The children's teacher, Vidyadhar, arrives at their home and Happu tries to avoid him. Beni meets Vidyadhar as the children's father.

videos.title: Happu's Family Hides the Truth from Vidyadhar
videos.overview: Happu asks Maganlal to keep Vidyadhar back as a tenant, but he refuses. The commissioner visits Happu's house and the family tries to hide the truth from Vidyadhar. Vimlesh asks Happu to prepare tea.

videos.title: Vidyadhar Spots Happu with Rajesh
videos.overview: Everyone pretends that Happu is Vimlesh's husband. At night, Vidyadhar gets stunned upon spotting Happu in Rajesh's room and tells Amma about it. Later, Happu asks the commissioner for help.

videos.title: Vidyadhar's True Self Stuns everyone
videos.overview: Upon learning the truth, Vidyadhar decides to not promote Happu's children to the next standard. A few days later, he brings the report cards and asks Happu for help. Vidyadhar's truth stuns everyone.

videos.title: The Danger of Death Befalls Happu
videos.overview: A sage tells Happu a way to avoid death. An upset Happu tells Beni about the sage's words. Rajesh heads to the beauty parlour to woo Happu. The family decides to shower Happu with love.

videos.title: Happu Gets Showered with Love
videos.overview: Manohar protects Happu from a man's attack. Happu returns home from the police station and everyone showers him with love. Meanwhile, an upset Beni's behaviour shocks Vimlesh.

videos.title: Happu Instils Hate for Himself in the Family
videos.overview: Beni helps Happu and gets thrashed by Malaika. Rajesh complains about Happu to Amma. Happu deliberately attempts to instil hatred for himself in the family members' minds.

videos.title: The Family Begins to Hate Happu
videos.overview: Happu instils hatred for himself in the minds of the family members and rejoices over the success of his plan. Rajesh and the kids prepare to leave the house. Amma also plans to accompany them.

videos.title: Happu's Children Celebrate Father's Day
videos.overview: Beni tells the truth to the family to stop them from leaving. The family pretends to hate Happu. Manohar tells Happu the reality of the sage. Happu's children wish him a happy Father's day.

videos.title: Happu's Plan to Visit a Museum Backfires
videos.overview: The commissioner shares his problem with Happu. Later, Happu takes his kids to a museum, where Hrithik accidentally breaks a 2500-year-old cup, and the manager asks Happu to compensate for it.

videos.title: How will the Museum's Damage be Compensated?
videos.overview: Happu worries about raising the money to fix the museum's damage. Hrithik vows to stop speaking nonsense. Later, Malaika comes up with an idea to raise money.

videos.title: Happu Devises a Plan to Steal
videos.overview: Happu devises a plan to steal from Reshampal, but someone else beats him to it. For the sake of money, Rajesh asks Gabbar to marry Kamini. Kamlesh tells Malaika a way to steal from an ATM.

videos.title: Rajesh's Plan to Collect Money
videos.overview: A prisoner assures help to Happu and Happu sets him free. Manohar tells Happu that it is the same prisoner who planned the loot. Rajesh and Vimlesh discuss with Kamini, her marriage to Gabbar.

videos.title: The Museum's Manager is Arrested
videos.overview: Happu devises a plan to conduct a robbery at the museum and Amma agrees to it. To save Chamchi, Hrithik breaks his vow. Later, the commissioner arrests the museum manager, Pandey.

videos.title: Rajesh Demands to Have AC in the Kitchen
videos.overview: Happu agrees to get the AC installed in the kitchen for Rajesh, but after talking to Amma, he refuses to get it installed. Vimlesh suggests Rajesh a plan. Kamlesh gets the job of a reporter.

videos.title: Rajesh Turns into a Mermaid
videos.overview: Troubled by the heat, Rajesh pulls off a pretence. Gabbar lies to the family that Rajesh is a mermaid. Happu arranges a swimming pool for Rajesh at home. Malaika grows suspicious of Rajesh.

videos.title: The News of Rajesh Being a Mermaid Goes Viral
videos.overview: Happu tells Manohar and Resham Pal that Rajesh is a mermaid. Reporter Kamlesh covers this news and it goes viral. The news on TV makes the family suspect that Rajesh is not a mermaid.

videos.title: Rajesh's Pretence Lands Happu in Trouble
videos.overview: Rajesh tells her family the truth. Resham Pal asks Happu to let Rajesh continue her pretence for a few days. The editor asks Kamlesh to find out about the mermaid's husband and Happu gets in trouble.

videos.title: A Few Goons Try to Abduct Happu and Rajesh
videos.overview: Happu pretends to be a mermaid just like Rajesh. The goons of an international gang come to abduct them, but Malaika saves them. Resham Pal makes a statement by holding a press conference.

videos.title: Rajesh Recieves Her Grandfather’s Umbrella
videos.overview: Gabbar gives Rajesh an umbrella of her grandfather. Happu stops Kamlesh from entering the house. Hritik decides to participate in the essay competition. Manohar tells Happu about his stolen umbrella.

videos.title: Rajesh's Grandfather's Umbrella Gets Stolen
videos.overview: Happu takes Rajesh's grandfather's umbrella to Chhajjan's dhaba without informing Rajesh, but it gets stolen. Hrithik writes an essay on the umbrella. Rajesh gets upset after not finding the umbrella.

videos.title: Rajesh Learns about the Theft of the Umbrella
videos.overview: Rajesh learns that Happu has lost the umbrella. She asks Happu not to come to the house till he gets it back. Amma visits the police station, gives Pitaji's umbrella to Happu, and tells him a trick.

videos.title: Happu Gives Rajesh a Fake Umbrella
videos.overview: Gabbar is saddened to learn that the umbrella is stolen. Hrithik makes Beni write an essay for the competition. The umbrella given by Amma gets stolen, and Happu brings Rajesh a fake umbrella.

videos.title: Happu Catches the Umbrella Thief
videos.overview: Kamlesh steals the umbrella from Rajesh's cupboard and takes it away. Soon, Happu catches the umbrella thief, Kamlesh. He listens to Kamlesh and allows him to visit his house on one condition.

videos.title: Happu's Kids Pray to God for His Fame
videos.overview: Happu's kids pray to God to make him famous. A marriage proposal comes up for Kat. Kamlesh decides to break up that alliance. Happu tells Resham Pal how to become famous.

videos.title: Kamlesh Makes a Video of Happu
videos.overview: Happu eats Parathas made by Amma with great fervour, which later causes a stomach upset. Journalist Dhumal interviews Happu. Kamlesh makes a video of Happu to break Kat's alliance.

videos.title: Happu's Video Goes Viral
videos.overview: A suitor's family comes to see Kat. Happu's video goes viral, and everyone sees it on their phone, due to which Kat's alliance gets cancelled. Rajesh blames Amma for Happu's stomach being upset.

videos.title: Happu Is Saddened by His Humiliation
videos.overview: Resham Pal suspends Happu. Moreover, Happu faces humiliation due to his viral video, which disheartens him. Malaika learns that Kamlesh had made Happu's video.

videos.title: Happu Earns His Prestige Back
videos.overview: Kamlesh asks for a chance to rectify his mistake after apologising to Happu. Happu gets his job back by blackmailing Resham Pal, who helps him regain his lost prestige at a press conference.

videos.title: Beni and Vimlesh Meet a Baba
videos.overview: Rajesh ousts Happu from the room because of his belching. Beni and Vimlesh visit a baba, who gives them a book of black magic. Beni, Vimlesh and Rajesh perform tantric remedies mentioned in the book.

videos.title: A Glitch in the Tantric Practice
videos.overview: Owing to a glitch during the tantric practice, the demonic power comes out of the book. Rajesh, Beni and Vimlesh go to Baba to find out who is possessed because of this. Baba suggests them a remedy.

videos.title: Someone Is Possessed by the Demonic Power
videos.overview: Hrithik devises a plan against Kamlesh. Rajesh tells the remedy suggested by the baba, which reveals that somene is possessed by the demonic power. Rajesh gets scared, and Vimlesh gives her an idea.

videos.title: The Baba Gives Rajesh a Powdered Herb
videos.overview: Happu's belching scares Rajesh. The Baba gives Rajesh a powdered herb to drive away the demonic power in Happu's body. Kamlesh finds it hard to pretend to be a vampire and tells Malaika the truth.

videos.title: Rajesh Beats Happu with His Shoe
videos.overview: Worried about Malaika's disguise, Rajesh tells Amma the truth and seeks her help. Later, Rajesh beats Happu with a shoe to drive away the evil force. Manohar comes and reveals the truth to everyone.

videos.title: Pathan Demands Money from Beni
videos.overview: Pathan asks Beni for his money. Kamlesh gets a job in an insurance company and makes a vow. Happu and Beni lose their invested money. Pathan threatens them and Beni thinks of a plan.

videos.title: Beni Tells Vimlesh His Plan
videos.overview: A disguised Beni comes to the police station with Happu, who asks Manohar to lock Beni up to save him from Pathan. Kamlesh tells Kat about his actions. Beni tells Vimlesh his and Happu's plan.

videos.title: Happu Breaks the News of Beni's Death
videos.overview: Happu informs the family about Beni's death. The kids suspect that Happu is lying, and Kat seeks Kamlesh's help to find out the truth. Later, everyone mourns at Beni's condolence meet.

videos.title: Rajesh Decides to Get Vimlesh Remarried
videos.overview: Kamlesh interrogates Happu. Rajesh decides to get Vimlesh remarried. Kamlesh's and Happu's kids go to the accident site to find out the truth behind the accident. Beni gets thrashed in the lockup.

videos.title: Beni Stops Vimlesh from Getting Engaged
videos.overview: Happu tells Kamlesh to pass Beni's insurance claim quickly. Beni stops Vimlesh from getting engaged and reveals the truth to everyone. Pathan asks Beni to return his money and gives him the good news.

videos.title: Gabbar demands INR 2 Lakh from His Daughters
videos.overview: Happu does not provide money for his children's school trips. Atbir returns Amma's money. Gabbar asks for INR 2 Lakh from Rajesh and Vimlesh, and they think of a plan to arrange the money.

videos.title: Rajesh Steals Money from Her Own House
videos.overview: Happu agrees to give money for his children's school trip. Later, he keeps the money in the storeroom cupboard in front of Rajesh and Amma. When Rajesh steals money from the cupboard, Amma wakes up.

videos.title: Happu Learns about the Theft
videos.overview: Rajesh gives money to Gabbar. Happu learns that the money has been stolen and decides to find the thief. Rajesh tries to frame Amma for the robbery. Later, Gabbar again asks Rajesh for the money.

videos.title: Rajesh Steals the Money Again
videos.overview: Due to Vimlesh's threat, Beni fails to tell Happu the truth. Kamlesh gets a job to tarp the cats. He mistakes Gabbar for a cat and catches him. Rajesh again steals the money and gives it to Gabbar.

videos.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Admit their Mistake
videos.overview: Happu learns that the money has been stolen again. Due to Rajesh's action, Amma gets into a problem. Rajesh and Vimlesh admit their mistake. Gabbar returns the money to Rajesh.

videos.title: Chamchi Goes into Depression
videos.overview: Chamchi goes into depression on failing to write an essay. Happu learns the reason behind Chamchi’s depression. Hrithik comes up with an idea to help Chamchi.

videos.title: Happu Becomes Happu Man
videos.overview: To please Chamchi, Happu transforms into a superhero and lies to her. Someone smears ink on Reshampal's face and leaves. Chamchi challenges her friends that she will show them Happu's superpowers.

videos.title: Happu Man Becomes Famous
videos.overview: Lotiya Pehlwan seizes Beni's land, and Happu refuses to help Beni. Happu becomes famous after showing his superpower in front of Chamchi's friends. Later, Happu reveals the truth to Reshampal.

videos.title: Happu Gets Scared of Lotiya Pehelwaan
videos.overview: Happu Man talks to the press reporters. In order to help Beni and Vimlesh, he threatens Lotiya Pehelwaan, but it backfires on him. Hrithik and Ranbir stop Chamchi from putting her life at risk.

videos.title: Chamchi Realises Her Mistake
videos.overview: Two goons kidnap Happu. Reshampal makes a plan to save Happu. Later, Happu returns home as the goons free him. Chamchi realises her mistake and apologises to Happu. Everyone celebrates Rakshabandhan.

videos.title: Happu Keeps His Money with Beni
videos.overview: Happu tells the significance of Independence Day to kids. Amma assigns the children the task of cleaning up the trash around the house. Happu receives a bribe of INR 5 lakh, which he keeps with Beni.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Get Into a Fight Over Money
videos.overview: Gabbar is moved to tears by Rajesh and Vimlesh's love. Happu asks Beni for his money. Kat and Kamlesh think about making a project on friendship. Happu and Beni get into a fight over money.

videos.title: Happu Lodges a Complaint against Beni
videos.overview: Gabbar arrives while Rajesh and Vimlesh get into a fight. Happu lodges a complaint against Beni. Kamlesh tells a plan to foster friendship between Happu and Beni. Manohar arrives to investigate Beni.

videos.title: Beni Threatens to Sue Reshampal
videos.overview: The fight between Happu and Beni heats up. Rajesh and Vimlesh also get into a brawl. Reshampal attempts to help Happu, but Beni threatens to sue him.

videos.title: Happu and Beni's Misunderstandings are Resolved
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh tell their husbands about Gabbar's wish and celebrate his birthday. Later, envelopes full of money are found in the cupboard. Happu, Beni, Rajesh and Vimlesh realise their mistake.

videos.title: Rajesh Decides to Take up a Job
videos.overview: Rajesh decides to take up a job and agrees to do the job suggested by her father Gabbar. Reshampal tells Happu that Rajesh is a cunning spy and asks him to unearth the truth.

videos.title: Happu Tells a Secret to Amma
videos.overview: Happu informs Amma that Rajesh is a Russian spy. Later, he sees Rajesh with a Russian man. Ranbir and Chamchi approach Malaika for assistance. Rajesh's lookalike, Natalia, murders a man.

videos.title: Rajesh Tries to Learn the Russian Language
videos.overview: Reshampal asks Happu to perform police duties. Happu informs Beni that Rajesh is a spy. Later, Rajesh tries to learn the Russian language. On hearing her words, Happu and Beni have a misunderstanding.

videos.title: Beni misidentifies Vimlesh as a Spy
videos.overview: Happu suspects Kamlesh is also with Rajesh. Beni misidentifies Vimlesh as a spy. Reshampal rebukes Happu for failing to inform him about Natalia. Later, the children refuse Rajesh to take up the job.

videos.title: Rajesh Gives Up on Her Desire to Work
videos.overview: Happu refuses to believe Rajesh and Vimlesh and arrests them. Reshampal gives Happu a piece of news and apologises to him. Rajesh relinquishes her insistence on doing a job.

videos.title: The News about Kamlesh Surprises Everyone
videos.overview: Kamlesh becomes homeless and Happu refuses to house him. Bored with her life, Rajesh decides to try something new. Kamlesh devises a plan, and everyone is surprised to read about him in the newspaper.

videos.title: Hero Kamlesh to Stay at Happu's House
videos.overview: Despite Malaika's objections, Rajesh and Happu decide to keep Kamlesh in the house. Kamlesh and his fake director move into Happu's house. Later, the fake director casts Kat and Amma in his film.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Fight Due to Their Wives'
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh fight for the roles in the film. Happu and Beni also beat each other in retaliation for their wives' abuse. On learning about this, Kat and Kamlesh get enraged.

videos.title: Kamlesh Is Exposed
videos.overview: To get a role in the film, a wrestling competition between Rajesh and Vimlesh begins. Reshampal comes to Happu's house with kebabs and exposes Kamlesh. Later, Amma punishes the fake director.

videos.title: Happu Gets Disturbed by His Room's Leaky Roof
videos.overview: Happu and Rajesh's romance is disturbed by the room's leaky roof. Happu then tells Beni about his problem. Malaika beats Kamlesh up due to his actions. Later, Manohar gives Happu an important news.

videos.title: The Rain Spoils Happu's Mood
videos.overview: Happu wishes to romance Rajesh, but the rain spoils his mood. They go to the children's room and send them to Amma's room. But Amma also drives them away to spend time with Pitaji.

videos.title: Rajesh and Happu's Romance is Disturbed
videos.overview: Rajesh and Happu sleep in Kat and Malaika's room, but they are unable to romance there. Amma has a party with Pitaji. Later, Rajesh and Happu go to Beni's house to sleep.

videos.title: Happpu Gets the Roof of His Room Repaired
videos.overview: Happu frees Ganguram from jail and orders him to repair the roof of his room. As the roof of Amma's room leaks, she sleeps in Happu's room. Later, Happu and Rajesh's romance is disturbed again.

videos.title: The Leaky Roof Ruins Happu's Night
videos.overview: Happu and Rajesh go to Beni's house, but the roof there also begins to leak. Beni and Vimlesh have a bad night. Happu plans to romance Rajesh at the police station, but their night gets spoiled.

videos.title: Amma Gets Embarrassed in front of Nargis
videos.overview: Amma shows Nargis the necklace she got during Happu’s wedding. She gets embarrassed when the necklace turns out to be fake. Later, Reshampal goes to keep his money in the bank locker.

videos.title: Vimlesh's Chain Turns Out to be Fake
videos.overview: The argument between Amma and Rajesh ruins Happu's mood. Happu asks Rajesh to make Gabbar apologise to Amma, but she refuses. The chain given by Gabbar to Vimlesh turns out to be fake.

videos.title: Amma Demands INR 15 lakh from Gabbar
videos.overview: Gabbar tries to calm down Amma by apologising to her, but she threatens him and demands INR 15 lakh. Rajesh and Vimlesh leave the house despite Happu and Beni's attempts to stop them.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Miss their Wives
videos.overview: Kat demands INR 15 lakh from Kamlesh. Happu and Beni miss Rajesh and Vimlesh and go to pick them up, but they refuse to return home. Happu shares a plan with Gabbar to arrange for INR 15 lakh.

videos.title: Amma Teaches Gabbar a Lesson
videos.overview: Happu and Beni kidnap Reshampal's wife in order to arrange money. Gabbar gives Amma the money, and Amma reveals her plan to teach him a lesson. At the police station, Reshampal interrogates Happu.

videos.title: Masterji Complains about the Children
videos.overview: Masterji complains to Happu and Rajesh about the children. Amma mocks Rajesh for not paying attention to the children, and Happu grows tired of their squabbles. Kamlesh informs Kat of his new job.

videos.title: Happu Pretends to be a Child
videos.overview: Happu starts behaving like a child, and his family members get worried on seeing his state. Rajesh's cure for Happu fails. At Kat's behest, Kamlesh takes Happu's responsibility.

videos.title: Happu Gets Exposed in front of Rajesh
videos.overview: Amma taunts Rajesh for not instilling good values in the children. Rajesh devises a plan and exposes Happu. She takes revenge on Amma by blackmailing Happu. Later, Amma slaps Happu.

videos.title: The Children Ask Happu to Steal the Money
videos.overview: The children ask Happu to steal the money from Rajesh's purse. Happu gets enraged with Rajesh, who then executes her plan. However, the commissioner arrives and Happu gets exposed.

videos.title: The Minister Brings Mintu's Proposal for Kat
videos.overview: Kat slaps Minister Dayashankar's son Mintu. To fulfil Mintu's wish, Dayashankar brings Mintu's marriage alliance for Kat. Beni advises Happu to not get Kat married to Mintu.

videos.title: Rajesh's Plan to Break Kat's Marriage Alliance
videos.overview: Rajesh devises a plan to break Kat's marriage alliance. The family defames Happu in front of the minister. Everyone rejoices when Kat's marriage alliance breaks, but Happu gives them worrisome news.

videos.title: Dayashankar to Get Kat and Mintu Engaged
videos.overview: Seeking help from Jagwanti gets difficult for Happu. Despite Rajesh and Vimlesh's act, Minister Dayashankar agrees to get Kat and Mintu engaged. Gabbar arrives to meet Amma and Amma stops him.

videos.title: Malaika's Plan to Break Kat's Marriage Alliance
videos.overview: The minister gets Mintu and Kat engaged. Happu panics on having a nightmare. Malaika devises a plan to break Kat's marriage alliance. Two girls file a police complaint against Mintu.

videos.title: Happu To Perform 'Jagrata' for Promotion
videos.overview: Reshampal advises Happu on how to get a promotion. Karishma informs Rajesh and Vimlesh of the molestation incident at the passport office. Happu asks his musician friend Hulchul to perform 'Jagrata'.

videos.title: Rajesh Slaps Musician Hulchul
videos.overview: The family gets happy learning that a 'Jagrata' will be held. Due to a misunderstanding at the passport office, Rajesh slaps Hulchul. Later, Hulchul is shocked to learn that Rajesh is Happu's wife.

videos.title: Hulchul Refuses to Perform 'Jagrata'
videos.overview: The family invites everyone for 'jagrata' and starts the preparations. Happu tells them that Hulchul has refused to perform 'jagrata' due to Rajesh. Resham Pal threatens Happu that he will demote him.

videos.title: Rajesh Slaps Hulchul Again
videos.overview: At Happu's behest, Rajesh apologises to Hulchul. But, due to a misunderstanding, she slaps Hulchul again. Happu and Beni concoct a plan to pacify Hulchul, but they end up in trouble.

videos.title: Happu Disguises Himself as Hulchul
videos.overview: Happu devises a plan after spotting Kamlesh singing on the street. He organises Jagrata, which Reshampal and the DIG attend. Happu, disguised as Hulchul, sings hymns, but the DIG catches him.

videos.title: Gabbar and Amma Compete to Become a Special Officer
videos.overview: Reshampal makes an announcement on the news channel. Gabbar and Amma compete for the position of a Special Officer. Kat insults a boy, and he vows vengeance. Happu tells Reshampal about his condition.

videos.title: Amma Bribes the Commissioner
videos.overview: Happu tells Rajesh that Gabbar cannot be chosen as a Special Officer. Amma bribes the commissioner to get selected. Rajesh and Vimlesh get enraged with their husbands as Gabbar does not get selected.

videos.title: Amma Suspends Happu
videos.overview: Amma, who has become a special officer, suspends Happu. Rajesh promises to Gabbar that he will make him an officer. Kamlesh is arrested for stealing a watch. Happu is shocked to see Rajesh stealing.

videos.title: Rajesh Demands Amma's Resignation
videos.overview: Happu is furious at Rajesh for stealing, and Rajesh demands Amma's resignation. As Amma instructs Happu to stop Rajesh, he locks Rajesh in the room. Later, he finds Vimlesh in place of Rajesh.

videos.title: Amma Resigns from the Post of a Special Officer
videos.overview: Reshampal arrives to arrest Rajesh for stealing from his home. Amma saves Rajesh and resigns from the post of a special officer. On Karwa Chauth, Rajesh and Vimlesh teach their husbands a lesson.

videos.title: Rajesh Devises a Plan Against Amma
videos.overview: Amma taunts Rajesh and complains to Gabbar about his daughters. An enraged Rajesh devises a plan to teach Amma a lesson. At Rajesh's behest, Happu vows to obey her orders.

videos.title: Happu Humiliates Amma in Front of Everyone
videos.overview: Happu is in a dilemma due to the promise made to Rajesh. He humiliates Amma in front of everyone and orders her to do housework. The kids get upset with Happu for his behaviour with Amma.

videos.title: Rajesh Gets Amma to Apologise to Gabbar
videos.overview: Happu feels upset after insulting Amma. Reshampal orders Happu to arrest everyone who misbehaves with women. Scared of Rajesh, Amma ends up apologising to Gabbar.

videos.title: Reshampal Imprisons Happu
videos.overview: Reshampal imprisons Happu. Amma and Rajesh come up with a plan and get Happu released from jail. They accept their mistake and reconcile with each other. Later, they get into a fight again.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Gamble for Money
videos.overview: The family members ask Happu for expensive gifts. Vimlesh too asks Beni for a gold necklace. To get the money, Happu and Beni end up gambling. Happu’s kids decide to help a poor man, Sonu.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Lose Money in Gambling
videos.overview: Happu and Beni lose money in gambling and fail to purchase gifts for their families. Kamlesh agrees to help Rajesh with cleaning. Happu tells a lie to Amma, but she learns the truth.

videos.title: Manohar Shares a Plan with Happu and Beni
videos.overview: According to Manohar's plan, Beni and Happu deceive their wives. After discovering Happu's deception, Amma threatens him. While trying to help Happu and Beni, Manohar himself lands into trouble.

videos.title: A Plan to Rob Reshampal
videos.overview: Happu shows his family a video of him getting robbed. Amma forwards the video to Reshampal, who chastises Happu. Later, Manohar, Happu, and Beni go to rob Reshampal.

videos.title: Amma Fulfills Everyone's Demands
videos.overview: Reshampal thrashes Happu, Beni, and Manohar while they tell him about their helplessness. On Reshampal's advice, Happu and Beni reveal the truth to the family. Amma fulfills everyone's demands.

videos.title: A Drunk Gabbar Reveals a Secret
videos.overview: Rajesh gets a love letter written by Pitaji for Sulochana. She tells Vimlesh about the letter and Amma decides to teach them a lesson. Later, a drunk Gabbar reveals a secret to Amma.

videos.title: Happu and Beni are Shocked to Learn a Secret
videos.overview: As per Amma's plan, Kat and Kamlesh disguise themselves and put on an act in front of everyone. Beni and Happu get shocked on learning about Happu's marriage. Later, they get angry at their wives.

videos.title: A Way for Happu to Become an ACP
videos.overview: Kamlesh, posing as a baba, suggests a way for Happu to become an ACP. Rajesh believes that her marriage is in danger. Amma lies to Happu to persuade him to do the remedy, but Beni objects.

videos.title: Rajesh Locks Happu in a Room
videos.overview: Vimlesh and Beni complain to Rajesh about Happu. Rajesh ties up Happu and locks him in the room. Later, Pitaji makes Amma realise her mistake. Happu includes his children in his plans.

videos.title: Amma Gets Happu Remarried to Rajesh
videos.overview: Kamlesh and Kat are exposed. Happu reveals his plan. Amma apologises to Rajesh and gets Happu remarried with her. Later, Rajesh imposes a few conditions before taking 'Pheras'.

videos.title: Rajesh Feeds Everyone Boiled Food
videos.overview: Sunaina, Rajesh's friend, teaches everyone about health care. Happu praises Sunaina and insults Rajesh. Later, Rajesh makes nutritious and boiled food for everyone.

videos.title: Happu Feels Sad to Eat Boiled Food
videos.overview: Amma makes kebabs for the kids as they feel hungry at night, but Rajesh refuses to let them eat. Happu feels sad as he eats boiled food. Beni and Vimlesh bring food for Amma from the food festival.

videos.title: Happu Craves Delicious Food
videos.overview: Rajesh bans Amma's liquor. At night, she catches Amma, Happu, and the children secretly eating kebabs. Beni and Vimlesh go to the food festival. Later, Happu craves delicious food.

videos.title: Rajesh Realises Her Mistake
videos.overview: Sunaina visits the police station to file a complaint against her husband. Happu comes up with an idea to teach Rajesh a lesson, and Amma and the kids support him. Later, Rajesh realises her mistake.

videos.title: Happu Makes a Promise to the Children
videos.overview: Amma has a nightmare. The children ask Happu for gifts on Children’s Day. On Rajesh’s suggestion, Happu decides to take the children to see tigers. Reshampal gives some news to Happu and Manohar.

videos.title: Happu Takes His Kids on a Jungle Safari
videos.overview: Happu learns that all the tigers of Kanpur have been sent to the jungles of MP. Happu gives an idea to Beni to motivate Vimlesh. Later, he takes the kids on a jungle safari.

videos.title: The Lion's Arrival Scares Everyone
videos.overview: Kat shoots her modeling photographs in the forest. Beni, who is disguised as a lion, flees on seeing the real lion. The lion's arrival scares everyone. The news on TV shocks Amma, Rajesh, and Vimlesh.

videos.title: Everyone's Life Is in Danger
videos.overview: Everyone's life is in danger. When Amma, Rajesh and Vimlesh argue over going to the forest, an upset Reshampal arrives. Scared at the thought of dying, everyone thinks about their unfulfilled dreams.

videos.title: Happu Fights with the Lion
videos.overview: Reshampal agrees to go to the forest, but he gets a phone call from his wife. Happu fulfils his last wish and fights with the lion, following which, the lion faints and everyone returns home safely.

videos.title: Who Will Win the Lucky Draw?
videos.overview: Rajesh buys a lucky draw ticket in which the winner gets a trip to Rishikesh. Reshampal gives Happu a week off. Beni also buys a ticket. Later, the winner of the lucky draw is announced.

videos.title: An Argument Over Travelling to Rishikesh
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh argue with Happu over travelling to Rishikesh, so he offers Beni the tickets to Rishikesh. Happu asks Reshampal to cancel his leave, and Reshampal provides a solution to his problem.

videos.title: Happu's Plan to Cancel the Trip to Rishikesh
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh conspire to defeat each other in the competition. They force Reshampal to eat chhole despite his upset stomach. Happu comes up with a plan to cancel the trip to Rishikesh.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Won't be Able to Travel to Rishikesh
videos.overview: Happu fractures his leg to avoid going to Rishikesh. Amma and Rajesh's dream of visiting Rishikesh is shattered. Amma plans to take the entire family, excluding Happu and Beni, on a tour of Rishikesh.

videos.title: Rajesh's Visit to Her Maternal House Delights Happu
videos.overview: Happu gets delighted as Rajesh goes to her maternal house. Reshampal urges Happu to enjoy himself. Vimlesh takes over Rajesh's responsibility, but the family dislikes the food she prepares.

videos.title: Amma Demands Apologies from Her Daughters-In-Law
videos.overview: Amma forces Vimlesh to drink alcohol. A drunk Vimlesh tells Amma how much Rajesh disparages her. Amma records it and shows it to Happu. Later, she demands apologies from her daughters-in-law.

videos.title: Vimlesh Refuses to Apologise to Amma
videos.overview: Vimlesh does not apologise to Amma. On learning about Happu's predicament, Reshampal shares a plan with him. Amma makes Kamlesh do housework while training him. Later, she does not talk to Beni.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Start Fighting
videos.overview: Beni throws away the bottle of wine bought by Happu, and the duo starts fighting. Amma treats Kamlesh like a servant, and Dr. Udas gives him advice. Later, Reshampal tells another plan to Happu.

videos.title: Amma and Vimlesh Make a Revelation
videos.overview: After arguing with Happu, Beni decides to leave the house. Happu comes up with a plan to stop Beni. Later, Beni asks Vimlesh to apologise to Amma. Moreover, Amma and Vimlesh make a revelation.

videos.title: Rajesh Demands Happu to Buy a Car
videos.overview: Rajesh insists on Happu purchasing a car, but Amma opposes her. Malaika allows Kamlesh to stay at her house. Reshampal goes out for a few days and gives the responsibility of his car to Manohar.

videos.title: Happu Brings a Car Home
videos.overview: Vimlesh makes Rajesh envious with good news. Happu borrows Reshampal's car from Manohar. He lies to the family, and everyone goes for a ride. Reshampal calls Manohar to know the condition of his car.

videos.title: Amma Sells the Car
videos.overview: The family enjoys riding in the car. When Reshampal returns, he asks Happu and Manohar about his car. Meanwhile, Amma sells the car. Happu returns home and tells everyone the truth about the car.

videos.title: Happu Lies to Reshampal
videos.overview: Amma tells Happu that she has sold the car. As the car owner refuses to return the car, Happu lies to Reshampal that his car has been stolen. Later, Reshampal threatens Happu. Amma makes a revelation.

videos.title: The Children Narrate an Incident to Vimlesh
videos.overview: The children plan to party when the new car arrives. They tell Vimlesh about the chariot resort, where Ranbir celebrated his birthday. Everyone decides to go to the Chariot Resort in their new car.

videos.title: Rajesh Gets Humiliated
videos.overview: Kat tells Happu and Rajesh about her new job. Rajesh receives the parcel, but instead of Pucci sandals, something else arrives. As Rajesh gets humiliated in front of everyone, she threatens Happu.

videos.title: Vimlesh Demands Pucci Sandals
videos.overview: Happu contacts Pucci's customer service. Kat, who works there, dupes Happu and hangs up the phone. Karishma and Vimlesh mock Rajesh. Later, Vimlesh asks Beni for Pucci sandals.

videos.title: Rajesh Orders a Dress from Pucci
videos.overview: Rajesh orders a dress from Pucci for INR 70,000 to get her refund. When their demands are not fulfilled, the children exact vengeance on Happu. Benni devises a plan to avoid gifting Vimlesh sandals.

videos.title: Rajesh Gets Pucci Sandals and a Dress
videos.overview: Rajesh again falls prey to an online shopping scam. Kat helps in finding the online fraudster, Johnny Sharma. Later, Happu gifts Rajesh Pucci sandals and a dress.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh to Fight with Each Other
videos.overview: Rajesh and Amma have an argument and they fight with each other. The kids ask Happu for handcuffs for their school play. Later, Happu decides to judge the contest between Amma and Rajesh.

videos.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - December 20, 2022
videos.overview: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh Become Greedy
videos.overview: Happu notices Amma and Rajesh's handcuffs. Raka expresses his wish to make Amma wear his mother's gold bangles. Happu refuses to let Amma and Rajesh take the bangles, but they become greedy.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh's Handcuffs Are Unlocked
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh take the bangles from Raka. Reshampal learns about Happu's children's antics. Manohar comes with the key, which unlocks Amma and Rajesh's handcuffs. Raka flees from Happu's house.

videos.title: Where will Happu's Family Celebrate Christmas?
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh quarrel over going out during the Christmas holidays. Happu doesn't understand who he should support. Later, the family votes on whether to travel to Manali or Jabalpur.

videos.title: Happu's Family Leave for Manali
videos.overview: Kamlesh tells Kat about his new business. Happu votes for Rajesh and plans to celebrate Christmas in Manali. Later, Amma curses everyone, and they leave for Manali.

videos.title: Amma's Predictions Come True
videos.overview: Happu's family trip to Manali gets cancelled and Vimlesh blames Amma for it. Later, Amma's predictions come true once again, and the family enjoys Manali in Kanpur.

videos.title: The Family Members Tape Amma's Mouth
videos.overview: The family members tape Amma's mouth, which worsens her health. Rajesh gets terrified of Amma and makes a request to her. Later, Amma speaks something negative about Reshampal.

videos.title: Will Happu Win a Lottery of INR 100 Crore?
videos.overview: Beni advises Happu, who then decides to take advantage of Amma's situation. He buys a lottery ticket worth INR 100 crore. Later, the family discovers the reason behind Amma's prophecy coming true.

videos.title: Happu Eats an Omelette Made of Snake Eggs
videos.overview: Manohar accidentally feeds an omelette made of snake eggs to Happu. Naagin follows them to exact revenge. The next morning, Beni talks to Happu, and Malaika finds a snake outside the house.

videos.title: Naagin Threatens Happu with Revenge
videos.overview: Reshampal summons a snake to help Happu and Manohar. Naagin threatens Happu with revenge. Happu forbids his children from leaving the house and keeps watch over them at night.

videos.title: Happu Performs a Dance
videos.overview: Happu apologises to Nagin and makes a request to her. However, Nagin makes him dance in front of everyone. Furthermore, Happu, concerned about his family's safety, seeks help from Kamlesh.

videos.title: Nagin Injects Her Poison into Happu's Body
videos.overview: Nagin injects her poison into Happu's body, and he feels scared to shake hands with others. Karishma tells Rajesh that she witnessed Happu with a girl. Kamlesh stops Happu's children from going out.

videos.title: Happu Is Proved to be an Idiot
videos.overview: Happu's children deceive Kamlesh and go trekking in the forest. Chamchi returns home with bad news. Reshampal's niece Vishu wins the bet by proving Happu to be an idiot.

videos.title: Happu Teaches the Children with Beni's Help
videos.overview: Happu teaches the children with Beni's help, and Vimlesh tells Rajesh about it. Rajesh reveals Happu's deception and taunts Amma. Later, Amma reprimands Happu and Beni.

videos.title: Happu's Plan Against Masterji
videos.overview: Happu bribes Masterji and he punishes Happu. Amma assigns a task to Manohar. Happu intends to degrade Masterji's character. Later, Kamlesh records Masterji's video.

videos.title: Masterji Complains to Reshampal
videos.overview: As per Happu's plan, Beni and Kamlesh blackmail Masterji. Later, Masterji and his father complain about them to Reshampal, who arrests Beni and Kamlesh. Happu and the duo are then punished.

videos.title: Happu's Children Accept Masterji's Condition
videos.overview: Manohar beats up Happu, Beni and Kamlesh. Masterji lays a condition to the children, and Reshampal releases Happu, Beni and Kamlesh. The children study well, take the exam and get their results.

videos.title: Gupta Curses Happu
videos.overview: Rajesh, Vimlesh and Amma talk about their ex-lovers and later the trio gets a call from them. Elsewhere, Gupta curses Happu when the latter imprisons him.

videos.title: Rajesh, Vimlesh and Amma Meet Their Ex-Lovers
videos.overview: Rajesh, Vimlesh and Amma meet their respective ex-lovers. Amma sees Rajesh and Vimlesh and tells Happu about them. Later, Rajesh informs Happu about Amma and Bhatia. Happu overhears Kamlesh and Kat.

videos.title: Happu asks Gupta to Take Back His Curse
videos.overview: Happu asks Gupta to take back his curse. Jayesh and Suresh invite Rajesh and Vilmesh to the park. Amma also agrees to go to the park with Bhatia. Later, Gupta curses the commissioner.

videos.title: The Commissioner and Happu Serve Gupta
videos.overview: Kat and Kamlesh go camping. Rajesh, Vimlesh and Amma meet Jayesh, Suresh and Bhatia, respectively. Later, Beni warns Happu. The commissioner and Happu serve Gupta and ask him to take back his curse.

videos.title: Happu's Misunderstanding Is Cleared
videos.overview: Rajesh, Vimlesh and the others arrive at the hotel. Happu too arrives there, and his misunderstanding is cleared. Happu, Beni and Pitaji apologise to their wives. Later, Manohar exposes Gupta’s truth.

videos.title: A Secret Mission for Happu and Manohar
videos.overview: The commissioner assigns Happu and Manohar the secret mission of catching Johnny Briganza. Happu lies to Rajesh and reaches Munnibai's place with Manohar. Later, Rajesh discovers Happu's deception.

videos.title: Rajesh Asks Beni to Spy on Happu
videos.overview: Rajesh informs Amma about Happu's deception. She asks Beni to spy on Happu. Beni follows Happu, who lies to everyone at home and goes to the grave. Meanwhile, Rajesh and Amma watch Happu's video.

videos.title: Beni's Plan to Teach Happu a Lesson
videos.overview: When Rajesh asks questions, Happu reveals his flaws. Beni tells Rajesh about a plan to teach Happu a lesson. Later, Amma and Rajesh go to Munnibai's place and ask her to join their plan.

videos.title: Happu Is Angered on Seeing Rajesh at a Brothel
videos.overview: Happu is shocked to see Rajesh at a brothel and later, fight at home. He informs Amma about it but she defends Rajesh. Rajesh and Beni pull off a pretence at the brothel to make Happu jealous.

videos.title: Happu Tells Rajesh the Truth about the Mission
videos.overview: Rajesh and Amma continue the pretence in front of Happu. Reshampal frees Happu from his oath and Happu tells Rajesh the reason behind coming to the brothel. Johnny Briganza escapes the police.

videos.title: Pitaji Tells Amma about the Hidden Treasure
videos.overview: Rajesh asks Happu to accompany her to Goa for her birthday. Pitaji tells Amma about the hidden treasure in the house. Amma informs the family of this secret, and Rajesh cancels her trip to Goa.

videos.title: Happu Digs His House for the Treasure

videos.overview: Rajesh and Amma start fighting while trying to resolve Hrithik and Chamchi's argument. Happu aggravates the situation by siding with Rajesh against Amma and vice versa. He advises Manohar.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh to Teach Happu a Lesson
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh realise Happu's plan. Watching Kumar's acting, they come up with a plan, and seek Kumar's help to teach Happu a lesson. The children also join them in their plan.

videos.title: Changu Dev Maharaj Appears in Front of Kamlesh
videos.overview: Witnessing Amma transformed into Rajesh and vice versa, everyone is shocked. Happu decides to go to the temple of Changu Dev Maharaj with Beni. Changu Dev Maharaj appears in front of Kamlesh.

videos.title: Happu Meets Changu Dev
videos.overview: Rajesh and Amma rejoice over the success of their plan. Happu meets Changu Dev, who tells him about his curse. Happu speaks negatively about Amma to Rajesh and criticises Rajesh in front of Amma.

videos.title: Happu Discovers Changu Dev's Ploy
videos.overview: Happu discovers Changu Dev's ploy. Later, he suggests sending Amma to an old age home and decides to divorce Rajesh, leaving them shocked. Rajesh apologises to Happu, who then beats up Changu Dev.

videos.title: Kat Worries about Gaining Weight
videos.overview: Rajesh calls Happu during the encounter. Happu decides on the home menu, and Kate worries about her weight. Later, Happu and Rajesh are troubled about cooking the children's favourite vegetables.

videos.title: Happu's Kids Refuse to Eat Food
videos.overview: Reshampal discovers that Manohar is working for Happu instead of being at the police station. Kat prepares her diet plan with Kamlesh. The kids refuse to eat potato-pea curry, which enrages Happu.

videos.title: Happu Steals Buns from the Bakery
videos.overview: Jitu refuses to give Happu the buns from his bakery, showing how close his relationship is with Reshampal. Happu goes to Reshampal for help, but doesn't get any. Later, he steals the buns with Beni.

videos.title: The Kids Refuse to Eat Burgers
videos.overview: Rajesh makes burgers from the buns stolen by Happu, but the kids refuse to eat them. Kamlesh eats sweet while jogging with Kat. When shooting Shakal, Happu asks Manohar to deliver mutton to his house.

videos.title: Happu Realises His Mistake
videos.overview: The children request Happu to make Lasagna pasta, leading to a misunderstanding. When the food is not served on time, Amma's health deteriorates. Happu realises his mistake and apologises to Rajesh.

videos.title: Rajesh Worries about the Cold Wave News
videos.overview: On hearing the news of a cold wave, Rajesh asks Happu to get a heater and Kamlesh seeks space at Kat's house. Happu is upset due to a shortage of heaters. Amma highlights the benefits of cold weather.

videos.title: Happu Plans a Trip to Lucknow with Rajesh
videos.overview: Shakal promises to provide heaters to Happu and Reshampal in exchange for his bail. Kamlesh helps Happu with household chores to stay in his house. Later, Happu plans a trip to Lucknow with Rajesh.

videos.title: Happu Goes to Get the Heater from Kalpana
videos.overview: The doctor arrives to see Amma and demands a heater. Happu and Beni go to get it from Kalpana. Master asks for a heater in exchange for passing Hrithik and Ranbir. Happu and Reshampal learn a truth.

videos.title: Amma's Way to Stay Safe from Heatwaves
videos.overview: Happu and Beni tell their wives about Kalpana's condition. Amma suggests a way to stay safe from heatwaves. Happu blackmails Kamlesh and asks him to do a task, putting Kamlesh in trouble.

videos.title: Shakal Sends a Heater to Shakal's House
videos.overview: Happu and Beni go to the jungle to bring Kamlesh, who goes to gather firewood. Reshampal takes the firewood from Happu. Happu curses Shakal and he sends him a heater. A piece of news shocks everyone.

videos.title: Happu Expresses His Anger
videos.overview: Happu scolds the kids and Rajesh. Later, he lashes out unnecessarily at Beni and beats up Reshampal's brother-in-law. Rajesh sings a song to pacify him. Soon, Happu beats up the paan vendor.

videos.title: The Family Devises a Plan to Control Happu's Anger
videos.overview: The family devises a plan to control Happu's anger. Masterji completes the children's duties. Pitaji takes pride in Happu's anger, and Happu resolves never to reduce his anger.

videos.title: Can Mukti Anand Calm Happu's Anger?
videos.overview: Ranbir pretends to point a gun at Hrithik in front of Happu. However, Happu takes pride in Ranbir's anger. Reshampal seeks the help of Guru Mukti Anand to control Happu's anger.

videos.title: Happu's Children Kill Masterji
videos.overview: The children inform Happu that they have killed Masterji. Beni refuses to help Happu. Masterji's wife complains about his disappearance, and Reshampal asks Happu to find him.

videos.title: Happu Faces Punishment for Getting Angry
videos.overview: Masterji's ghost scares Happu and Reshampal arrests Happu's kids for Masterji's murder. Happu realises the impact of teaching wrong lessons to his kids, and the family tells him about their act.

videos.title: Happu Keeps an Eye on His Children
videos.overview: Amma and the kids plan a party for Happu on his birthday. Upon hearing the news, Happu keeps an eye on his kids and informs Rajesh about Hrithik's actions. Kat tells Kamlesh about getting a job.

videos.title: Happu and Rajesh Blame Each Other
videos.overview: Rajesh notices a whiskey bottle with Hrithik and Ranbir. Kat informs Rajesh that she wants to stay away from the family to work. Later, Happu and Rajesh blame each other for the children's misconduct.

videos.title: Happu and Rajesh Worry about Children
videos.overview: Happu and Rajesh worry about the children. Kat seeks a favour from Kamlesh, but Rajesh catches Kat's lie. Happu and Rajesh seek help from Beni and Vimlesh to keep an eye on the children.

videos.title: Happu Learns about His Children's Actions
videos.overview: Happu, Beni and Rajesh try to teach the children. Beni sees Chamchi accepting a flower from a boy. Manohar sees Hrithik, and Ranbir playing cards. Later, they both inform Happu about his children.

videos.title: Happu Gets a Birthday Surprise
videos.overview: Happu is unhappy about not providing a proper upbringing to the children. He beats up the boys who give a flower to Chamchi and offer alcohol to Hrithik. The children give Happu a birthday surprise.

videos.title: Happu's Plan to Surprise the Children
videos.overview: The children get upset with Happu, and he comes up with a plan to resolve their grievances. Amma informs the children about Happu's plan. Happu requests Manohar to bring a Santa Claus costume for him.

videos.title: Kamlesh Becomes a Thief to Fulfil Kat's Wishes
videos.overview: Happu's kids prepare their wishlist. Kat hands her wishlist to Kamlesh, who then steals a stranger's chain to fulfil her wishes. Happu asks a tailor to stitch a Santa Claus dress.

videos.title: Kamlesh Performs a Theft at Beni's House
videos.overview: The kids make a Christmas tree. Kamlesh, disguised as Santa, performs a theft at Beni's house. Resham Pal asks Happu to find the thief. Manohar gives Happu a suggestion to arrange Santa's dress.

videos.title: Happu Fails to Get a Santa Claus Costume
videos.overview: Happu buys gifts for the children for Christmas but fails to get a Santa Claus costume. Amma informs the children about this, and they get upset. At night, a dream leaves Happu scared.

videos.title: Happu Becomes the Santa for His Children
videos.overview: Happu's children feel sad when they don't find gifts near the Christmas tree. Kamlesh gives gifts to Kat. When Happu fails to get Santa's costume, he devises a plan and gives gifts to the children.

videos.title: Happu and Beni's Plan for the New Year
videos.overview: Happu's family prepares to celebrate the New Year at home. Later, Beni suggests Happu to go to a club for the New Year's party. Kat promises to help Kamlesh find a job.

videos.title: Happu and Beni's Photos Are Printed in the Newspaper
videos.overview: Happu and Beni return home late after the party. Kat asks Happu to help Kamlesh secure a job in the police force. Happu and Beni's photos are printed in the newspaper. Gabbar informs Amma about this.

videos.title: Amma Punishes Happu and Beni
videos.overview: When Happu's lie is exposed, the family becomes upset with him. Vimlesh, enraged at Beni, ousts him from the house, and Rajesh beats up Happu. Amma punishes Happu and Beni.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Get Punished
videos.overview: Due to his punishment, Happu fails to reject any demands from his family. Reshampal promotes Manohar, and Happu asks Reshampal to fulfil his promise. Even Beni has to suffer the punishment.

videos.title: Happu Apologises for His Mistake
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh argue, and they decide to send each other to their respective maternal homes. Reshampal fires Manohar and gives his position to Kamlesh. Happu apologises to Rajesh and Amma.

videos.title: Beni Loses Happu's Father's Old Case
videos.overview: Beni loses an old case related to Happu's father. The court orders Happu to deposit INR 2 crore. Later, Beni suggests a trick to Happu's family to avoid depositing the money.

videos.title: Happu's Family Pretends to Be Poor
videos.overview: Manohar is made the observer of Happu's case. Happu's family pretends to be poor. Happu asks a man for a bribe and Resham Pal suspends him. Beni gives a news to Happu.

videos.title: Happu Hides His Black Money
videos.overview: Happu buries his black money in a pit to hide it, but Manohar sees it. Reshampal arrives to seize Happu's black money. Later, everyone gets startled on finding the money and jewellery missing.

videos.title: Beni Ousts Happu's Family from His House
videos.overview: Everyone rejoices as the kids bring money and jewellery in front of Happu. Beni ousts Happu’s family, and the kids work on the streets. Manohar records a video of them. Gabbar arrives to meet Rajesh.

videos.title: Beni Shares Good News
videos.overview: Happu falls into Reshampal's trap and is arrested. Meanwhile, Beni shares good news with Happu's family. The family members apologise to Pitaji and celebrate Makar Sankranti.

videos.title: Happu Becomes ACP
videos.overview: Due to a lack of progress in the job, Happu loses faith in God. Rajesh arranges 'Bhajan' in the house for Happu's progress. Happu becomes ACP but gives credit to himself instead of giving it to God.

videos.title: Happu Becomes Arrogant on Becoming the ACP
videos.overview: Happu becomes arrogant on becoming the ACP and doesn’t take Beni along to the party. On his way to the party, Happu meets a boy, Keshav. Later, Happu’s behaviour upsets Rajesh.

videos.title: An Egoistic Happu Talks Rudely with His Family
videos.overview: Reshampal recommends his nephew to Happu for a job. Beni talks to Rajesh about Happu's egoistic nature. Later, Happu talks rudely to his family members, which upsets Rajesh.

videos.title: Happu's Children Bring Keshav Home
videos.overview: Happu punishes Manohar. Rajesh prays to Lord Krishna to give wisdom to Happu. Happu's children meet Keshav, and they bring him home. Rajesh hires Keshav for work.

videos.title: Keshav Wins Everyone's Hearts
videos.overview: Keshav resolves the problems of Happu's family and wins their hearts. Amma's health deteriorates, but Happu ignores her. Rajesh prays to Lord Krishna to prevent Happu from displaying arrogance.

videos.title: Happu Asks Kamlesh to Leave the House
videos.overview: Hapu warns Kamlesh to leave his house within two days. Kamlesh shares this information with Kat. Gabbar seeks financial help from Happu to expand his business, but Hapu humiliates him.

videos.title: Keshav Tries to Reason with Happu
videos.overview: Rajesh tells Keshav about Happu's actions and he tries to reason with Happu. Later, Rajesh prays to God to teach Happu a lesson. Kat gives Kamlesh a suggestion to stay in her house.

videos.title: Happu Ousts Amma from the House
videos.overview: Kamlesh fails to please Happu. Keshav gives Kat a suggestion to ensure that Happu is unable to oust Kamlesh from the house. Later, Happu ousts Amma from the house and Beni takes her to his house.

videos.title: Happu Ousts Kamlesh From the House
videos.overview: Amma narrates Beni a story, and it reminds her of Happu. Kamlesh unknowingly makes a mistake and Happu ousts him from the house. Rajesh asks Amma to come back home, but she refuses.

videos.title: Kat Marries Kamlesh and Brings Him Home
videos.overview: Rajesh tries to convince Amma to return home. On Keshav's advice, Kat marries Kamlesh and brings him to her house. Later, Amma asks Happu to accept their relationship.

videos.title: Happu Doesn't Go to Rajesh's House
videos.overview: Happu tells Kamlesh the rules of the house. Later, he makes up a story about having important work and doesn't go to Rajesh's house. Rajesh finds out Happu lied to her by reading a newspaper article.

videos.title: Kat Tries to Make Breakfast for Kamlesh
videos.overview: Kat tries to make tea and parathas for Kamlesh. The Paan shop owner humiliates Beni in front of Happu. At the police station, Happu tells Reshampal and Manohar about his party with the minister.

videos.title: Happu Gets Defamed by a News Article
videos.overview: Happu does a favour for Shakal's sister Guddi, and she thanks him by kissing him. Gabbar requests Happu to inaugurate his shop. Later, Happu gets defamed by a news article in the newspaper.

videos.title: Happu Worries about His Defamation
videos.overview: Happu resolves to prove himself innocent. He goes to seek Guddi's help but ends up getting defamed. Gabbar cancels his plan to let Happu inaugurate his shop. Upset, Happu then goes to Beni.

videos.title: Happu Learns the Consequences of His Bad Attitude
videos.overview: Happu learns the consequences of his bad attitude and seeks forgiveness from God for his mistake. Guddi clarifies the matter in a media interview. The family also forgives Happu for his actions.

videos.title: The Kids Give Happu a Challenge
videos.overview: At night, Happu dresses up as a ghost and scares the kids and Rajesh. The kids challenge Happu to spend a night in the crematorium. Reshampal asks Bhalla to hold onto his INR 50 lakhs of black money.

videos.title: Happu Is Possessed by Bhalla's Spirit
videos.overview: Happu and Beni spend the night with Bhalla in jail instead of the crematorium. Happu is possessed by Bhalla's spirit. Manohar hides the truth about Bhalla's death from Reshampal.

videos.title: Happu Flirts with Vimlesh
videos.overview: Happu flirts with Vimlesh and Beni gets into an argument with Happu. Manohar feels scared when Bhalla dies and lies to Reshampal about Bhalla. Meanwhile, Kamlesh gets a job.

videos.title: Pitaji Suspects that Happu Is Possessed
videos.overview: Pitaji suspects that Happu is possessed. Happu asks Vimlesh to run away with him. Beni and Vimlesh complain to Amma and Rajesh about Happu. Amma informs Rajesh about Pitaji's suspicion.

videos.title: Happu Is Free of Bhalla's Spirit
videos.overview: The family members learn that Bhalla has possessed Happu. They follow Keshav's advice, and Bhalla leaves Happu's body. Reshampal and Manohar are surprised to see Bhalla alive.

videos.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh's Valentine's Day Wishes
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh share their Valentine's Day wishes with their husbands. Kat tells Kamlesh to find a job. Hritik and Ranbir see Chamchi talking to a boy in school.

videos.title: Beni Couldn't Take Vimlesh to Dinner
videos.overview: Happu books a table for dinner with Rajesh. However, Beni is unable to book a table due to a lack of money. Later, on Valentine's night, Benny returns home drunk, which upsets Vimlesh.

videos.title: Beni Gets a Good Job Opportunity
videos.overview: Rajesh gets upset with Happu for not lending money to Beni. Later, Beni seeks help from a prominent lawyer, who offers him a job opportunity in Chennai. Beni and Vimlesh prepare to shift to Chennai.

videos.title: Amma's Act to Prevent Beni from Leaving
videos.overview: Happu considers Manohar his friend and spends time with him. Amma pretends to be sick to stop Beni from leaving, but Beni realises her act. Later, Amma refuses to let Beni go away.

videos.title: Happu Plans to Prevent Beni from Going to Chennai
videos.overview: Vimlesh packs his belongings for his trip to Chennai. Happu plans to prevent Beni from going to Chennai. When Vimlesh and Beni bid goodbye to everyone, Sundaram Nayar accuses Beni of being dishonest.

videos.title: Ranbir Brags about Being the Son of an ACP
videos.overview: Happu discourages Malaika from joining the police force. Kamlesh gets a job interview call. Ranbir brags about being the son of an ACP, and Chamchi complains to Happu about him.

videos.title: Ranbir Is Not Happu's Son
videos.overview: A man tells Ranbir that he is not Happu's son. An upset Ranbir shares this news with his family, and Happu decides to find out the truth. Ranbir accuses Happu and Rajesh of discriminating against him.

videos.title: Happu is Unaware of Ranbir's Favourite Colour
videos.overview: Happu tells Manohar to find the person who told Ranbir the truth. Later, he brings clothes of their favourite colours for the kids. Happu not knowing his favourite colour upsets the Ranbir.

videos.title: Ranbir's Name Is Struck Off from School
videos.overview: Ranbir's name is struck off from school for unpaid fees. Kamlesh wears a stolen shirt for an interview but gets into trouble. Happu beats up the man who tells the truth to Ranbir.

videos.title: Ranbir Discovers the Truth
videos.overview: Ranbir leaves the house. Keshav convinces him to return home, and later, Ranbir learns the truth. After receiving her exam results, Malaika bids goodbye to everyone and leaves for training.

videos.title: Rajesh and Happu's Argument
videos.overview: Rajesh and Happu have an argument. Chamchi strikes a deal with Ranbir. Rajesh gets upset with Happu over him not knowing her likes-dislikes. Chamchi plans to go for a movie with Sanket.

videos.title: The Family Teaches Happu a Lesson
videos.overview: Rajesh prevents Ranbir and Chamchi from fighting with each other and tells them the truth. The family teaches Happu a lesson by pretending to plot to kill him. Happu tries to pacify an upset Rajesh.

videos.title: Happu Becomes a Police Inspector Again
videos.overview: Malaika informs Rajesh over the phone that she has completed her training. While Kat gets a job, Keshav bids farewell to Happu's family. Happu becomes a police inspector again after being demoted.

videos.title: Malaika Becomes an IPS Officer
videos.overview: Malaika comes home as an IPS officer. Later, Malaika saves Reshampal from the escaped criminal Maglu, and Reshampal feels proud of her. The family hosts a party for Malaika who becomes an IPS officer.

videos.title: Happu Argues with Malaika over a Case
videos.overview: At the police station, Kusum complains to Malaika about a street poet. Malaika summons the poet to the police station, where he explains his side of the story. Happu argues with Malaika over the case.

videos.title: Malaika Seeks Vimlesh's Help
videos.overview: Rajesh tries to resolve the argument between Happu and Malaika. Happu attempts to learn Urdu to solve the case of the poet. Meanwhile, Malaika seeks help from Vimlesh to solve the case.

videos.title: Malaika Resolves the Case of the Poet
videos.overview: Beni feels that Vimlesh is betraying him. Malaika resolves the case of the poet on the way, and Reshampal praises her. Later, she clears Beni's misunderstanding by telling him the truth.

videos.title: Malaika Threatens to Demote Happu
videos.overview: Happu refuses to fulfil the family's demands and becomes angry at their unnecessary expenses. Later, he demands a bribe from an ice cream vendor. Malaika threatens to demote Happu to discipline him.

videos.title: The Money Is Stolen from Happu's Safe
videos.overview: Happu suspects Ranbir to have stolen money from the safe. Pran files a complaint against Pappu Nath, and Malaika assigns this case to Happu. Later, someone again steals money from Happu's safe.

videos.title: Happu Frisks Rajesh on Suspicion of Theft
videos.overview: Happu calls Pran's wife Anju to the police station. He then frisks Rajesh on suspicion of theft. Rajesh complains to Amma about Happu. Pran comes to the police station to complain about Pappu.

videos.title: Happu Suspects Amma of Stealing
videos.overview: Despite keeping watch over Happu's safe, money is stolen from it. Happu suspects Amma and asks Rajesh to frisk her. To resolve Pran's case, Happu asks Pran to divorce Anju as a solution.

videos.title: Malaika Catches the Thief
videos.overview: Malaika catches a thief stealing money at night. The ice-cream vendor tells Happu the reason for seeking revenge. As Pran's case is solved, Happu is saved from demotion and apologises to the family.

videos.title: The Minister's Son Develops Animosity towards Malaika
videos.overview: The minister's son, Bantu, develops animosity towards Malaika. Ranbir plans to celebrate Holi with Simran at school. To take revenge on Malaika, Bantu applies colours to Rajesh and Amma and flees.

videos.title: Happu's Family Becomes Desperate for Water
videos.overview: Due to Bantu, Happu's family becomes desperate for water. Happu's children plead with Masterji to keep the school open on Holi. Rajesh suspects a conspiracy behind the water shortage at home.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh Bathe in Alcohol
videos.overview: Beni arranges for water, but Bantu spills it. Unable to find water, Amma and Rajesh bathe in alcohol, but Bantu again applies colour to them. Ranbir tricks Simran into calling her to school on Holi.

videos.title: Malaika Catches Hold of Bantu and Beats Him
videos.overview: Beni arranges water for Amma and Rajesh. Happu's children convince Masterji to keep the school open on Holi. Later, Malaika beats Bantu who was trying to smear colour on Amma and Rajesh.

videos.title: Happu's Family Enjoy the Colours of Holi
videos.overview: Malaika forgives Bantu when he apologises to her. She later solves the case and celebrates Holi with her family. At school, Masterji catches Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi playing Holi with Simreet.

videos.title: Rajesh's Plan for Amma's Birthday
videos.overview: Rajesh plans something for Amma's birthday and stops her from going shopping. Tinku goes to the police station to complain about his neighbour. Amma is surprised to see Rajesh in the jewellery shop.

videos.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Lie to Amma
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh return from the bazaar and lie to Amma. After seeing Jang Bahadur, Tinku's neighbour, Happu feels that he is not capable of hitting Tinku. Happu seeks Beni's help for his problem.

videos.title: Amma Complains to Happu about Rajesh
videos.overview: Amma complains to Happu that Rajesh has cut down her expenses, and Happu talks to her. Tinku again comes to lodge a police complaint against Jung Bahadur. Beni talks to Malaika about Happu.

videos.title: Happu Interrogates Jung Bahadur's Mother
videos.overview: Reshampal and Malaika stop Happu from interrogating Jung Bahadur strictly. After hearing Rajesh, Amma devises a plan. Happu sees Jung Bahadur running in the bazaar and interrogates his mother.

videos.title: Malaika Solves Jang Bahadur's Case
videos.overview: Amma follows Rajesh and Vimlesh. Malaika tells Happu that Jang Bahadur hates the red colour, and that's why he was beating Tinku. Tinku tells Amma that Rajesh has gone shopping for her.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh Get into a Fight
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh get into a fight, but Happu helps them reconcile. Later, a man comes to the police station to complain against his landlord, and Happu suggests a solution to his problem.

videos.title: Happu's Plan Backfires on Him
videos.overview: As Amma and Rajesh get into an argument again, Happu comes up with a plan. However, Happu's strategy backfires on him. In the police station, Malaika warns Happu upon seeing his anger towards Manohar.

videos.title: Happu Is fed Up of Rajesh and Amma's Fight
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh argue again. Malaika rebukes Happu for talking rudely to the complainant at the police station. Later, Rajesh and Amma vent their anger on Happu, leaving him frustrated.

videos.title: Masterji Vents His Anger at Happu
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh reconcile for the sake of Happu. Masterji gets angry with Chamchi and Ranbir's actions and calls Happu to school to vent his anger. Beni tells Happu the solution to his problem.

videos.title: Happu's Advice to All the Husbands
videos.overview: Happu instigates Amma and Rajesh against each other. Malaika solves the case between the landlord and the tenant. Rajesh and Amma vent their anger at Happu and Happu gives advice to all the husbands.

videos.title: Amma and Rajesh's Plan to Become Famous
videos.overview: Amma and Rajesh plan to become famous after seeing Vimal and Beni making videos. In the police station, a man complains about Hakikat Khureshi, a resident of his colony, whose dreams turn true.

videos.title: Hakikat's Dream Comes True
videos.overview: When Happu's children arrive late to school, Masterji asks them to call their parents. Hakikat has a dream about Happu, and Happu gets worried as his dream comes true. The children lie to Masterji.

videos.title: Rajesh Makes a Video of Her Murder
videos.overview: Rajesh decides to make a video of her murder at Amma's hands and Ranbir and Chamchi come up with an idea. Hakikat tells Happu a riddle. Happu is shocked to see Amma attacking Rajesh with a knife.

videos.title: Happu's Sleep Is Disturbed by Hakikat's Dreams
videos.overview: Happu, troubled by Hakikat's dreams, decides not to let Hakikat sleep. However, Hakikat falls asleep in the police station and dreams about Happu again. Happu is scared to see Rajesh attacking Amma.

videos.title: Happu Is Free of Hakikat's Dreams
videos.overview: Malaika suspends Manohar for torturing Hakikat. Thereafter, Hakikat sees another dream about Happu. Amma and Rajesh concoct a drama of Happu's murder. Later, Happu is free of Hakikat's dreams.

videos.title: Masterji's Plan to Get a Home Loan
videos.overview: Following Vimlesh's advice, Rajesh sets a rule for Happu. Singer Pintu lodges a complaint against his music teacher, Pakhawaj. Masterji tells Chamchi and Ranbir his plan to get a home loan.

videos.title: Happu Gets Pintu Beaten Up
videos.overview: Masterji uses Happu's name in front of the bank officials for the loan, but Happu does not answer his call. Happu gets Pintu beaten up by Manohar to bring pain in his voice and tells Beni his problem.

videos.title: Happu Becomes Pinkia for Pintu
videos.overview: Happu once again fails to answer Masterji's call. Amma teaches the kids about Rama Navami. Happu devises a plan to inflict pain in Pintu's voice, and he becomes Pinkia to call Pintu.

videos.title: Happu's Trick Lands Him in Trouble
videos.overview: Happu's trick to solve Pintu's case lands him in trouble. Masterji threatens to fail Chamchi and Ranbir in the exams if he does not get the loan. Later, Rajesh refuses to help Happu.

videos.title: Pintu Sings a Heart-Wrenching Song
videos.overview: Amma meets Pintu in the guise of Pinkiya to help Happu, but Pintu falls for her. Happu is forced to tell Pintu the truth, which breaks his heart. Later, Pintu sings a heart-wrenching song.

videos.title: Happu Gets a Sensitive Case
videos.overview: Malaika instructs Happu to solve the case sensitively. Later, Happu comes across a case of a woman attempting suicide. At school, Shreya talks to Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi about her problem.

videos.title: Hapus Befriends Pari
videos.overview: Amma is surprised to see Happu's growing love for Rajesh. Pari again thinks of committing suicide. Happu, disguised as Hapus, befriends Pari. Amma plans a doubt in Rajesh's mind about Happu.

videos.title: Rajesh Grows Suspicious of Happu
videos.overview: Rajesh detects the scent of perfume on Happu's body and grows suspicious. She asks Beni to spy on Happu. Hrithik overhears Happu talking to Pari and relays the information to Chamki and Ranbir.

videos.title: Rajesh Learns about Happu's Actions
videos.overview: Happu goes to watch a movie with Pari, and Beni takes their photo. Rajesh and Amma are surprised to learn about Happu's affair. Rajesh also informs the children about Happu's actions.

videos.title: Rajesh Confronts Pari and Happu
videos.overview: Happu brings a bangle for Rajesh, but she doesn't talk to him nicely. Later, she catches Happu with Pari and confronts them. Pari reveals the truth in front of everyone, and they feel proud of Happu.

videos.title: KK to Trap Malaika In His Plan
videos.overview: The Commissioner informs Malaika and Happu about JK's gang. JK's son, KK, decides to trap Malaika in his plan. Amma reveals her desire to Rajesh. KK deliberately gets himself arrested.

videos.title: KK Flirts with Malaika
videos.overview: The children ask Happu to increase their pocket money. Malaika sees KK's wounds, and KK flirts with her. Later, Amma meets a person named Sunny in the market, and they become friends.

videos.title: Pitaji Assigns Happu a Task
videos.overview: Rajesh tells Happu that Amma is having an affair. Amma informs Pitaji about Sunny. Pitaji assigns Happu the task of keeping Sunny away from Amma. Happu asks Chamchi to keep an eye on Amma.

videos.title: Malaika's Wish to Get Married
videos.overview: Chamchi informs the family about Amma and Sunny's romance. KK, who is in custody, flirts with Malaika. Malaika tells Rajesh that she wants to get married. At Pitaji's behest, Manohar slaps Happu.

videos.title: Malaika Arrests JK
videos.overview: Amma tells the truth to Sunny and ends their friendship. Malaika’s plan to nab JK succeeds and Reshampal praises her. Later, Amma pacifies an angry Pitaji.

videos.title: Happu Is Happy with Astrologer Pintu's Prediction
videos.overview: Manohar doesn't get a half-day leave from the police station. Babbu complains to Happu about astrologer Pintu. Rajesh starts her cooking channel. Happu is pleased with astrologer Pintu's prediction.

videos.title: Chef Pintu Tells Happu the Way to Success
videos.overview: Happu makes a promise to Rajesh. Chef Pintu tells Happu that he is not getting success because of Rajesh and offers a solution. Happu tells Beni about Chef Pintu, and Vimlesh overhears them.

videos.title: Rajesh Parts Ways with Happu
videos.overview: Happu urges Rajesh to part ways with him. Upset Rajesh leaves the house and goes to stay with Vimlesh. A criminal, Kamalkant, escapes from jail, and Reshampal threatens to suspend Happu and Manohar.

videos.title: Happu's Bad Days Start
videos.overview: Happu's fortune takes a turn for the worse and he gets suspended. Rajesh creates a video for her cooking channel, which becomes famous. Amma comes up with an idea to make Happu realise his mistake.

videos.title: Amma Persuades Rajesh to Return Home
videos.overview: An Astrologer reveals the truth about Pintu to Happu. Chef Ranjeev offers Rajesh to work with him, but she declines. Happu apologises to Rajesh, and Amma persuades Rajesh to return home.

videos.title: Rajesh Mocks Happu for Getting Older
videos.overview: As Happu's back aches, Rajesh playfully mocks him about getting older. Reshampal arrests Pappu, who is adept at wooing women. Masterji asks Chamchi and Ranbir to bring Happu to school.

videos.title: Beni and Happu Tell the Doctor about Their Problem
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh's friend, Urja, mistakes Happu for Rajesh's father-in-law. Chamchi and Ranbir reach school without Happu and lie to the teacher. Beni and Happu go to the doctor with their problem.

videos.title: Pappu Gives Happu a Fitness Tip
videos.overview: Happu is shocked to learn about Pappu's age. Amma tells Rajesh a secret. Chamchi and Ranbir threaten the ice cream seller to dress up as Happu and come to the school. Pappu gives Happu a fitness tip.

videos.title: Happu Starts Following a Diet Plan
videos.overview: In the bazaar, the bangle vendor mistakes Beni for Vimlesh's father and Beni gets angry. Happu eats boiled food and pleases Rajesh with Pappu's help. Later, Happu tells Beni about Pappu.

videos.title: Malaika Advises Happu and Beni to Stay Fit
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vimalesh realise that their husbands are trying to make them happy by learning poetries from Pappu. They teach their husbands a lesson. Malaika advises Happu and Beni to stay fit.

videos.title: Whose Maternal Family Is More Powerful?
videos.overview: On seeing Happu working in the kitchen, Amma argues with Rajesh. Later, Rajesh and Amma challenge each other to see whose maternal family is powerful. Elsewhere, Chamchi and Ranbir lie to Masterji.

videos.title: Rajesh Tells Gabbar about Her Challenge to Amma
videos.overview: Gabbar, who comes to Rajesh's house, flaunts his bravery. Happu fails to solve Gyanchakshu's dispute with his landlord. Rajesh tells Gabbar about her challenge to Amma. Tinku arrives at Amma's house.

videos.title: Gabbar Is Scared by Tinku's Strength
videos.overview: Gabbar, scared by Tinku's strength, asks Rajesh to avoid arranging a fight with him. Reshampal pressures Happu to resolve the Gyanchakshu case and Happu puts his landlord in jail.

videos.title: Happu Apprehends Tinku in a False Case
videos.overview: Rajesh's attempt to stop the rivalry between Gabbar and Tinku fails. Later, as per Beni's plan, Happu apprehends Tinku in a false case. Amma visits the police station to secure Tinku's release.

videos.title: Gabbar Wins the Fight Due to Happu's Plan
videos.overview: Vimlesh tells Happu about Rajesh's threat to go to her maternal home. A fight erupts between Tinku and Gabbar. Gabbar wins the fight due to Happu's plan. Amma learns about Happu and Rajesh's plot.

videos.title: Ranbir Is Punished for Writing a Love Letter
videos.overview: Happu punishes Ranbir after reading his love letter. Beni shares a secret with Ranbir and Chamchi. Reshampal puts a tantric behind bars. Ranbir decides to summon Bhaddi’s spirit to question her.

videos.title: Bhaddi's Spirit Possesses Vimlesh
videos.overview: Manohar explains to Happu how to punish Buddha Baba in jail. Chamchi and Ranbir summon Bhaddi's spirit, which later possesses Vimlesh. A frightened Beni then informs Happu about it.

videos.title: Happu and Beni Are Frightened by Bhaddi's Spirit
videos.overview: Happu and Beni, frightened by Bhaddi's spirit, inform Rajesh about her. Bhaddi starts haunting Happu, and Amma suggests a solution to get rid of her. Later, Bhaddi plots to kill Rajesh.

videos.title: Bhaddi's Spirit Wants to Marry Happu
videos.overview: Beni saves Rajesh’s life. At the police station, Happu tries to revive Ujaad Buddhi Baba who had fainted due to Happu’s torture. Later, Bhaddi’s spirit asks Happu to kill Rajesh and marry her.

videos.title: Rajesh Saves Happu From Bhaddi
videos.overview: Chamchi informs the family that Ranbir has summoned Bhaddi's spirit. Bhaddi's spirit tries to marry Happu forcibly. Rajesh confronts Bhaddi and saves Happu from her.

videos.title: Rajesh Gets Irked with Happu Due to the Heat
videos.overview: Rajesh, annoyed by the heat, argues with Happu over shutting down the air conditioner to save it from damage. Masterji faints due to the heat. Subhash comes to Happu with his complaint.

videos.title: Hindrances in Happu and Rajesh's Romance
videos.overview: Rajesh invites Vimlesh over for some buttermilk. Irritated by the heat, Ammaji and the kids stop Happu and Rajesh from getting romantic. Beni and Vimlesh also join them in their room to enjoy the AC.

videos.title: Happu Tries to Arrange the AC
videos.overview: Happu arranges for AC from the dealer Santram and informs Rajesh. The minister's PA calls Santram for the same. Ranbir and Chamchi try to postpone the exam. Rajesh scolds Happu for not arranging AC.

videos.title: Happu and Rajesh Try to Romance
videos.overview: Happu tries to appease Rajesh. They try to get romantic, but Amma interrupts them. Happu asks Santaram about an AC. Later, he takes another packet of medicine from Baba and informs Beni about it.

videos.title: Happu Shatters Rajesh's Hopes
videos.overview: Happu and Rajesh's romance gets disturbed due to Vimalesh. Happu receives an AC from Santaram by framing him in a false case. When Rajesh tries to be romantic, Happu tells her about Baba's medicine.

videos.title: Happu Plans to Celebrate Father's Day
videos.overview: Happu tells Beni that he plans to celebrate Father's Day and confides his feelings in Rajesh. Amma tells Happu about Khanna's death. Happu and Malaika argue while Sneha gets her work done by Ranbir.

videos.title: Is Happu Khanna's Son?
videos.overview: Pitaji tells Amma that Khanna has told him that Happu is his son. Rajesh hears Amma's words. Later, Happu gets upset about the children's behaviour. Rajesh tells Happu that he is Khanna's son.

videos.title: Happu Is Saddened by the Truth about His Father
videos.overview: Malaika slaps a man. Happu argues with Amma after learning the truth about his father. Ranbir confesses his feelings to Sneha. Chamchi asks Rajesh for permission to go camping.

videos.title: Happu Saves Chamchi
videos.overview: Happu asks Malaika to apologise to the minister's brother-in-law. Amma tells Pitaji that Happu is their own son. Happu saves Chamchi in the jungle. Ranbir tells Malaika the reason for his sorrow.
