videos.overview: Reshampal tells Happu how his father was strict with him in childhood, which made him a helpless man. Angered by Hrithik’s misbehaviour, Happu throws him out of the house to teach him a lesson.

videos.title: Hrithik Is Forced to Work as a Labourer
videos.overview: Upon Hrithik's request, Jasmine's father gives him labour work. Meanwhile, Amma scolds Happu for his behaviour. Rajesh comes to Hrithik, feeds him, and asks him to return home.

videos.title: Hrithik Clashes with Beni for Jasmine’s Sake
videos.overview: Rajesh decides not to celebrate Janmashtami until Hrithik returns. Hrithik stops Beni from taking action against Jasmine’s father. Happu insults Masterji when he comes to talk about Hrithik.

videos.title: Happu Punishes Himself for His Actions
videos.overview: Happu asks Beni to beat him with a belt as punishment. Ranbir and Chamchi urge Happu to bring Hrithik back. Later, Happu sees Hrithik washing dishes and feels heartbroken.

videos.title: Happu Brings Hrithik Back Home
videos.overview: Beni tells the children that Happu is punishing himself for sending Hrithik out of the house. Happu brings Hrithik back home after talking to Reshampal, and the family celebrates Janmashtami.

videos.title: Happu Misunderstands Rajesh
videos.overview: Hansmukh, a washerman, reads out Hritik's love letter to Rajesh, which makes Happu suspect that Rajesh is having an affair with Hansmukh. When Rajesh questions Hritik, he tells her about Jasmine.

videos.title: Kamlesh’s Twin Brother Sonu Falls for Malaika
videos.overview: Kamlesh’s twin brother Sonu falls for Malaika. Hritik gets into a fight with Reshampal’s son, Sootpal, over Jasmine. Hearing Rajesh’s words, Happu decides to lose weight and win Rajesh back.

videos.title: Happu Expresses His Grief to Beni
videos.overview: Happu tells Beni that Rajesh is having an affair with Hasmukh. On the other hand, Sonu calls Malaika to befriend her. Later, Hrithik and Sutpal get into a fight over Jasmine.

videos.title: Happu Tells Hrithik to Apologise to Sutpal
videos.overview: Desperate to save his job, Happu urges Hrithik to apologise to Sutpal. Furious, Amma beats Happu, and Malaika slaps Sonu for his comment. Later, Amma shares a story with Happu.

videos.title: Happu Arrives to Stop Rajesh and Hasmukh's Wedding
videos.overview: Manohar tells Happu that Rajesh plans to marry Hasmukh at the temple. Happu rushes there, and Rajesh clears the air. Meanwhile, Sonu threatens Malaika with poison if she refuses to be his friend.

videos.title: Happu's Growing Interest in the Stock Market
videos.overview: A man boasts to Happu about his stock market earnings, sparking his curiosity. Stockbroker PK asks Happu to jail him. Intrigued, Happu asks PK for a stock market tip and boldly invests INR 20,000.

videos.title: Happu Asks Beni to Invest in the Stock Market
videos.overview: Happu shares his plan with Beni and convinces him to invest in the stock market. Amma teaches Bela a lesson at Rajesh’s parlour. Meanwhile, Manohar dances dressed as a woman to entertain PK.

videos.title: Will Gabbar Give Happu Money?
videos.overview: Happu asks Rajesh to request money from Gabbar for investing in the stock market. Chamchi’s plan brings Bansuri closer to Ranbir, while Happu also discusses investment with PK.

videos.title: The Stock Market Makes Happu Rich
videos.overview: Happu and his family celebrate as their stock market investment doubles. Sonu comes down to meet Malaika, irritating her. Later, Chamchi and Hrithik console a heartbroken Ranbir.

videos.title: Happu's Family Is Shocked by the Financial Loss
videos.overview: A major stock market loss shocks Happu and his family. PK is stunned when it's revealed that Manohar was pretending to be a woman. Later, a bank employee brings them unexpected good news.

videos.title: The Doctor Advises Rajesh to Get Glasses
videos.overview: Rajesh consults the doctor for a heavy head, and he advises her to get glasses. While Chamchi declines to be Sutpal’s dance partner, Sonu bets with Malaika and eventually wins.

videos.title: Rajesh Decides to Not Get Glasses
videos.overview: Rajesh discovers Happu’s strong dislike for glasses and decides against getting them. Meanwhile, Sonu stands up to two goons harassing Malaika.

videos.title: Amma Develops a Misunderstanding about Rajesh
videos.overview: Rajesh wears contact lenses, and Amma mistakenly believes she’s possessed. While Ranbir and Hrithik plan to help Chamchi, Beni discusses Rajesh with Happu.

videos.title: Happu Visits an Occultist
videos.overview: Beni takes Happu to an occultist, who gives him a special powder to place in the kitchen. Meanwhile, Sutpal speaks with the MLA’s daughter, Shakti, who quickly catches on to Chamchi’s plan.

videos.title: Happu Brings the Occultist Home
videos.overview: Happu brings an occultist to help Rajesh. When a suitor’s family visits Malaika, Chamchi pretends being possessed and drives them away. Rajesh later admits to having poor eyesight.

videos.title: Sky Mocks the Snacks Chamchi Brings
videos.overview: Gagan confesses his love to Chamchi, but she rejects him. He joins her college under a new identity, Sky, and mocks the snacks she brings. Chamchi asks her family to pack exotic cuisine in her tiffin.

videos.title: Chamchi Demands a Fancy Breakfast
videos.overview: At Chamchi’s request, Rajesh makes pizza for breakfast, and Happu and Amma eat it reluctantly. Rajesh asks Happu to bring broccoli from the market. Later, Sonu faints and Malaika grows worried.

videos.title: Happu’s Mission Broccoli
videos.overview: Happu heads out to buy broccoli, but shopkeeper Sharma, seeking revenge, refuses to sell it to him. Chamchi wins over Sky's heart with a pizza feast. Back home, Amma complains to Happu about the food.

videos.title: Chamchi Learns about Happu's Misdeed
videos.overview: Chamchi feeds Sky broccoli and realises Happu had swapped it with green-painted cabbage. For her next demand, Happu dons a disguise and heads to Sharma’s shop for zucchini.

videos.title: Chamchi Uncovers Sky's Truth
videos.overview: Rajesh firmly tells Amma to cook only what Chamchi likes. Chamchi discovers that Gagan is actually Sky and slaps him. She then asks the family to stop making exotic cuisines.

videos.title: Beni's Taunts Hurt Happu
videos.overview: Beni mocks Happu, claiming he'll never be more than a cop. Meanwhile, Hrithik asks Jasmine to join him for dandiya. Later, Happu and Beni decide to visit the Pahadiwali Mata temple to make a wish.

videos.title: Happu's Dream of Becoming a Commissioner
videos.overview: Happu tells Manohar he's going to the Pahadiwali Mata temple to pray for a commissioner's post, and Manohar informs the commissioner. That night, Happu dreams of his promotion and dances in his sleep.

videos.title: Will Happu Reach the Pahadiwala Mata Temple?
videos.overview: The commissioner plots to stop Happu from reaching the Pahadiwali Mata temple. Happu and Beni crawl their way there, while Rajesh observes a Nirjala fast for his wish to come true.

videos.title: Beni and Happu Return Home
videos.overview: Manohar criticises the commissioner for interfering with Happu’s devotion. Hrithik and Sutpal join a dandiya competition in front of Jasmine. Later, Beni and Happu return home.

videos.title: Happu's Family Celebrates Navratri
videos.overview: Happu gets a call, warning him of his demotion to constable. Worried, he and Beni revisit the Pahadiwali Mata temple. Later, the family performs aarti and enjoys garba together.

videos.title: Amma’s Fond Memories of Pitaji’s Scooter
videos.overview: Amma shares fond memories of Pitaji’s scooter with the children. Happu tells Rajesh about Pitaji’s special request. Ranbir talks to Ayesha about the scooter, and she makes a heartfelt request.

videos.title: Pitaji's Beloved Scooter Gets Stolen
videos.overview: Happu and Beni take Pitaji's scooter to go party, but it gets stolen. Later, the commissioner ends up committing a crime. Meanwhile, Ranbir prepares to fulfil Ayesha’s request to impress her.

videos.title: The Scooter Theft Creates Chaos in Happu’s House
videos.overview: When Pitaji’s scooter is found stolen, chaos breaks out at Happu’s house. Happu and Beni recall last night’s events. Sonu files a complaint at the station, and the commissioner seeks Malaika’s help.

videos.title: Happu Is Under Pressure to Find the Scooter
videos.overview: Ranbir is heartbroken as his dreams fall apart. Rajesh and Amma pressure Happu to find Pitaji’s scooter. Caught in a dilemma, Malaika takes Chamchi’s advice and decides to talk to Sonu.

videos.title: Happu Gets Pitaji's Scooter
videos.overview: Amma scolds Happu over Pitaji's stolen scooter. He learns the commissioner was behind it and brings it back. Rajesh, tempted by a necklace, fulfils Pitaji's wish.

videos.title: Happu Gets a Bag Full of Gold
videos.overview: Happu brings home a bag full of gold. The next day, Tony Rich, the commissioner’s brother-in-law, files a complaint at the police station. After fighting with Malaika, Sonu decides not to meet her.

videos.title: Rajesh Gives Gabbar the Bag of Jewellery
videos.overview: Rajesh hands Gabbar the jewellery bag. Meanwhile, Manohar, searching for Tony's bag, tips off the Commissioner and Happu. Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi threaten Halke for tricks to win someone’s love.

videos.title: Happu’s Act is Exposed in front of the Commissioner
videos.overview: Malaika discovers the truth about Sonu’s lover, Titu. Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi turn to tantra to fulfil their wishes. After the revelation, the Commissioner orders Happu to return Tony’s bag.

videos.title: Tony’s Jewellery Bag Is Stolen from Gabbar’s House
videos.overview: Pitaji tells Amma about the kids’ mischief, prompting her to confront Hrithik and Ranbir. Meanwhile, the Commissioner fumes over Tony’s stolen bag and gives Happu one last chance to recover it.

videos.title: Gabbar Saves Happu from Going to Jail
videos.overview: Happu, Beni and Manohar hold Gabbar captive to extract the truth. When the jewellery bag remains missing, Happu prepares to get jailed. Just in time, Gabbar reveals a secret and saves him.

videos.title: Happu Sees an Auspicious Dream before Diwali
videos.overview: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

videos.title: Happu Wins a Lottery, and Rajesh Slips Up
videos.overview: Manohar’s uncle, Mungerilal, helps the Commissioner with a task. Happu wins an INR 50 crore lottery but keeps it a secret from Beni. Meanwhile, Rajesh unknowingly makes a huge mistake.

videos.title: Beni Asks Happu for a Share in the Lottery Money
videos.overview: Rajesh hides the fact that the lottery ticket is damaged. Amma tells Beni about Happu’s win, prompting him to demand a share. Later, Hrithik proudly declares himself a millionaire at college.

videos.title: Rajesh’s Mistake Shatters the Family’s Dreams
videos.overview: Gabbar gets beaten up by Happu while trying to help Rajesh. Rajesh is forced to confess, shattering the family’s millionaire dreams. But Happu soon comes up with a clever plan to win the lottery.

videos.title: Happu’s Family Celebrates Diwali
videos.overview: Happu takes help from Manohar’s uncle, and more people claim a share in the lottery money. Bad news shatters everyone’s dream of becoming rich. Amma cheers everyone up, and they celebrate Diwali.

videos.title: Happu Learns about Pinky Gang’s Plan
videos.overview: After a strange dream, Rajesh worries about Happu and meets Baba Black Sheep. Happu catches Sanjay Singh Singhania from the Pinky Gang but soon uncovers a deeper plan behind their actions.

videos.title: Rajesh Casts the Baba Black Sheep Spell on Happu
videos.overview: Rajesh tries the Baba Black Sheep spell on Happu. Later, Happu tells Beni about Pinky Gang’s plan, but Rajesh misunderstands. Meanwhile, Malaika joins Sonu’s photoshoot to support him.

videos.title: The Family Learns about Malaika and Sonu’s Photo
videos.overview: Happu tricks Manohar, while Rajesh tries to woo Happu by wearing a nightie gifted by Baba Black Sheep. Meanwhile, Beni spots Malaika and Sonu’s photo and alerts the family.

videos.title: Rajesh Learns the Truth about Baba Black Sheep
videos.overview: Happu forces a confession from Singhania. The recovery agent harassing Beni troubles Happu also. Meanwhile, Rajesh uncovers Baba Black Sheep’s truth and overhears Happu sharing the plan with Beni.

videos.title: Happu Nabs Pinky Gang
videos.overview: Ranbir and Chamchi overhear Happu’s plan from Rajesh and go to rob the bank as well. To catch Happu red-handed, Amma and Rajesh arrive at the bank with Gabbar, while Happu nabs Pinky Gang.

videos.title: Happu's New Woe
videos.overview: Happu feels troubled for not understanding others' thoughts. He feeds a hungry baba, who blesses him. Meanwhile, Hrithik and Ranbir assure Kiara of help, while Chamchi gets angry.

videos.title: Happu Receives a Unique Power
videos.overview: Happu suddenly gains the ability to hear people’s thoughts and eagerly tells Beni about it. Later, he cleverly uses this power to make a smuggler confess where the hidden diamonds are.

videos.title: Happu Uses His Powers to Locate the Diamonds
videos.overview: Happu uses his powers to locate two diamonds hidden by a smuggler. Malaika sets a condition for accepting Sonu’s friendship, while Happu tries to settle a dispute between Amma and Rajesh.

videos.title: Rajesh Learns about Happu's Power
videos.overview: Rajesh learns about Happu’s powers. At the station, Happu retrieves the remaining diamonds, raising the smuggler’s suspicions. Beni brings Sonu to Happu for help.

videos.title: Happu's Family Makes Him Reveal His Secret
videos.overview: Happu hears Malaika’s thoughts and helps Sonu. Rajesh tells the family about his powers, and they trick Happu into revealing his secret.

videos.title: Rajesh Fumes over Happu’s Cold Behaviour
videos.overview: Rajesh clashes with Happu over his indifference. Amma finds a way to rekindle their bond. Meanwhile, Beni gets intoxicated as he misses Vimlesh and then fights with the paan seller.

videos.title: Rajesh Is Overjoyed to Receive Happu's Love
videos.overview: Rajesh gives Happu an occultist’s special juice, which makes him shower her with love, leaving her delighted. Later, at the station, Happu arrests a ghazal singer based on his wife's complaint.

videos.title: Happu Embarrasses Himself in front of Masterji
videos.overview: Happu tries to cheer up Rajesh with a ghazal singer, but she gets irritated. Later, she visits Masterji at college to discuss Ranbir’s complaint, where Happu shows up and embarrasses himself.

videos.title: The Family Comes Up with a Way to Cure Happu
videos.overview: Gabbar comes to take Rajesh to her maternal home, but Happu stops her. Still lost in her thoughts, Happu's antics land Manohar in trouble. The family begins looking for a way to help him recover.

videos.title: Happu's Love Craze Has Finally Worn Off
videos.overview: The family's plan to have Happu cured flops. Rajesh then feeds him Baba's offering, which helps break the love spell. Meanwhile, Beni thrashes the paan seller after discovering his deeds.

videos.title: Happu Is Tasked to Find a Missing Dog
videos.overview: Happu tries to console an upset Beni. Meanwhile, Gabbar tells Amma and others about Baba Bangali's special herbal powder. The commissioner gives Happu the task of finding his neighbour's dog, Gabaru.

videos.title: Beni Holds Gabbar Singh Captive
videos.overview: Hrithik and Chamchi plot to extort Ranbir, while Beni holds Gabbar Singh captive and tortures him to locate Vimlesh. Meanwhile, Rajesh looks for Gabbar, leaving Happu deeply distressed.

videos.title: Rajesh Reaches Beni while Looking for Gabbar
videos.overview: Lakshmi begins to see Thiru everywhere. In Ambika’s absence, Kanchana conductss Parashuraman and Vasundhara’s 'shashtiapthapoorthi' ceremony and makes a heartfelt request.

videos.title: Malaika Exposes Beni’s Actions to the Family
videos.overview: Malaika follows Happu to Beni’s house and finds Gabbar tied up. She informs everyone, and Happu promises to rescue him. Later, Happu vents his anger on the commissioner.

videos.title: Happu Renders Beni Unconscious to Save Gabbar
videos.overview: To save Gabbar, Happu injects Beni with the doctor’s sedative, knocking him out. Meanwhile, Ranbir uncovers Hrithik and Chamchi’s prank. Furious over Gabru’s bite, the Commissioner suspends Happu.

videos.title: Hrithik Rules the Game of Cricket
videos.overview: Masterji tells Happu about Ritik’s fine cricket performance. Happu and Rajesh dream of him on the world stage, while the Commissioner surprises Happu by praising Sutpal.

videos.title: Beni Offers Hrithik a Proposal
videos.overview: Hrithik finds himself in need of INR 5,000. Recognising his cricket talent, Beni puts forth a proposal. At home, Amma and Rajesh pin their hopes on Hrithik’s victory in the match.

videos.title: Hrithik Gets Stuck in a Match Fixing Case
videos.overview: Hrithik leads his college team to defeat in the cricket match and bring humiliation upon Masterji. The Commissioner considers Hrithik guilty of match-fixing and pressures Happu to arrest him.

videos.title: Hrithik’s Family Tries to Protect Him from Arrest
videos.overview: To save Hrithik from arrest, Amma devises a plan, and the family lies to Happu that Hrithik has fled. Under the commissioner’s orders, Happu thrashes Beni to force a confession.

videos.title: Hrithik Rectifies His Mistake
videos.overview: Malaika unmasks Hrithik hiding in disguise at home, and Happu arrests him. Just then, Masterji arrives with news, prompting Hrithik to redeem himself and rectify his mistake right.

videos.title: Tired of His Life, Happu Prays to God
videos.overview: Exhausted by his chaotic life, Happu hears from Beni about a mystic in the cemetery. He makes a wish to God, but later, a common man exposes his failing health before the Commissioner.

videos.title: Happu Finds a Solution to His Problem
videos.overview: Happu’s scientist uncle builds a robot in his likeness, which Happu cleverly uses. Beni, trapped in a graveyard, calls for help, while at home Rajesh mistakes the robot for Happu.

videos.title: Happu Wows Everyone with a Robot’s Aid
videos.overview: Robot Happu T‑20 romances Rajesh, angering Happu. Later, the robot takes over all his duties, impressing everyone. Happu then reveals the truth about his robot to Beni.

videos.title: The Robot Spells Trouble for Happu and Beni
videos.overview: Beni’s dream of building a robot drags him into trouble. At the same time, Happu T‑20 turns into a headache for Happu, who finally reveals the truth to Rajesh.

videos.title: Happu Gets Rid of the Robot
videos.overview: After conducting a test, Rajesh becomes convinced that the person living in the house is not Happu but his robot. Later, Happu tells Rajesh a plan, and with her help, Happu gets rid of the robot.

videos.title: Amma’s Memories Tied to Her Favourite Quilt
videos.overview: Amma recalls old memories of her favourite quilt to the children. Later, she angers Rajesh by refusing her earrings, prompting her to take a vow. Meanwhile, at college, Ranbir finds a new love!

videos.title: Amma Is Shocked by the Quilt Theft
videos.overview: The quilt theft leaves Amma shaken and ill. She has her family swear to recover it. Soon, a cold wave grips the city, and everyone shivers in the piercing cold.

videos.title: Rajesh Admits to Stealing the Quilt
videos.overview: Amma frees the shivering children from their vow. Discovering Rajesh’s mischief, they plot a plan. Fearing Happu’s anger, Rajesh confesses to Amma, but the quilt actually gets stolen.

videos.title: Malaika Brings the Quilt Thieves before Amma
videos.overview: Rajesh tells Amma about the quilt stolen from the storeroom, leaving Happu shivering on night duty. Later, Malaika drags the quilt thieves to Amma.

videos.title: Amma’s Quilt Is in Beni’s Possession
videos.overview: Beni steals the quilt from Happu’s children’s room and sets a condition before Amma. Later, the family devises a plan to reclaim it, while Amma fulfils Rajesh’s heartfelt wish.

videos.title: Happu Gets Stuck Because of the Property Tax
videos.overview: Rajesh becomes an insurance agent and tries to sell policies to everyone. Happu, stuck with pending property tax, hears Rajesh explain the benefits of insurance and comes up with a plan.

videos.title: Happu Falls Victim to an Accident
videos.overview: Rajesh agrees to help Happu, but because of her own plan, Happu falls victim to an accident. Meanwhile, Ranbir’s quick-money scheme lands him in trouble.

videos.title: Happu Falls for Chamkili
videos.overview: After the accident, Happu’s memory goes back 20 years. Learning Ranbir’s mischief, Rajesh gets shocked. Meanwhile, thinking himself young, Happu falls for Constable Chamkili at the station.

videos.title: Rajesh's Plan to Pull Happu out of a Trap
videos.overview: Beni brings an alarming news to Rajesh. Later, with his help, Happu threatens Tax Officer C.K. Sutiya. Meanwhile, Rajesh tries a trick to pull Happu out of Chamkili’s love spell.

videos.title: Happu Decides to Marry Pinky
videos.overview: Beni cleverly gets Chamkili suspended from the job. Smitten by Pinky, Happu decides to marry her. But Amma's plan helps him regain his memories, and he realises that Pinky is none other than Rajesh.

videos.title: Judge Satyaprakash Gives Happu an Unusual Punishment
videos.overview: Happu overhears the children plotting to extort money from him. Later, Judge Satyaprakash witnesses Happu assaulting a needy man, punishes him, and instructs Malaika to keep an eye on him.

videos.title: Happu Asks Amma for Help to Keep His Job
videos.overview: When the sacred flame for Happu’s promotion goes off for the third time, Rajesh gets worried. Happu breaks the troubling news to her and seeks Amma’s support to protect his job.

videos.title: Judge Satyaprakash Grants Happu One Last Chance
videos.overview: Malaika uncovers Amma and Happu’s act. Later, Judge Satyaprakash catches Happu in another mistake. However, urged by the commissioner, he grants Happu a final chance, driving him to devise a plan.

videos.title: Happu’s Plan to Save His Job Fails
videos.overview: Happu’s cunning plan to save his job collapses once more, triggering Malaika’s fury. Later, Rajesh’s prayer is interrupted with an ill omen again, and Happu wakes shaken from a nightmare.

videos.title: Happu Is Rewarded for His Service
videos.overview: Judge Satyaprakash suspends Happu, but he saves a child from abduction and captures the kidnapper. Malaika’s revelation shifts the tide, and the judge prepares a surprising reward for Happu.

videos.title: Will Happu Prevent the Police Station from Closing?
videos.overview: With no crimes reported in Happu’s area for months, an order is passed for Happu to be honoured. However, MLA Chamanlal decides to shut down the police station since there has been no crime.

videos.title: Happu Goes to Apologise to Chintu Parchhai
videos.overview: Chamchi devises a plan to save Happu’s job, landing Hrithik and Ranbir in trouble. On Beni’s advice, Happu seeks Chintu Parchhai’s forgiveness, but a daring condition awaits.

videos.title: Happu Compels Beni to Steal from the Temple
videos.overview: Happu forces Beni to steal from a temple to save his job, but the plan fails. As Manohar secures new work, Happu turns to the Commissioner with a desperate plea.

videos.title: Happu Goes from Inspector to Peon
videos.overview: Municipal officer Madan assigns peon jobs to Happu and Manohar. When Happu’s truth emerges, the family considers cutting expenses, while Amma is shaken by a disturbing nightmare.

videos.title: Can Happu Retain His Job as Inspector?
videos.overview: Amma beats Rajesh to protect Happu’s inspector job. Next morning, a newspaper story excites Happu and Manohar, who rush to the station as the Commissioner makes a shocking revelation.

videos.title: Riya’s Dream of Marrying Hrithik
videos.overview: A baba predicts Rajesh’s future, but she doubts it. Meanwhile, Hrithik’s new love, Riya, dreams of marriage, and then Hrithik requests Rajesh and Happu to meet her father.

videos.title: Riya’s Boxer Father Sets a Condition before Happu
videos.overview: Riya’s parents visit Hrithik’s family. Her boxer father Jagawar, aka JV, sets a condition before Happu, while Rajesh forces him to agree, landing Happu in deep trouble.

videos.title: Boxing Contest Pressure Rises on Happu
